1.zh: 当乌西雅、约坦、亚哈斯、希西家作犹大王的时候，亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚得默示，论到犹大和耶路撒冷。
1.en: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

1.zh: 天哪，要听！地啊，侧耳而听！ 因为耶和华说： 我养育儿女，将他们养大， 他们竟悖逆我。
1.en: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for the LORD has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children and they have rebelled against me.

1.zh: 牛认识主人， 驴认识主人的槽， 以色列却不认识； 我的民却不留意。
1.en: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know. My people don’t consider.”

1.zh: 嗐！犯罪的国民， 担着罪孽的百姓； 行恶的种类， 败坏的儿女！ 他们离弃耶和华， 藐视以色列的圣者， 与他生疏，往后退步。
1.en: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken the LORD. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.

1.zh: 你们为什么屡次悖逆， 还要受责打吗？ 你们已经满头疼痛， 全心发昏。
1.en: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

1.zh: 从脚掌到头顶， 没有一处完全的， 尽是伤口、青肿，与新打的伤痕， 都没有收口，没有缠裹， 也没有用膏滋润。
1.en: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it, but wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, bandaged, or soothed with oil.

1.zh: 你们的地土已经荒凉； 你们的城邑被火焚毁。 你们的田地在你们眼前为外邦人所侵吞， 既被外邦人倾覆就成为荒凉。
1.en: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

1.zh: 仅存锡安城， 好像葡萄园的草棚， 瓜田的茅屋， 被围困的城邑。
1.en: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.

1.zh: 若不是万军之耶和华给我们稍留余种， 我们早已像所多玛、蛾摩拉的样子了。
1.en: Unless the LORD of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom. We would have been like Gomorrah.

1.zh: 你们这所多玛的官长啊， 要听耶和华的话！ 你们这蛾摩拉的百姓啊， 要侧耳听我们　神的训诲！
1.en: Hear the LORD’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

1.zh: 耶和华说： 你们所献的许多祭物与我何益呢？ 公绵羊的燔祭和肥畜的脂油， 我已经够了； 公牛的血，羊羔的血，公山羊的血， 我都不喜悦。
1.en: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says the LORD. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.

1.zh: 你们来朝见我， 谁向你们讨这些， 使你们践踏我的院宇呢？
1.en: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts?

1.zh: 你们不要再献虚浮的供物。 香品是我所憎恶的； 月朔和安息日，并宣召的大会， 也是我所憎恶的； 作罪孽，又守严肃会， 我也不能容忍。
1.en: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me. New moons, Sabbaths, and convocations— I can’t stand evil assemblies.

1.zh: 你们的月朔和节期，我心里恨恶， 我都以为麻烦； 我担当，便不耐烦。
1.en: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.

1.zh: 你们举手祷告，我必遮眼不看； 就是你们多多地祈祷，我也不听。 你们的手都满了[杀人的]血。
1.en: When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.

1.zh: 你们要洗濯、自洁， 从我眼前除掉你们的恶行， 要止住作恶，
1.en: Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.

1.zh: 学习行善， 寻求公平， 解救受欺压的； 给孤儿伸冤， 为寡妇辨屈。
1.en: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”

1.zh: 耶和华说： 你们来，我们彼此辩论。 你们的罪虽像朱红，必变成雪白； 虽红如丹颜，必白如羊毛。
1.en: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says the LORD: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

1.zh: 你们若甘心听从， 必吃地上的美物，
1.en: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;

1.zh: 若不听从，反倒悖逆， 必被刀剑吞灭。 这是耶和华亲口说的。
1.en: but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for the LORD’s mouth has spoken it.”

1.zh: 可叹，忠信的城变为妓女！ 从前充满了公平， 公义居在其中， 现今却有凶手居住。
1.en: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice. Righteousness lodged in her, but now there are murderers.

1.zh: 你的银子变为渣滓； 你的酒用水搀对。
1.en: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.

1.zh: 你的官长居心悖逆， 与盗贼作伴， 各都喜爱贿赂， 追求赃私。 他们不为孤儿伸冤； 寡妇的案件也不得呈到他们面前。
1.en: Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes and follows after rewards. They don’t defend the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come to them.

1.zh: 因此，主—万军之耶和华、 以色列的大能者说： 哎！我要向我的对头雪恨， 向我的敌人报仇。
1.en: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: “Ah, I will get relief from my adversaries, and avenge myself on my enemies.

1.zh: 我必反手加在你身上， 炼尽你的渣滓， 除净你的杂质。
1.en: I will turn my hand on you, thoroughly purge away your dross, and will take away all your tin.

1.zh: 我也必复还你的审判官，像起初一样， 复还你的谋士，像起先一般。 然后，你必称为公义之城， 忠信之邑。
1.en: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called ‘The city of righteousness, a faithful town.’

1.zh: 锡安必因公平得蒙救赎； 其中归正的人必因公义得蒙救赎。
1.en: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.

1.zh: 但悖逆的和犯罪的必一同败亡； 离弃耶和华的必致消灭。
1.en: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake the LORD shall be consumed.

1.zh: 那等人必因你们所喜爱的橡树抱愧； 你们必因所选择的园子蒙羞。
1.en: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.

1.zh: 因为，你们必如叶子枯干的橡树， 好像无水[浇灌]的园子。
1.en: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.

1.zh: 有权势的必如麻瓤； 他的工作好像火星， 都要一同焚毁，无人扑灭。
1.en: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”

2.zh: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚得默示，论到犹大和耶路撒冷。
2.en: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

2.zh: 末后的日子，耶和华殿的山必坚立， 超乎诸山，高举过于万岭； 万民都要流归这山。
2.en: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of the LORD’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.

2.zh: 必有许多国的民前往，说： 来吧，我们登耶和华的山， 奔雅各　神的殿。 主必将他的道教训我们； 我们也要行他的路。 因为训诲必出于锡安； 耶和华的言语必出于耶路撒冷。
2.en: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law shall go out of Zion, and the LORD’s word from Jerusalem.

2.zh: 他必在列国中施行审判， 为许多国民断定是非。 他们要将刀打成犁头， 把枪打成镰刀。 这国不举刀攻击那国； 他们也不再学习战事。
2.en: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples. They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

2.zh: 雅各家啊，来吧！ 我们在耶和华的光明中行走。
2.en: House of Jacob, come, and let’s walk in the light of the LORD.

2.zh: [耶和华]，你离弃了你百姓雅各家， 是因他们充满了东方的[风俗]， 作观兆的，像非利士人一样， 并与外邦人击掌。
2.en: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.

2.zh: 他们的国满了金银， 财宝也无穷； 他们的地满了马匹， 车辆也无数。
2.en: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.

2.zh: 他们的地满了偶像； 他们跪拜自己手所造的， 就是自己指头所做的。
2.en: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

2.zh: 卑贱人屈膝； 尊贵人下跪； 所以不可饶恕他们。
2.en: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.

2.zh: 你当进入岩穴，藏在土中， 躲避耶和华的惊吓和他威严的荣光。
2.en: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty.

2.zh: 到那日，眼目高傲的必降为卑； 性情狂傲的都必屈膝； 惟独耶和华被尊崇。
2.en: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and the LORD alone will be exalted in that day.

2.zh: 必有万军耶和华[降罚]的一个日子， 要临到骄傲狂妄的； 一切自高的都必降为卑；
2.en: For there will be a day of the LORD of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant, and for all that is lifted up, and it shall be brought low—

2.zh: 又临到黎巴嫩高大的香柏树和巴珊的橡树；
2.en: for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,

2.zh: 又临到一切高山的峻岭；
2.en: for all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,

2.zh: 又临到高台和坚固城墙；
2.en: for every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,

2.zh: 又临到他施的船只并一切可爱的美物。
2.en: for all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.

2.zh: 骄傲的必屈膝； 狂妄的必降卑。 在那日，惟独耶和华被尊崇；
2.en: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the arrogance of men shall be brought low; and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

2.zh: 偶像必全然废弃。
2.en: The idols shall utterly pass away.

2.zh: 耶和华兴起，使地大震动的时候， 人就进入石洞，进入土穴， 躲避耶和华的惊吓和他威严的荣光。
2.en: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

2.zh: 到那日，人必将为拜而造的金偶像、银偶像 抛给田鼠和蝙蝠。
2.en: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats,

2.zh: 到耶和华兴起，使地大震动的时候， 人好进入磐石洞中和岩石穴里， 躲避耶和华的惊吓和他威严的荣光。
2.en: to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of the LORD, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

2.zh: 你们休要[倚靠]世人。 他鼻孔里不过有气息； 他在一切事上可算什么呢？
2.en: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?

3.zh: 主—万军之耶和华从耶路撒冷和犹大， 除掉众人所倚靠的，所仗赖的， 就是所倚靠的粮，所仗赖的水；
3.en: For, behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;

3.zh: 除掉勇士和战士， 审判官和先知， 占卜的和长老，
3.en: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,

3.zh: 五十夫长和尊贵人， 谋士和有巧艺的， 以及妙行法术的。
3.en: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.

3.zh: [主说]：我必使孩童作他们的首领， 使婴孩辖管他们。
3.en: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.

3.zh: 百姓要彼此欺压； 各人受邻舍的欺压。 少年人必侮慢老年人； 卑贱人必侮慢尊贵人。
3.en: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the wicked against the honorable.

3.zh: 人在父家拉住弟兄，[说]： 你有衣服，可以作我们的官长。 这败落的事归在你手下吧！
3.en: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”

3.zh: 那时，他必扬声说： 我不作医治你们的人； 因我家中没有粮食，也没有衣服， 你们不可立我作百姓的官长。
3.en: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”

3.zh: 耶路撒冷败落， 犹大倾倒； 因为他们的舌头和行为与耶和华反对， 惹了他荣光的眼目。
3.en: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

3.zh: 他们的面色证明自己的不正； 他们述说自己的罪恶，并不隐瞒， 好像所多玛一样。 他们有祸了！因为作恶自害。
3.en: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

3.zh: 你们要论义人说：他必享福乐， 因为要吃自己行为所结的果子。
3.en: Tell the righteous that it will be well with them, for they will eat the fruit of their deeds.

3.zh: 恶人有祸了！他必遭灾难！ 因为要照自己手所行的受报应。
3.en: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them, for the deeds of their hands will be paid back to them.

3.zh: 至于我的百姓， 孩童欺压他们， 妇女辖管他们。 我的百姓啊，引导你的使你走错， 并毁坏你所行的道路。
3.en: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

3.zh: 耶和华起来辩论， 站着审判众民。
3.en: The LORD stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.

3.zh: 耶和华必审问他民中的长老和首领，[说]： 吃尽葡萄园果子的就是你们； 向贫穷人所夺的都在你们家中。
3.en: The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses.

3.zh: 主—万军之耶和华说： 你们为何压制我的百姓， 搓磨贫穷人的脸呢？
3.en: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

3.zh: 耶和华又说： 因为锡安的女子狂傲， 行走挺项，卖弄眼目， 俏步徐行，脚下玎珰，
3.en: Moreover the LORD said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking daintily as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;

3.zh: 所以，主必使锡安的女子头长秃疮； 耶和华又使她们赤露下体。
3.en: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and the LORD will make their scalps bald.”

3.zh: 到那日，主必除掉她们华美的脚钏、发网、月牙圈、
3.en: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,

3.zh: 耳环、手镯、蒙脸的帕子、
3.en: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,

3.zh: 华冠、足链、华带、香盒、符囊、
3.en: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume containers, the charms,

3.zh: 戒指、鼻环、
3.en: the signet rings, the nose rings,

3.zh: 吉服、外套、云肩、荷包、
3.en: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,

3.zh: 手镜、细麻衣、裹头巾、蒙身的帕子。
3.en: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.

3.zh: 必有臭烂代替馨香， 绳子代替腰带， 光秃代替美发， 麻衣系腰代替华服， 烙伤代替美容。
3.en: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.

3.zh: 你的男丁必倒在刀下； 你的勇士必死在阵上。
3.en: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

3.zh: 锡安的城门必悲伤、哀号； 她必荒凉坐在地上。
3.en: Her gates shall lament and mourn. She shall be desolate and sit on the ground.

4.zh: 在那日，七个女人必拉住一个男人，说：「我们吃自己的食物，穿自己的衣服，但求你许我们归你名下；求你除掉我们的羞耻。」
4.en: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, “We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our reproach.”

4.zh: 到那日，耶和华发生的苗必华美尊荣，地的出产必为以色列逃脱的人显为荣华茂盛。
4.en: In that day, the LORD’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.

4.zh: 主以公义的灵和焚烧的灵，将锡安女子的污秽洗去，又将耶路撒冷中[杀人]的血除净。那时，剩在锡安、留在耶路撒冷的，就是一切住耶路撒冷、在生命册上记名的，必称为圣。
4.en: It will happen that he who is left in Zion and he who remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy, even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem,
when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from within it, by the spirit of justice and by the spirit of burning.

4.zh: 耶和华也必在锡安全山，并各会众以上，使白日有烟云，黑夜有火焰的光。因为在全荣耀之上必有遮蔽。
4.en: The LORD will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.

4.zh: 必有亭子，白日可以得荫避暑，也可以作为藏身之处，躲避狂风暴雨。
4.en: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.

5.zh: 我要为我所亲爱的唱歌， 是我所爱者的歌，论他葡萄园的事： 我所亲爱的有葡萄园在肥美的山冈上。
5.en: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.

5.zh: 他刨挖园子，捡去石头， 栽种上等的葡萄树， 在园中盖了一座楼， 又凿出压酒池； 指望结[好]葡萄， 反倒结了野葡萄。
5.en: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.

5.zh: 耶路撒冷的居民和犹大人哪， 请你们现今在我与我的葡萄园中，断定是非。
5.en: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.

5.zh: 我为我葡萄园所做之外， 还有什么可做的呢？ 我指望结[好]葡萄， 怎么倒结了野葡萄呢？
5.en: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?

5.zh: 现在我告诉你们， 我要向我葡萄园怎样行： 我必撤去篱笆，使它被吞灭， 拆毁墙垣，使它被践踏。
5.en: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.

5.zh: 我必使它荒废，不再修理， 不再锄刨，荆棘蒺藜倒要生长。 我也必命云不降雨在其上。
5.en: I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”

5.zh: 万军之耶和华的葡萄园就是以色列家； 他所喜爱的树就是犹大人。 他指望的是公平， 谁知倒有暴虐； 指望的是公义， 谁知倒有冤声。
5.en: For the vineyard of the LORD of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.

5.zh: 祸哉！那些以房接房， 以地连地， 以致不留余地的， 只顾自己独居境内。
5.en: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!

5.zh: 我耳闻万军之耶和华[说]： 必有许多又大又美的房屋 成为荒凉，无人居住。
5.en: In my ears, the LORD of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.

5.zh: 三十亩葡萄园只出一罢特[酒]； 一贺梅珥谷种只结一伊法[粮食]。
5.en: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”

5.zh: 祸哉！那些清早起来追求浓酒， 留连到夜深，甚至因酒发烧的人。
5.en: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!

5.zh: 他们在筵席上 弹琴，鼓瑟，击鼓，吹笛，饮酒， 却不顾念耶和华的作为， 也不留心他手所做的。
5.en: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of the LORD, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.

5.zh: 所以，我的百姓因无知就被掳去； 他们的尊贵人甚是饥饿， 群众极其干渴。
5.en: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.

5.zh: 故此，阴间扩张其欲， 开了无限量的口； 他们的荣耀、群众、繁华， 并快乐的人都落[在其中]。
5.en: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.

5.zh: 卑贱人被压服； 尊贵人降为卑； 眼目高傲的人也降为卑。
5.en: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;

5.zh: 惟有万军之耶和华因公平而崇高； 圣者　神因公义显为圣。
5.en: but the LORD of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.

5.zh: 那时，羊羔必来吃草，如同在自己的草场； 丰肥人的荒场被游行的人吃尽。
5.en: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.

5.zh: 祸哉！那些以虚假之细绳牵罪孽的人！ 他们又像以套绳拉罪恶，
5.en: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,

5.zh: 说：任他急速行，赶快成就他的作为， 使我们看看； 任以色列圣者所谋划的临近成就， 使我们知道。
5.en: who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”

5.zh: 祸哉！那些称恶为善，称善为恶， 以暗为光，以光为暗， 以苦为甜，以甜为苦的人。
5.en: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

5.zh: 祸哉！那些自以为有智慧， 自看为通达的人。
5.en: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

5.zh: 祸哉！那些勇于饮酒， 以能力调浓酒的人。
5.en: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;

5.zh: 他们因受贿赂，就称恶人为义， 将义人的义夺去。
5.en: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!

5.zh: 火苗怎样吞灭碎秸， 干草怎样落在火焰之中， 照样，他们的根必像朽[物]， 他们的花必像灰尘飞腾； 因为他们厌弃万军之耶和华的训诲， 藐视以色列圣者的言语。
5.en: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust, because they have rejected the law of the LORD of Armies, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

5.zh: 所以，耶和华的怒气向他的百姓发作。 他的手伸出攻击他们，山岭就震动； 他们的尸首在街市上好像粪土。 虽然如此，他的怒气还未转消； 他的手仍伸不缩。
5.en: Therefore the LORD’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them. The mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is still stretched out.

5.zh: 他必竖立大旗，招远方的国民， 发嘶声叫他们从地极而来； 看哪，他们必急速奔来。
5.en: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.

5.zh: 其中没有疲倦的，绊跌的； 没有打盹的，睡觉的； 腰带并不放松， 鞋带也不折断。
5.en: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken,

5.zh: 他们的箭快利， 弓也上了弦。 马蹄算如坚石， 车轮好像旋风。
5.en: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses’ hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.

5.zh: 他们要吼叫，像母狮子， 咆哮，像少壮狮子； 他们要咆哮抓食， 坦然叼去，无人救回。
5.en: Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and carry it off, and there will be no one to deliver.

5.zh: 那日，他们要向以色列人吼叫， 像海浪匉訇； 人若望地，只见黑暗艰难， 光明在云中变为昏暗。
5.en: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land, behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds.

6.zh: 当乌西雅王崩的那年，我见主坐在高高的宝座上。他的衣裳垂下，遮满圣殿。
6.en: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

6.zh: 其上有撒拉弗侍立，各有六个翅膀：用两个翅膀遮脸，两个翅膀遮脚，两个翅膀飞翔；
6.en: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

6.zh: 彼此呼喊说： 圣哉！圣哉！圣哉！万军之耶和华； 他的荣光充满全地！
6.en: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”

6.zh: 因呼喊者的声音，门槛的根基震动，殿充满了烟云。
6.en: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

6.zh: 那时我说：「祸哉！我灭亡了！因为我是嘴唇不洁的人，又住在嘴唇不洁的民中，又因我眼见大君王—万军之耶和华。」
6.en: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Armies!”

6.zh: 有一撒拉弗飞到我跟前，手里拿着红炭，是用火剪从坛上取下来的，
6.en: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

6.zh: 将炭沾我的口，说：「看哪，这炭沾了你的嘴，你的罪孽便除掉，你的罪恶就赦免了。」
6.en: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

6.zh: 我又听见主的声音说：「我可以差遣谁呢？谁肯为我们去呢？」我说：「我在这里，请差遣我！」
6.en: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”

6.zh: 他说：「你去告诉这百姓说： 你们听是要听见，却不明白； 看是要看见，却不晓得。
6.en: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’

6.zh: 要使这百姓心蒙脂油， 耳朵发沉， 眼睛昏迷； 恐怕眼睛看见， 耳朵听见， 心里明白， 回转过来，便得医治。」
6.en: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”

6.zh: 我就说：「主啊，这到几时为止呢？」他说： 直到城邑荒凉，无人居住， 房屋[空闲]无人，地土极其荒凉。
6.en: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,

6.zh: 并且耶和华将人迁到远方， 在这境内撇下的地土很多。
6.en: and the LORD has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.

6.zh: 境内剩下的[人]若还有十分之一， 也必被吞灭， 像栗树、橡树虽被砍伐， 树ⶍ子却仍存留。 这圣洁的种类在国中也是如此。
6.en: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump.”

7.zh: 乌西雅的孙子、约坦的儿子、犹大王亚哈斯[在位]的时候，亚兰王利汛和利玛利的儿子、以色列王比加上来攻打耶路撒冷，却不能攻取。
7.en: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

7.zh: 有人告诉大卫家说：「亚兰与以法莲已经同盟。」王的心和百姓的心就都跳动，好像林中的树被风吹动一样。
7.en: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.

7.zh: 耶和华对以赛亚说：「你和你的儿子施亚雅述出去，到上池的水沟头，在漂布地的大路上，去迎接亚哈斯，
7.en: Then the LORD said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.

7.zh: 对他说：『你要谨慎安静，不要因亚兰[王]利汛和利玛利的儿子这两个冒烟的火把头所发的烈怒害怕，也不要心里胆怯。
7.en: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

7.zh: 因为亚兰和以法莲，并利玛利的儿子，设恶谋害你，
7.en: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,

7.zh: 说：我们可以上去攻击犹大，扰乱它，攻破它，在其中立他比勒的儿子为王。
7.en: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”

7.zh: 所以主耶和华如此说： 这所谋的必立不住， 也不得成就。
7.en: This is what the Lord GOD says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”

7.zh: 原来亚兰的首城是大马士革； 大马士革的首领是利汛。 （六十五年之内，以法莲必然破坏，不再成为国民。）
7.en: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people.

7.zh: 以法莲的首城是撒马利亚； 撒马利亚的首领是利玛利的儿子。 你们若是不信， 定然不得立稳。』」
7.en: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”

7.zh: 耶和华又晓谕亚哈斯说：
7.en: The LORD spoke again to Ahaz, saying,

7.zh: 「你向耶和华—你的　神求一个兆头：或求[显]在深处，或求[显]在高处。」
7.en: “Ask a sign of the LORD your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”

7.zh: 亚哈斯说：「我不求；我不试探耶和华。」
7.en: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt the LORD.”

7.zh: 以赛亚说：「大卫家啊，你们当听！你们使人厌烦岂算小事，还要使我的　神厌烦吗？
7.en: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?

7.zh: 因此，主自己要给你们一个兆头，必有童女怀孕生子，给他起名叫以马内利。
7.en: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

7.zh: 到他晓得弃恶择善的时候，他必吃奶油与蜂蜜。
7.en: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.

7.zh: 因为在这孩子还不晓得弃恶择善之先，你所憎恶的那二王之地必致见弃。
7.en: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.

7.zh: 耶和华必使亚述王[攻击你]的日子临到你和你的百姓，并你的父家，自从以法莲离开犹大以来，未曾有这样的日子。
7.en: The LORD will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah, even the king of Assyria.

7.zh: 「那时，耶和华要发嘶声，使埃及江河源头的苍蝇和亚述地的蜂子飞来；
7.en: It will happen in that day that the LORD will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

7.zh: 都必飞来，落在荒凉的谷内、磐石的穴里，和一切荆棘篱笆中，并一切的草场上。
7.en: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.

7.zh: 「那时，主必用大河外赁的剃头刀，就是亚述王，剃去头发和脚上的毛，并要剃净胡须。
7.en: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.

7.zh: 「那时，一个人要养活一只母牛犊，两只母绵羊；
7.en: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep.

7.zh: 因为出的奶多，他就得吃奶油，在境内所剩的人都要吃奶油与蜂蜜。
7.en: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.

7.zh: 「从前，凡种一千棵葡萄树、值银一千[舍客勒]的地方，到那时必长荆棘和蒺藜。
7.en: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, will be for briers and thorns.

7.zh: 人上那里去，必带弓箭，因为遍地满了荆棘和蒺藜。
7.en: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.

7.zh: 所有用锄刨挖的山地，你因怕荆棘和蒺藜，不敢上那里去；只可成了放牛之处，为羊践踏之地。」
7.en: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”

8.zh: 耶和华对我说：「你取一个大牌，拿人所用的笔，写上『玛黑珥·沙拉勒·哈施·罢斯』。
8.en: The LORD said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;

8.zh: 我要用诚实的见证人，祭司乌利亚和耶比利家的儿子撒迦利亚记录这事。」
8.en: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”

8.zh: 我—[以赛亚]与妻子同室；她怀孕生子，耶和华就对我说：「给他起名叫玛黑珥·沙拉勒·哈施·罢斯；
8.en: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then the LORD said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’

8.zh: 因为在这小孩子不晓得叫父叫母之先，大马士革的财宝和撒马利亚的掳物必在亚述王面前搬了去。」
8.en: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father’ and ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”

8.zh: 耶和华又晓谕我说：
8.en: The LORD spoke to me yet again, saying,

8.zh: 「这百姓既厌弃西罗亚缓流的水，喜悦利汛和利玛利的儿子；
8.en: “Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;

8.zh: 因此，主必使大河翻腾的水猛然冲来，就是亚述王和他所有的威势，必漫过一切的水道，涨过两岸；
8.en: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.

8.zh: 必冲入犹大，涨溢泛滥，直到颈项。以马内利啊，他展开翅膀，遍满你的地。」
8.en: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land, O Immanuel.

8.zh: 列国的人民哪，任凭你们喧嚷，终必破坏； 远方的众人哪，当侧耳而听！ 任凭你们束起腰来，终必破坏； 你们束起腰来，终必破坏。
8.en: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!

8.zh: 任凭你们同谋，终归无有； 任凭你们言定，终不成立； 因为　神与我们同在。
8.en: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”

8.zh: 耶和华以大能的手，指教我不可行这百姓所行的道，对我这样说：
8.en: For the LORD spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,

8.zh: 「这百姓说同谋背叛，你们不要说同谋背叛。他们所怕的，你们不要怕，也不要畏惧。
8.en: “Don’t call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy. Don’t fear their threats or be terrorized.

8.zh: 但要尊万军之耶和华为圣，以他为你们所当怕的，所当畏惧的。
8.en: The LORD of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.

8.zh: 他必作为圣所，却向以色列两家作绊脚的石头，跌人的磐石；向耶路撒冷的居民作为圈套和网罗。
8.en: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.

8.zh: 许多人必在其上绊脚跌倒，而且跌碎，并陷入网罗，被缠住。」
8.en: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”

8.zh: 你要卷起律法[书]，在我门徒中间封住训诲。
8.en: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.

8.zh: 我要等候那掩面不顾雅各家的耶和华；我也要仰望他。
8.en: I will wait for the LORD, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

8.zh: 看哪，我与耶和华所给我的儿女，就是从住在锡安山万军之耶和华来的，在以色列中作为预兆和奇迹。
8.en: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.

8.zh: 有人对你们说：「当求问那些交鬼的和行巫术的，就是声音绵蛮，言语微细的。」[你们便回答说]：「百姓不当求问自己的　神吗？岂可为活人[求问]死人呢？」
8.en: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?

8.zh: 人当以训诲和法度为标准；他们所说的，若不与此相符，必不得见晨光。
8.en: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.

8.zh: 他们必经过这地，受艰难，受饥饿；饥饿的时候，心中焦躁，咒骂自己的君王和自己的　神。
8.en: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse their king and their God. They will turn their faces upward,

8.zh: 仰观上天，俯察下地，不料，尽是艰难、黑暗，和幽暗的痛苦。[他们必]被赶入乌黑的黑暗中去。
8.en: then look to the earth and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.

9.zh: 但那受过痛苦的必不再见幽暗。 从前　神使西布伦地和拿弗他利地被藐视，末后却使这沿海的路，约旦河外，外邦人的加利利地得着荣耀。
9.en: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

9.zh: 在黑暗中行走的百姓看见了大光； 住在死荫之地的人有光照耀他们。
9.en: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.

9.zh: 你使这国民繁多， 加增他们的喜乐； 他们在你面前欢喜， 好像收割的欢喜， 像人分掳物那样的快乐。
9.en: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.

9.zh: 因为他们所负的重轭 和肩头上的杖， 并欺压他们人的棍， 你都已经折断， 好像在米甸的日子一样。
9.en: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.

9.zh: 战士在乱杀之间所穿戴的盔甲， 并那滚在血中的衣服， 都必作为可烧的， 当作火柴。
9.en: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.

9.zh: 因有一婴孩为我们而生； 有一子赐给我们。 政权必担在他的肩头上； 他名称为「奇妙策士、全能的　神、永在的父、和平的君」。
9.en: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

9.zh: 他的政权与平安必加增无穷。 他必在大卫的宝座上治理他的国， 以公平公义使国坚定稳固， 从今直到永远。 万军之耶和华的热心必成就这事。
9.en: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.

9.zh: 主使一言入于雅各[家]， 落于以色列[家]。
9.en: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.

9.zh: 这众百姓，就是以法莲 和撒马利亚的居民，都要知道； 他们凭骄傲自大的心说：
9.en: All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,

9.zh: 砖[墙]塌了，我们却要凿石头建筑； 桑树砍了，我们却要换香柏树。
9.en: “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”

9.zh: 因此，耶和华要高举利汛的敌人 来攻击以色列， 并要激动以色列的仇敌。
9.en: Therefore the LORD will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,

9.zh: 东有亚兰人，西有非利士人； 他们张口要吞吃以色列。 虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消； 他的手仍伸不缩。
9.en: The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

9.zh: 这百姓还没有归向击打他们的主， 也没有寻求万军之耶和华。
9.en: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought the LORD of Armies.

9.zh: 因此，耶和华一日之间 必从以色列中剪除头与尾， 棕枝与芦苇—
9.en: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.

9.zh: 长老和尊贵人就是头， 以谎言教人的先知就是尾。
9.en: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.

9.zh: 因为，引导这百姓的使他们走错了路； 被引导的都必败亡。
9.en: For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are destroyed.

9.zh: 所以，主必不喜悦他们的少年人， 也不怜恤他们的孤儿寡妇； 因为，各人是亵渎的，是行恶的， 并且各人的口都说愚妄的话。 虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消； 他的手仍伸不缩。
9.en: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

9.zh: 邪恶像火焚烧， 烧灭荆棘和蒺藜， 在稠密的树林中着起来， 就成为烟柱，旋转上腾。
9.en: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.

9.zh: 因万军之耶和华的烈怒，地都烧遍； 百姓成为火柴； 无人怜爱弟兄。
9.en: Through the LORD of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.

9.zh: 有人右边抢夺，仍受饥饿， 左边吞吃，仍不饱足； 各人吃自己膀臂上的肉。
9.en: One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:

9.zh: 玛拿西[吞吃]以法莲； 以法莲[吞吃]玛拿西， 又一同攻击犹大。 虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消； 他的手仍伸不缩。
9.en: Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh, and they together will be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

10.zh: 祸哉！那些设立不义之律例的 和记录奸诈之判语的，
10.en: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees

10.zh: 为要屈枉穷乏人， 夺去我民中困苦人的理， 以寡妇当作掳物， 以孤儿当作掠物。
10.en: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!

10.zh: 到降罚的日子，有灾祸从远方临到， 那时，你们怎样行呢？ 你们向谁逃奔求救呢？ 你们的荣耀存留何处呢？
10.en: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?

10.zh: 他们只得屈身在被掳的人以下， 仆倒在被杀的人以下。 虽然如此，耶和华的怒气还未转消； 他的手仍伸不缩。
10.en: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

10.zh: 亚述是我怒气的棍， 手中拿我恼恨的杖。
10.en: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!

10.zh: 我要打发他攻击亵渎的国民， 吩咐他攻击我所恼怒的百姓， 抢财为掳物，夺货为掠物， 将他们践踏，像街上的泥土一样。
10.en: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

10.zh: 然而，他不是这样的意思； 他心也不这样打算。 他心里倒想毁灭， 剪除不少的国。
10.en: However, he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.

10.zh: 他说：我的臣仆岂不都是王吗？
10.en: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?

10.zh: 迦勒挪岂不像迦基米施吗？ 哈马岂不像亚珥拔吗？ 撒马利亚岂不像大马士革吗？
10.en: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”

10.zh: 我手已经搆到有偶像的国； 这些国雕刻的偶像 过于耶路撒冷和撒马利亚的偶像。
10.en: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria,

10.zh: 我怎样待撒马利亚和其中的偶像， 岂不照样待耶路撒冷和其中的偶像吗？
10.en: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

10.zh: 主在锡安山和耶路撒冷成就他一切工作的时候，[主说]：「我必罚亚述王自大的心和他高傲眼目的荣耀。」
10.en: Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his arrogant looks.

10.zh: 因为他说： 我所成就的事是靠我手的能力 和我的智慧， 我本有聪明。 我挪移列国的地界， 抢夺他们所积蓄的财宝； 并且我像勇士，使坐宝座的降为卑。
10.en: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.

10.zh: 我的手搆到列国的财宝， 好像人搆到鸟窝； 我也得了全地， 好像人拾起所弃的雀蛋。 没有动翅膀的； 没有张嘴的，也没有鸣叫的。
10.en: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”

10.zh: 斧岂可向用斧砍木的自夸呢？ 锯岂可向用锯的自大呢？ 好比棍抡起那举棍的， 好比杖举起那非木的人。
10.en: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.

10.zh: 因此，主—万军之耶和华 必使亚述王的肥壮人变为瘦弱， 在他的荣华之下必有火着起， 如同焚烧一样。
10.en: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.

10.zh: 以色列的光必如火； 他的圣者必如火焰。 在一日之间，将亚述王的荆棘 和蒺藜焚烧净尽；
10.en: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.

10.zh: 又将他树林和肥田的荣耀全然烧尽， 好像拿军旗的昏过去一样。
10.en: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.

10.zh: 他林中剩下的树必稀少， 就是孩子也能写其数。
10.en: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.

10.zh: 到那日，以色列所剩下的和雅各家所逃脱的，不再倚靠那击打他们的，却要诚实倚靠耶和华—以色列的圣者。
10.en: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

10.zh: 所剩下的，就是雅各[家]所剩下的，必归回全能的　神。
10.en: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

10.zh: 以色列啊，你的百姓虽多如海沙，[惟有]剩下的归回。原来灭绝的事已定，必有公义施行，如水涨溢。
10.en: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.

10.zh: 因为主—万军之耶和华在全地之中必成就所定规的结局。
10.en: For the Lord, GOD of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth.

10.zh: 所以，主—万军之耶和华如此说：「住锡安我的百姓啊，亚述王虽然用棍击打你，又照埃及的样子举杖攻击你，你却不要怕他。
10.en: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, says, “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.

10.zh: 因为还有一点点时候，[向你们]发的忿恨就要完毕，我的怒气要向他[发作]，使他灭亡。
10.en: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”

10.zh: 万军之耶和华要兴起鞭来攻击他，好像在俄立磐石那里杀戮米甸人一样。耶和华的杖要向海伸出，把杖举起，像在埃及一样。
10.en: The LORD of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.

10.zh: 到那日，亚述王的重担必离开你的肩头；他的轭必离开你的颈项；那轭也必因肥壮的缘故撑断。」
10.en: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.

10.zh: 亚述王来到亚叶， 经过米矶 ， 在密抹安放辎重。
10.en: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.

10.zh: 他们过了隘口， 在迦巴住宿。 拉玛人战兢； 扫罗的基比亚人逃跑。
10.en: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.

10.zh: 迦琳的居民哪，要高声呼喊！ 莱煞人哪，须听！ 哀哉！困苦的亚拿突啊。
10.en: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!

10.zh: 玛得米那人躲避； 基柄的居民逃遁。
10.en: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.

10.zh: 当那日，亚述王要在挪伯歇兵， 向锡安女子的山— 就是耶路撒冷的山—抡手[攻他]。
10.en: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

10.zh: 看哪，主—万军之耶和华 以惊吓削去树枝； 长高的必被砍下， 高大的必被伐倒。
10.en: Behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.

10.zh: 稠密的树林，他要用铁器砍下； 黎巴嫩[的树木]必被大能者伐倒。
10.en: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.

11.zh: 从耶西的本必发一条； 从他根生的枝子必结果实。
11.en: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.

11.zh: 耶和华的灵必住在他身上， 就是使他有智慧和聪明的灵， 谋略和能力的灵， 知识和敬畏耶和华的灵。
11.en: The LORD’s Spirit will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD.

11.zh: 他必以敬畏耶和华为乐； 行审判不凭眼见， 断是非也不凭耳闻；
11.en: His delight will be in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;

11.zh: 却要以公义审判贫穷人， 以正直判断世上的谦卑人， 以口中的杖击打世界， 以嘴里的气杀戮恶人。
11.en: but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.

11.zh: 公义必当他的腰带； 信实必当他胁下的带子。
11.en: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist, and faithfulness the belt around his waist.

11.zh: 豺狼必与绵羊羔同居， 豹子与山羊羔同卧； 少壮狮子与牛犊并肥畜同群； 小孩子要牵引它们。
11.en: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat, the calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.

11.zh: 牛必与熊同食； 牛犊必与小熊同卧； 狮子必吃草，与牛一样。
11.en: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.

11.zh: 吃奶的孩子必玩耍在虺蛇的洞口； 断奶的婴儿必按手在毒蛇的穴上。
11.en: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.

11.zh: 在我圣山的遍处， 这一切都不伤人，不害物； 因为认识耶和华的知识要充满遍地， 好像水充满洋海一般。
11.en: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

11.zh: 到那日，耶西的根立作万民的大旗；外邦人必寻求他，他安息之所大有荣耀。
11.en: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.

11.zh: 当那日，主必二次伸手救回自己百姓中所余剩的，就是在亚述、埃及、巴忒罗、古实、以拦、示拿、哈马，并众海岛所剩下的。
11.en: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

11.zh: 他必向列国竖立大旗， 招回以色列被赶散的人， 又从地的四方聚集分散的犹大人。
11.en: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

11.zh: 以法莲的嫉妒就必消散； 扰害犹大的必被剪除。 以法莲必不嫉妒犹大， 犹大也不扰害以法莲。
11.en: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won’t envy Judah, and Judah won’t persecute Ephraim.

11.zh: 他们要向西飞， 扑在非利士人的肩头上， 一同掳掠东方人， 伸手按住以东和摩押； 亚扪人也必顺服他们。
11.en: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.

11.zh: 耶和华必使埃及海汊枯干， 抡手用暴热的风使大河分为七条， 令人过去不致湿脚。
11.en: The LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.

11.zh: 为主余剩的百姓， 就是从亚述剩下回来的， 必有一条大道， 如当日以色列从埃及地上来一样。
11.en: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

12.zh: 到那日，你必说： 耶和华啊，我要称谢你！ 因为你虽然向我发怒， 你的怒气却已转消； 你又安慰了我。
12.en: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, the LORD; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.

12.zh: 看哪！　神是我的拯救； 我要倚靠他，并不惧怕。 因为主耶和华是我的力量， 是我的诗歌， 他也成了我的拯救。
12.en: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”

12.zh: 所以，你们必从救恩的泉源欢然取水。
12.en: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.

12.zh: 在那日，你们要说： 当称谢耶和华，求告他的名； 将他所行的传扬在万民中， 提说他的名已被尊崇。
12.en: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Declare his doings among the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!

12.zh: 你们要向耶和华唱歌， 因他所行的甚是美好； 但愿这事普传天下。
12.en: Sing to the LORD, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!

12.zh: 锡安的居民哪，当扬声欢呼， 因为在你们中间的以色列圣者乃为至大。
12.en: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”

13.zh: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚得默示，论巴比伦。
13.en: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.

13.zh: 应当在净光的山竖立大旗， 向群众扬声招手， 使他们进入贵胄的门。
13.en: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

13.zh: 我吩咐我所挑出来的人； 我招呼我的勇士— 就是那矜夸高傲之辈， 为要成就我怒中所定的。
13.en: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.

13.zh: 山间有多人的声音， 好像是大国人民。 有许多国的民聚集哄嚷的声音； 这是万军之耶和华点齐军队，预备打仗。
13.en: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! The LORD of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.

13.zh: 他们从远方来， 从天边来， 就是耶和华并他恼恨的兵器 要毁灭这全地。
13.en: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

13.zh: 你们要哀号， 因为耶和华的日子临近了！ 这日来到， 好像毁灭从全能者来到。
13.en: Wail, for the LORD’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.

13.zh: 所以，人手都必软弱； 人心都必消化。
13.en: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.

13.zh: 他们必惊惶悲痛； 愁苦必将他们抓住。 他们疼痛，好像产难的妇人一样， 彼此惊奇相看，脸如火焰。
13.en: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.

13.zh: 耶和华的日子临到， 必有残忍、忿恨、烈怒， 使这地荒凉， 从其中除灭罪人。
13.en: Behold, the day of the LORD comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.

13.zh: 天上的众星群宿都不发光； 日头一出就变黑暗； 月亮也不放光。
13.en: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.

13.zh: 我必因邪恶刑罚世界， 因罪孽刑罚恶人， 使骄傲人的狂妄止息， 制伏强暴人的狂傲。
13.en: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the arrogance of the terrible.

13.zh: 我必使人比精金还少， 使人比俄斐纯金更少。
13.en: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.

13.zh: 我—万军之耶和华在忿恨中发烈怒的日子， 必使天震动， 使地摇撼，离其本位。
13.en: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in the LORD of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.

13.zh: 人必像被追赶的鹿， 像无人收聚的羊， 各归回本族， 各逃到本土。
13.en: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.

13.zh: 凡被[仇敌]追上的必被刺死； 凡被捉住的必被刀杀。
13.en: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.

13.zh: 他们的婴孩必在他们眼前摔碎； 他们的房屋必被抢夺； 他们的妻子必被玷污。
13.en: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.

13.zh: 我必激动米底亚人来攻击他们。 米底亚人不注重银子， 也不喜爱金子。
13.en: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.

13.zh: 他们必用弓击碎少年人， 不怜悯妇人所生的， 眼也不顾惜孩子。
13.en: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.

13.zh: 巴比伦素来为列国的荣耀， 为迦勒底人所矜夸的华美， 必像　神所倾覆的所多玛、蛾摩拉一样。
13.en: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

13.zh: 其内必永无人烟， 世世代代无人居住。 阿拉伯人也不在那里支搭帐棚； 牧羊的人也不使羊群卧在那里。
13.en: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.

13.zh: 只有旷野的走兽卧在那里； 咆哮的兽满了房屋。 鸵鸟住在那里； 野山羊在那里跳舞。
13.en: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.

13.zh: 豺狼必在它宫中呼号； 野狗必在它华美殿内吼叫。 巴比伦[受罚]的时候临近； 它的日子必不长久。
13.en: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.

14.zh: 耶和华要怜恤雅各，必再拣选以色列，将他们安置在本地。寄居的必与他们联合，紧贴雅各家。
14.en: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.

14.zh: 外邦人必将他们带回本土；以色列家必在耶和华的地上得外邦人为仆婢，也要掳掠先前掳掠他们的，辖制先前欺压他们的。
14.en: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in the LORD’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

14.zh: 当耶和华使你脱离愁苦、烦恼，并人勉强你做的苦工，得享安息的日子，
14.en: It will happen in the day that the LORD will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,

14.zh: 你必题这诗歌论巴比伦王说： 欺压人的何竟息灭？ 强暴的何竟止息？
14.en: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”

14.zh: 耶和华折断了恶人的杖， 辖制人的圭，
14.en: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,

14.zh: 就是在忿怒中连连攻击众民的， 在怒气中辖制列国， 行逼迫无人阻止的。
14.en: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.

14.zh: 现在全地得安息，享平静； 人皆发声欢呼。
14.en: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song.

14.zh: 松树和黎巴嫩的香柏树 都因你欢乐，[说]： 自从你仆倒， 再无人上来砍伐我们。
14.en: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”

14.zh: 你下到阴间， 阴间就因你震动来迎接你， 又因你惊动在世曾为首领的阴魂， 并使那曾为列国君王的， 都离位站起。
14.en: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

14.zh: 他们都要发言对你说： 你也变为软弱像我们一样吗？ 你也成了我们的样子吗？
14.en: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”

14.zh: 你的威势和你琴瑟的声音都下到阴间。 你下铺的是虫，上盖的是蛆。
14.en: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.

14.zh: 明亮之星，早晨之子啊， 你何竟从天坠落？ 你这攻败列国的何竟被砍倒在地上？
14.en: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!

14.zh: 你心里曾说： 我要升到天上； 我要高举我的宝座在　神众星以上； 我要坐在聚会的山上，在北方的极处。
14.en: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!

14.zh: 我要升到高云之上； 我要与至上者同等。
14.en: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”

14.zh: 然而，你必坠落阴间， 到坑中极深之处。
14.en: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.

14.zh: 凡看见你的都要定睛看你， 留意看你，[说]： 使大地战抖， 使列国震动，
14.en: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms,

14.zh: 使世界如同荒野， 使城邑倾覆， 不释放被掳的人归家， 是这个人吗？
14.en: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”

14.zh: 列国的君王 俱各在自己阴宅的荣耀中安睡。
14.en: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.

14.zh: 惟独你被抛弃， 不得入你的坟墓， 好像可憎的枝子， 以被杀的人为衣， 就是被刀刺透， 坠落坑中石头那里的； 你又像被践踏的尸首一样。
14.en: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.

14.zh: 你不得与君王同葬； 因为你败坏你的国，杀戮你的民。 恶人后裔的名，必永不提说。
14.en: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.

14.zh: 先人既有罪孽， 就要预备杀戮他的子孙， 免得他们兴起来，得了遍地， 在世上修满城邑。
14.en: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.

14.zh: 万军之耶和华说： 我必兴起攻击他们， 将巴比伦的名号和所余剩的人， 连子带孙一并剪除。 这是耶和华说的。
14.en: “I will rise up against them,” says the LORD of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says the LORD.

14.zh: 我必使巴比伦为箭猪所得， 又变为水池； 我要用灭亡的扫帚扫净它。 这是万军之耶和华说的。
14.en: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says the LORD of Armies.

14.zh: 万军之耶和华起誓说： 我怎样思想，必照样成就； 我怎样定意，必照样成立，
14.en: The LORD of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

14.zh: 就是在我地上打折亚述人， 在我山上将他践踏。 他加的轭必离开以色列人； 他加的重担必离开他们的肩头。
14.en: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.

14.zh: 这是向全地所定的旨意； 这是向万国所伸出的手。
14.en: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.

14.zh: 万军之耶和华既然定意，谁能废弃呢？ 他的手已经伸出，谁能转回呢？
14.en: For the LORD of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”

14.zh: 亚哈斯王崩的那年，就有以下的默示：
14.en: This burden was in the year that King Ahaz died.

14.zh: 非利士全地啊， 不要因击打你的杖折断就喜乐。 因为从蛇的根必生出毒蛇； 它所生的是火焰的飞龙。
14.en: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.

14.zh: 贫寒人的长子必有所食； 穷乏人必安然躺卧。 我必以饥荒治死你的根； 你所余剩的人必被杀戮。
14.en: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.

14.zh: 门哪，应当哀号！ 城啊，应当呼喊！ 非利士全地啊，你都消化了！ 因为有烟从北方出来， 他行伍中并无乱队的。
14.en: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.

14.zh: 可怎样回答外邦的使者呢？ 必说：耶和华建立了锡安； 他百姓中的困苦人必投奔在其中。
14.en: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.

15.zh: 论摩押的默示： 一夜之间，摩押的亚珥变为荒废， 归于无有； 一夜之间，摩押的基珥变为荒废， 归于无有。
15.en: The burden of Moab. For in a night, Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing. For in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing.

15.zh: 他们上巴益，又往底本， 到高处去哭泣。 摩押人因尼波和米底巴哀号， 各人头上光秃， 胡须剃净。
15.en: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.

15.zh: 他们在街市上都腰束麻布， 在房顶上和宽阔处俱各哀号， 眼泪汪汪。
15.en: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly.

15.zh: 希实本和以利亚利悲哀的声音达到雅杂， 所以摩押带兵器的高声喊嚷， 人心战兢。
15.en: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.

15.zh: 我心为摩押悲哀； 他的贵胄[逃]到琐珥， 到伊基拉·施利施亚。 他们上鲁希坡，随走随哭； 在何罗念的路上，因毁灭举起哀声。
15.en: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.

15.zh: 因为宁林的水成为干涸， 青草枯干，嫩草灭没， 青绿之物，一无所有。
15.en: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.

15.zh: 因此，摩押人所得的财物 和所积蓄的都要运过柳树河。
15.en: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.

15.zh: 哀声遍闻摩押的四境； 哀号的声音达到以基莲； 哀号的声音达到比珥·以琳。
15.en: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.

15.zh: 底们的水充满了血； 我还要加增底们的[灾难]， 叫狮子来追上摩押逃脱的民 和那地上所余剩的人。
15.en: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.

16.zh: 你们当将羊羔奉给那地掌权的， 从西拉往旷野，送到锡安城的山。
16.en: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

16.zh: 摩押的居民在亚嫩渡口， 必像游飞的鸟，如拆窝的[雏]。
16.en: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.

16.zh: 求你献谋略，行公平， 使你的影子在午间如黑夜， 隐藏被赶散的人，不可显露逃民。
16.en: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!

16.zh: 求你容我这被赶散的人和你同居。 至于摩押，求你作他的隐密处， 脱离灭命者的面。 勒索人的归于无有， 毁灭的事止息了， 欺压人的从国中除灭了，
16.en: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.

16.zh: 必有宝座因慈爱坚立； 必有一位诚诚实实坐在其上， 在大卫帐幕中施行审判， 寻求公平，速行公义。
16.en: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

16.zh: 我们听说摩押人骄傲， 是极其骄傲； 听说他狂妄、骄傲、忿怒； 他夸大的话是虚空的。
16.en: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.

16.zh: 因此，摩押人必为摩押哀号； 人人都要哀号。 你们摩押人要为吉珥·哈列设的葡萄饼哀叹， 极其忧伤。
16.en: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.

16.zh: 因为希实本的田地 和西比玛的葡萄树都衰残了。 列国的君主折断其上美好的枝子； 这枝子长到雅谢延到旷野， 嫩枝向外探出，直探过盐海。
16.en: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.

16.zh: 因此，我要为西比玛的葡萄树哀哭， 与雅谢人哀哭一样。 希实本、以利亚利啊， 我要以眼泪浇灌你； 因为有[交战]呐喊的声音 临到你夏天的果子， 并你收割的庄稼。
16.en: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.

16.zh: 从肥美的田中夺去了欢喜快乐； 在葡萄园里必无歌唱，也无欢呼的声音。 踹酒的在酒榨中不得踹出酒来； 我使他欢呼的声音止息。
16.en: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.

16.zh: 因此，我心腹为摩押哀鸣如琴； 我心肠为吉珥·哈列设也是如此。
16.en: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.

16.zh: 摩押人朝见的时候，在高处疲乏，又到他圣所祈祷，也不蒙应允。
16.en: It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.

16.zh: 这是耶和华从前论摩押的话。
16.en: This is the word that the LORD spoke concerning Moab in time past.

16.zh: 但现在耶和华说：「三年之内，照雇工的年数，摩押的荣耀与他的群众必被藐视，余剩的人甚少无几。」
16.en: But now the LORD has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”

17.zh: 论大马士革的默示： 看哪，大马士革已被废弃，不再为城， 必变作乱堆。
17.en: The burden of Damascus. “Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it will be a ruinous heap.

17.zh: 亚罗珥的城邑已被撇弃， 必成为牧羊之处； 羊在那里躺卧，无人惊吓。
17.en: The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and no one shall make them afraid.

17.zh: 以法莲不再有保障； 大马士革不再有国权； 亚兰所剩下的 必像以色列人的荣耀消灭一样。 这是万军之耶和华说的。
17.en: The fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria. They will be as the glory of the children of Israel,” says the LORD of Armies.

17.zh: 到那日，雅各的荣耀必至枵薄； 他肥胖的身体必渐瘦弱。
17.en: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.

17.zh: 就必像收割的人收敛禾稼， 用手割取穗子， 又像人在利乏音谷拾取遗落的穗子。
17.en: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat, and his arm reaps the grain. Yes, it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim.

17.zh: 其间所剩下的不多，好像人打橄榄树— 在尽上的枝梢上只剩两三个果子； 在多果树的旁枝上只剩四五个果子。 这是耶和华—以色列的　神说的。
17.en: Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree,” says the LORD, the God of Israel.

17.zh: 当那日，人必仰望造他们的主，眼目重看以色列的圣者。
17.en: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.

17.zh: 他们必不仰望祭坛，就是自己手所筑的，也不重看自己指头所做的，无论是木偶是日像。
17.en: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherah poles or the incense altars.

17.zh: 在那日，他们的坚固城必像树林中和山顶上所撇弃的地方，就是从前在以色列人面前被人撇弃的。这样，地就荒凉了。
17.en: In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.

17.zh: 因你忘记救你的　神， 不记念你能力的磐石； 所以，你栽上佳美的树秧子， 插上异样的栽子。
17.en: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the rock of your strength. Therefore you plant pleasant plants, and set out foreign seedlings.

17.zh: 栽种的日子，你周围圈上篱笆， 又到早晨使你所种的开花； 但在愁苦极其伤痛的日子， 所收割的都飞去了。
17.en: In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

17.zh: 唉！多民哄嚷，好像海浪匉訇； 列邦奔腾，好像猛水滔滔；
17.en: Ah, the uproar of many peoples who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!

17.zh: 列邦奔腾，好像多水滔滔； 但　神斥责他们，他们就远远逃避， 又被追赶，如同山上的风前糠， 又如暴风前的旋风土。
17.en: The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters, but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.

17.zh: 到晚上有惊吓，未到早晨他们就没有了。这是掳掠我们之人所得的分，是抢夺我们之人的报应。
17.en: At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.

18.zh: 唉！古实河外翅膀刷刷响声之地，
18.en: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;

18.zh: 差遣使者在水面上， 坐蒲草船过海。 [先知说]：你们快行的使者， 要到高大光滑的民那里去。 自从开国以来，那民极其可畏， 是分[地界]践踏[人]的； 他们的地有江河分开。
18.en: that sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters, saying, “Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide!”

18.zh: 世上一切的居民和地上所住的人哪， 山上竖立大旗的时候你们要看； 吹角的时候你们要听。
18.en: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen!

18.zh: 耶和华对我这样说： 我要安静，在我的居所观看， 如同日光中的清热， 又如露水的云雾在收割的热天。
18.en: For the LORD said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”

18.zh: 收割之先，花开已谢， 花也成了将熟的葡萄； 他必用镰刀削去嫩枝， 又砍掉蔓延的枝条，
18.en: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches.

18.zh: 都要撇给山间的鸷鸟和地上的野兽。 夏天，鸷鸟要宿在其上； 冬天，野兽都卧在其中。
18.en: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous birds will eat them in the summer, and all the animals of the earth will eat them in the winter.

18.zh: 到那时，这高大光滑的民， 就是从开国以来极其可畏、 分[地界]践踏[人]的， 他们的地有江河分开； 他们必将礼物奉给万军之耶和华， 就是奉到锡安山— 耶和华安置他名的地方。
18.en: In that time, a present will be brought to the LORD of Armies from a people tall and smooth, even from a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of the LORD of Armies, Mount Zion.

19.zh: 论埃及的默示： 看哪，耶和华乘驾快云， 临到埃及。 埃及的偶像在他面前战兢； 埃及人的心在里面消化。
19.en: The burden of Egypt. “Behold, the LORD rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence; and the heart of Egypt will melt within it.

19.zh: 我必激动埃及人攻击埃及人— 弟兄攻击弟兄， 邻舍攻击邻舍； 这城攻击那城， 这国攻击那国。
19.en: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

19.zh: 埃及人的心神必在里面耗尽； 我必败坏他们的谋略。 他们必求问偶像和念咒的、 交鬼的、行巫术的。
19.en: The spirit of the Egyptians will fail within them. I will destroy their counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards.

19.zh: 我必将埃及人交在残忍主的手中； 强暴王必辖制他们。 这是主—万军之耶和华说的。
19.en: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

19.zh: 海中的水必绝尽， 河也消没干涸。
19.en: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.

19.zh: 江河要变臭； 埃及的河水都必减少枯干。 苇子和芦荻都必衰残；
19.en: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.

19.zh: 靠尼罗河旁的草田， 并沿尼罗河所种的田，都必枯干。 [庄稼]被[风]吹去，归于无有。
19.en: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.

19.zh: 打鱼的必哀哭。 在尼罗河一切钓鱼的必悲伤； 在水上撒网的必都衰弱。
19.en: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.

19.zh: 用梳好的麻造物的 和织白布的都必羞愧；
19.en: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.

19.zh: 国柱必被打碎， 所有佣工的，心必愁烦。
19.en: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.

19.zh: 琐安的首领极其愚昧； 法老大有智慧的谋士， 所筹划的成为愚谋。 你们怎敢对法老说： 我是智慧人的子孙， 我是古王的后裔？
19.en: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings”?

19.zh: 你的智慧人在哪里呢？ 万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意， 他们可以知道，可以告诉你吧！
19.en: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now; and let them know what the LORD of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt.

19.zh: 琐安的首领都变为愚昧； 挪弗的首领都受了迷惑。 当埃及支派房角石的， 使埃及人走错了路。
19.en: The princes of Zoan have become fools. The princes of Memphis are deceived. They have caused Egypt to go astray, those who are the cornerstone of her tribes.

19.zh: 耶和华使乖谬的灵搀入埃及中间； 首领使埃及一切所做的都有差错， 好像醉酒之人呕吐的时候东倒西歪一样。
19.en: The LORD has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.

19.zh: 埃及中，无论是头与尾， 棕枝与芦苇，所做之工都不成就。
19.en: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do.

19.zh: 到那日，埃及人必像妇人一样，他们必因万军之耶和华在埃及以上所抡的手，战兢惧怕。
19.en: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of the LORD of Armies’s hand, which he shakes over them.

19.zh: 犹大地必使埃及惊恐，向谁提起犹大地，谁就惧怕。这是因万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意。
19.en: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of the LORD of Armies, which he determines against it.

19.zh: 当那日，埃及地必有五城的人说迦南的方言，又指着万军之耶和华起誓。有一城必称为「灭亡城」。
19.en: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”

19.zh: 当那日，在埃及地中必有为耶和华筑的一座坛；在埃及的边界上必有为耶和华[立]的一根柱。
19.en: In that day, there will be an altar to the LORD in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD at its border.

19.zh: 这都要在埃及地为万军之耶和华作记号和证据。埃及人因为受人的欺压哀求耶和华，他就差遣一位救主作护卫者，拯救他们。
19.en: It will be for a sign and for a witness to the LORD of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to the LORD because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.

19.zh: 耶和华必被埃及人所认识。在那日，埃及人必认识耶和华，也要献祭物和供物敬拜他，并向耶和华许愿还愿。
19.en: The LORD will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know the LORD in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to the LORD, and will perform it.

19.zh: 耶和华必击打埃及，又击打又医治，埃及人就归向耶和华。他必应允他们的祷告，医治他们。
19.en: The LORD will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to the LORD, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.

19.zh: 当那日，必有从埃及通亚述去的大道。亚述人要进入埃及，埃及人也进入亚述；埃及人要与亚述人一同敬拜[耶和华]。
19.en: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.

19.zh: 当那日，以色列必与埃及、亚述三国一律，使地上的人得福；
19.en: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing within the earth;

19.zh: 因为万军之耶和华赐福给他们，说：「埃及—我的百姓，亚述—我手的工作，以色列—我的产业，都有福了！」
19.en: because the LORD of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”

20.zh: 亚述王撒珥根打发他珥探到亚实突的那年，他珥探就攻打亚实突，将城攻取。
20.en: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;

20.zh: 那时，耶和华晓谕亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚说：「你去解掉你腰间的麻布，脱下你脚上的鞋。」以赛亚就这样做，露身赤脚行走。
20.en: at that time the LORD spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your sandals from off your feet.” He did so, walking naked and barefoot.

20.zh: 耶和华说：「我仆人以赛亚怎样露身赤脚行走三年，作为关乎埃及和古实的预兆奇迹。
20.en: The LORD said, “As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia,

20.zh: 照样，亚述王也必掳去埃及人，掠去古实人，无论老少，都露身赤脚，现出下体，使埃及蒙羞。
20.en: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

20.zh: 以色列人必因所仰望的古实，所夸耀的埃及，惊惶羞愧。
20.en: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

20.zh: 「那时，这沿海一带的居民必说：『看哪，我们素所仰望的，就是我们为脱离亚述王逃往求救的，不过是如此！我们怎能逃脱呢？』」
20.en: The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. And we, how will we escape?’”

21.zh: 论海旁旷野的默示： 有[仇敌]从旷野，从可怕之地而来， 好像南方的旋风，猛然扫过。
21.en: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.

21.zh: 令人凄惨的异象已默示于我。 诡诈的行诡诈，毁灭的行毁灭。 以拦哪，你要上去！ 米底亚啊，你要围困！ [主说]：我使一切叹息止住。
21.en: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.

21.zh: 所以，我满腰疼痛； 痛苦将我抓住， 好像产难的妇人一样。 我疼痛甚至不能听； 我惊惶甚至不能看。
21.en: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I am so dismayed that I can’t see.

21.zh: 我心慌张，惊恐威吓我。 我所羡慕的黄昏，变为我的战兢。
21.en: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.

21.zh: 他们摆设筵席， 派人守望，又吃又喝。 首领啊，你们起来， 用油抹盾牌。
21.en: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!

21.zh: 主对我如此说： 你去设立守望的， 使他将所看见的述说。
21.en: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.

21.zh: 他看见军队， 就是骑马的一对一对地来， 又看见驴队，骆驼队， 就要侧耳细听。
21.en: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”

21.zh: 他像狮子吼叫，[说]： 主啊，我白日常站在望楼上， 整夜立在我守望所。
21.en: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.

21.zh: 看哪，有一队军兵骑着马， 一对一对地来。 他就说：巴比伦倾倒了！倾倒了！ 他一切雕刻的神像都打碎于地。
21.en: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.

21.zh: 我被打的禾稼，我场上的谷啊， 我从万军之耶和华— 以色列的　神那里所听见的，都告诉你们了。
21.en: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.

21.zh: 论度玛的默示： 有人声从西珥呼问我[说]： 守望的啊，夜里如何？ 守望的啊，夜里如何？
21.en: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”

21.zh: 守望的说： 早晨将到，黑夜也来。 你们若要问就可以问， 可以回头再来。
21.en: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”

21.zh: 论阿拉伯的默示： 底但结伴的客旅啊， 你们必在阿拉伯的树林中住宿。
21.en: The burden on Arabia. You will lodge in the thickets in Arabia, you caravans of Dedanites.

21.zh: 提玛地的居民拿水来，送给口渴的， 拿饼来迎接逃避的。
21.en: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.

21.zh: 因为他们逃避刀剑和出了鞘的刀， 并上了弦的弓与刀兵的重灾。
21.en: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.

21.zh: 主对我这样说：「一年之内，照雇工的年数，基达的一切荣耀必归于无有。
21.en: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,

21.zh: 弓箭手所余剩的，就是基达人的勇士，必然稀少，因为这是耶和华—以色列的　神说的。」
21.en: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”

22.zh: 论异象谷的默示： 有什么事使你这[满城的人]都上房顶呢？
22.en: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?

22.zh: 你这满处呐喊、大有喧哗的城， 欢乐的邑啊， 你中间被杀的并不是被刀杀， 也不是因打仗死亡。
22.en: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town, your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.

22.zh: 你所有的官长一同逃跑， 都为弓箭手所捆绑。 你中间一切被找到的都一同被捆绑； 他们本是逃往远方的。
22.en: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.

22.zh: 所以我说：你们转眼不看我， 我要痛哭。 不要因我众民的毁灭， 就竭力安慰我。
22.en: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

22.zh: 因为主—万军之耶和华使「异象谷」 有溃乱、践踏、烦扰的日子。 城被攻破， 哀声达到山间。
22.en: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity from the Lord, GOD of Armies, in the valley of vision, a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”

22.zh: 以拦带着箭袋， 还有坐战车的和马兵； 吉珥揭开盾牌。
22.en: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.

22.zh: 你嘉美的谷遍满战车， 也有马兵在城门前排列。
22.en: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.

22.zh: 他去掉犹大的遮盖。 那日，你就仰望林库内的军器。
22.en: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.

22.zh: 你们看见大卫城的破口很多，便聚积下池的水，
22.en: You saw the breaches of David’s city, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

22.zh: 又数点耶路撒冷的房屋，将房屋拆毁，修补城墙，
22.en: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.

22.zh: 又在两道城墙中间挖一个聚水池可盛旧池的水，却不仰望做这事的主，也不顾念从古定这事的。
22.en: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who planned it long ago.

22.zh: 当那日，主—万军之耶和华叫人哭泣哀号， 头上光秃，身披麻布。
22.en: In that day, the Lord, GOD of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;

22.zh: 谁知，人倒欢喜快乐， 宰牛杀羊，吃肉喝酒，[说]： 我们吃喝吧！因为明天要死了。
22.en: and behold, there is joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: “Let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”

22.zh: 万军之耶和华亲自默示我[说]： 这罪孽直到你们死，断不得赦免！ 这是主—万军之耶和华说的。
22.en: The LORD of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

22.zh: 主—万军之耶和华这样说：「你去见掌银库的，就是家宰舍伯那，[对他说]：
22.en: The Lord, GOD of Armies says, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,

22.zh: 『你在这里做什么呢？有什么人竟在这里凿坟墓，就是在高处为自己凿坟墓，在磐石中为自己凿出安身之所？
22.en: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”

22.zh: 看哪，耶和华必像[大有力的]人，将你紧紧缠裹，竭力抛去。
22.en: Behold, the LORD will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.

22.zh: 他必将你滚成一团，[抛]在宽阔之地，好像抛球一样。你这主人家的羞辱，必在那里坐你荣耀的车，也必在那里死亡。
22.en: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you disgrace of your lord’s house.

22.zh: 我必赶逐你离开官职；你必从你的原位撤下。』
22.en: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.

22.zh: 「到那日，我必召我仆人希勒家的儿子以利亚敬来，
22.en: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,

22.zh: 将你的外袍给他穿上，将你的腰带给他系紧，将你的政权交在他手中。他必作耶路撒冷居民和犹大家的父。
22.en: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

22.zh: 我必将大卫家的钥匙放在他肩头上。他开，无人能关；他关，无人能开。
22.en: I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.
