22.zh: 我必将他[安稳]，像钉子钉在坚固处；他必作为他父家荣耀的宝座。
22.en: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.

22.zh: 他父家所有的荣耀，连儿女带子孙，都挂在他身上，好像一切小器皿，从杯子到酒瓶挂上一样。
22.en: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.

22.zh: 万军之耶和华说：当那日，钉在坚固处的钉子必压斜，被砍断落地；挂在其上的重担必被剪断。因为这是耶和华说的。」
22.en: “In that day,” says the LORD of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for the LORD has spoken it.”

23.zh: 论泰尔的默示： 他施的船只都要哀号； 因为泰尔变为荒场， 甚至没有房屋，没有可进之路。 这消息是从基提地得来的。
23.en: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.

23.zh: 沿海的居民， 就是素来靠航海西顿的商家得丰盛的， 你们当静默无言。
23.en: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea have replenished.

23.zh: 在大水之上， 西曷的粮食、 尼罗河的庄稼是泰尔的进项； 她作列国的大码头。
23.en: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.

23.zh: 西顿哪，你当惭愧； 因为大海说， 就是海中的保障说： 我没有劬劳，也没有生产， 没有养育男子，也没有抚养童女。
23.en: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”

23.zh: 这风声传到埃及； 埃及人为泰尔的风声极其疼痛。
23.en: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.

23.zh: 泰尔人哪，你们当过到他施去； 沿海的居民哪，你们都当哀号。
23.en: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!

23.zh: 这是你们欢乐的城， 从上古而有的吗？ 其中的居民往远方寄居。
23.en: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?

23.zh: 泰尔本是赐冠冕的。 她的商家是王子； 她的买卖人是世上的尊贵人。 遭遇如此是谁定的呢？
23.en: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of the earth?

23.zh: 是万军之耶和华所定的！ 为要污辱一切高傲的荣耀， 使地上一切的尊贵人被藐视。
23.en: The LORD of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

23.zh: 他施的民哪， 可以流行你的地，好像尼罗河； 不再有腰带拘紧你。
23.en: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.

23.zh: 耶和华已经向海伸手， 震动列国。 至于迦南， 他已经吩咐拆毁其中的保障。
23.en: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. The LORD has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.

23.zh: 他又说：受欺压西顿的居民哪， 你必不得再欢乐。 起来！过到基提去； 就是在那里也不得安歇。 （
23.en: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”

23.zh: 看哪，迦勒底人之地向来没有这民，这国是亚述人为住旷野的人所立的。现在他们建筑戍楼，拆毁泰尔的宫殿，使她成为荒凉。）
23.en: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.

23.zh: 他施的船只都要哀号， 因为你们的保障变为荒场。
23.en: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!

23.zh: 到那时，泰尔必被忘记七十年，照着一王的年日。七十年后，泰尔的景况必像妓女所唱的歌：
23.en: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.

23.zh: 你这被忘记的妓女啊， 拿琴周流城内， 巧弹多唱，使人再想念你。
23.en: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.

23.zh: 七十年后，耶和华必眷顾泰尔，她就仍得利息，与地上的万国交易。
23.en: It will happen after the end of seventy years that the LORD will visit Tyre. She will return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.

23.zh: 她的货财和利息要归耶和华为圣，必不积攒存留；因为她的货财必为住在耶和华面前的人所得，使他们吃饱，穿耐久的衣服。
23.en: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to the LORD. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

24.zh: 看哪，耶和华使地空虚，变为荒凉； 又翻转大地，将居民分散。
24.en: Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

24.zh: 那时百姓怎样，祭司也怎样； 仆人怎样，主人也怎样； 婢女怎样，主母也怎样； 买物的怎样，卖物的也怎样； 放债的怎样，借债的也怎样； 取利的怎样，出利的也怎样。
24.en: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.

24.zh: 地必全然空虚，尽都荒凉； 因为这话是耶和华说的。
24.en: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for the LORD has spoken this word.

24.zh: 地上悲哀衰残， 世界败落衰残； 地上居高位的人也败落了。
24.en: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.

24.zh: 地被其上的居民污秽； 因为他们犯了律法， 废了律例，背了永约。
24.en: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

24.zh: 所以，地被咒诅吞灭； 住在其上的显为有罪。 地上的居民被火焚烧， 剩下的人稀少。
24.en: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.

24.zh: 新酒悲哀，葡萄树衰残； 心中欢乐的俱都叹息。
24.en: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.

24.zh: 击鼓之乐止息； 宴乐人的声音完毕， 弹琴之乐也止息了。
24.en: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.

24.zh: 人必不得饮酒唱歌； 喝浓酒的，必以为苦。
24.en: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.

24.zh: 荒凉的城拆毁了； 各家关门闭户，使人都不得进去。
24.en: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

24.zh: 在街上因酒有悲叹的声音； 一切喜乐变为昏暗； 地上的欢乐归于无有。
24.en: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.

24.zh: 城中只有荒凉； 城门拆毁净尽。
24.en: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.

24.zh: 在地上的万民中， 必像打过的橄榄树， 又像已摘的葡萄所剩无几。
24.en: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

24.zh: 这些人要高声欢呼； 他们为耶和华的威严，从海那里扬起声来。
24.en: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of the LORD. They cry aloud from the sea.

24.zh: 因此，你们要在东方荣耀耶和华， 在众海岛荣耀耶和华—以色列　神的名。
24.en: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

24.zh: 我们听见从地极有人歌唱，[说]： 荣耀归于义人。 我却说：我消灭了！ 我消灭了，我有祸了！ 诡诈的行诡诈； 诡诈的大行诡诈。
24.en: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

24.zh: 地上的居民哪， 恐惧、陷坑、网罗都临近你。
24.en: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.

24.zh: 躲避恐惧声音的必坠入陷坑； 从陷坑上来的必被网罗缠住； 因为[天]上的窗户都开了， 地的根基也震动了。
24.en: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

24.zh: 地全然破坏，尽都崩裂， 大大地震动了。
24.en: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.

24.zh: 地要东倒西歪，好像醉酒的人； 又摇来摇去，好像吊床。 罪过在其上沉重， 必然塌陷，不能复起。
24.en: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.

24.zh: 到那日，耶和华在高处必惩罚高处的众军， 在地上必惩罚地上的列王。
24.en: It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

24.zh: 他们必被聚集，像囚犯被聚在牢狱中， 并要囚在监牢里， 多日之后便被讨罪。
24.en: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.

24.zh: 那时，月亮要蒙羞，日头要惭愧； 因为万军之耶和华必在锡安山， 在耶路撒冷作王； 在[敬畏]他的长老面前，必有荣耀。
24.en: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.

25.zh: 耶和华啊，你是我的　神； 我要尊崇你，我要称赞你的名。 因为你以忠信诚实行过奇妙的事， 成就你古时所定的。
25.en: The LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

25.zh: 你使城变为乱堆， 使坚固城变为荒场， 使外邦人宫殿的城不再为城， 永远不再建造。
25.en: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.

25.zh: 所以，刚强的民必荣耀你； 强暴之国的城必敬畏你。
25.en: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.

25.zh: 因为当强暴人催逼人的时候， 如同暴风直吹墙壁， 你就作贫穷人的保障， 作困乏人急难中的保障， 作躲暴风之处， 作避炎热的阴凉。
25.en: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.

25.zh: 你要压制外邦人的喧哗， 好像干燥地的热气下落； 禁止强暴人的凯歌， 好像热气被云影消化。
25.en: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.

25.zh: 在这山上，万军之耶和华必为万民用肥甘设摆筵席，用陈酒和满髓的肥甘，并澄清的陈酒，设摆筵席。
25.en: In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.

25.zh: 他又必在这山上除灭遮盖万民之物和遮蔽万国蒙脸的帕子。
25.en: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

25.zh: 他已经吞灭死亡直到永远。主耶和华必擦去各人脸上的眼泪，又除掉普天下他百姓的羞辱，因为这是耶和华说的。
25.en: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.

25.zh: 到那日，人必说：「看哪，这是我们的　神；我们素来等候他，他必拯救我们。这是耶和华，我们素来等候他，我们必因他的救恩欢喜快乐。」
25.en: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”

25.zh: 耶和华的手必按在这山上；摩押人在所居之地必被践踏，好像干草被践踏在粪池的水中。
25.en: For the LORD’s hand will rest in this mountain. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.

25.zh: 他必在其中伸开手，好像洑水的伸开手洑水一样；但[耶和华]必使他的骄傲和他手所行的诡计一并败落。
25.en: He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.

25.zh: 耶和华使你城上的坚固高台倾倒，拆平，直到尘埃。
25.en: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.

26.zh: 当那日，在犹大地人必唱这歌[说]： 我们有坚固的城。 耶和华要将救恩定为城墙，为外郭。
26.en: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.

26.zh: 敞开城门， 使守信的义民得以进入。
26.en: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.

26.zh: 坚心倚赖[你的]， 你必保守他十分平安， 因为他倚靠你。
26.en: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

26.zh: 你们当倚靠耶和华直到永远， 因为耶和华是永久的磐石。
26.en: Trust in the LORD forever; for in the LORD, the LORD, is an everlasting Rock.

26.zh: 他使住高处的与高城一并败落， 将城拆毁，拆平，直到尘埃，
26.en: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.

26.zh: 要被脚践踏， 就是被困苦人的脚和穷乏人的脚践踏。
26.en: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.”

26.zh: 义人的道是正直的； 你为正直的[主]，必修平义人的路。
26.en: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.

26.zh: 耶和华啊，我们在你行审判的路上等候你； 我们心里所羡慕的是你的名， 就是你那可记念的[名]。
26.en: Yes, in the way of your judgments, LORD, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.

26.zh: 夜间，我心中羡慕你； 我里面的灵切切寻求你。 因为你在世上行审判的时候， 地上的居民就学习公义。
26.en: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are on the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

26.zh: 以恩惠待恶人， 他仍不学习公义； 在正直的地上，他必行事不义， 也不注意耶和华的威严。
26.en: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see the LORD’s majesty.

26.zh: 耶和华啊，你的手高举， 他们仍然不看； 却要看你为百姓发的热心，因而抱愧， 并且有火烧灭你的敌人。
26.en: LORD, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.

26.zh: 耶和华啊，你必派定我们得平安， 因为我们所做的事都是你给我们成就的。
26.en: LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.

26.zh: 耶和华—我们的　神啊， 在你以外曾有别的主管辖我们， 但我们专要倚靠你，提你的名。
26.en: LORD our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.

26.zh: 他们死了，必不能再活； 他们去世，必不能再起； 因为你刑罚他们，毁灭他们， 他们的名号就全然消灭。
26.en: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.

26.zh: 耶和华啊，你增添国民， 你增添国民； 你得了荣耀， 又扩张地的四境。
26.en: You have increased the nation, O LORD. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.

26.zh: 耶和华啊，他们在急难中寻求你； 你的惩罚临到他们身上， 他们就倾心吐胆祷告你。
26.en: LORD, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.

26.zh: 妇人怀孕，临产疼痛， 在痛苦之中喊叫； 耶和华啊，我们在你面前也是如此。
26.en: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have been before you, LORD.

26.zh: 我们也曾怀孕疼痛， 所产的竟像风一样。 我们在地上未曾行什么拯救的事； 世上的居民也未曾败落。
26.en: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance on the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

26.zh: 死人要复活， 尸首要兴起。 睡在尘埃的啊，要醒起歌唱！ 因你的甘露[好像]菜蔬上的甘露， 地也要交出死人来。
26.en: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.

26.zh: 我的百姓啊，你们要来进入内室， 关上门，隐藏片时， 等到忿怒过去。
26.en: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.

26.zh: 因为耶和华从他的居所出来， 要刑罚地上居民的罪孽。 地也必露出其中的血， 不再掩盖被杀的人。
26.en: For, behold, the LORD comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.

27.zh: 到那日，耶和华必用他刚硬有力的大刀刑罚鳄鱼—就是那快行的蛇，刑罚鳄鱼—就是那曲行的蛇，并杀海中的大鱼。
27.en: In that day, the LORD with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.

27.zh: 当那日，有出酒的葡萄园， 你们要指这园唱歌[说]：
27.en: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!

27.zh: 我—耶和华是看守葡萄园的； 我必时刻浇灌， 昼夜看守， 免得有人损害。
27.en: I, the LORD, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.

27.zh: 我心中不存忿怒。 惟愿荆棘蒺藜与我交战， 我就勇往直前， 把它一同焚烧。
27.en: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.

27.zh: 不然，让它持住我的能力， 使它与我和好， 愿它与我和好。
27.en: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”

27.zh: 将来雅各要扎根， 以色列要发芽开花； 他们的果实必充满世界。
27.en: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

27.zh: 主击打他们， 岂像击打那些击打他们的人吗？ 他们被杀戮， 岂像被他们所杀戮的吗？
27.en: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?

27.zh: 你打发他们去， 是相机宜与他们相争； 刮东风的日子， 就用暴风将他们逐去。
27.en: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.

27.zh: 所以，雅各的罪孽得赦免， 他的罪过得除掉的果效，全在乎此： 就是他叫祭坛的石头变为打碎的灰石， 以致木偶和日像不再立起。
27.en: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.

27.zh: 因为坚固城变为凄凉， 成了撇下离弃的居所，像旷野一样； 牛犊必在那里吃草， 在那里躺卧，并吃尽其中的树枝。
27.en: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.

27.zh: 枝条枯干，必被折断； 妇女要来点火烧着。 因为这百姓蒙昧无知， 所以，创造他们的必不怜恤他们； 造成他们的也不施恩与他们。
27.en: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.

27.zh: 以色列人哪，到那日，耶和华必从大河，直到埃及小河，将你们一一地收集，如同人打树拾果一样。
27.en: It will happen in that day that the LORD will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.

27.zh: 当那日，必大发角声，在亚述地将要灭亡的，并在埃及地被赶散的，都要来，他们就在耶路撒冷圣山上敬拜耶和华。
27.en: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship the LORD in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

28.zh: 祸哉！以法莲的酒徒， 住在肥美谷的山上， 他们心里高傲， 以所夸的为冠冕， [犹如]将残之花。
28.en: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!

28.zh: 看哪，主有一大能大力者， 像一阵冰雹， 像毁灭的暴风， 像涨溢的大水， 他必用手将[冠冕]摔落于地。
28.en: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.

28.zh: 以法莲高傲的酒徒， 他的冠冕必被踏在脚下。
28.en: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.

28.zh: 那荣美将残之花， 就是在肥美谷山上的， 必像夏令以前初熟的无花果； 看见这果的就注意， 一到手中就吞吃了。
28.en: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer, which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.

28.zh: 到那日，万军之耶和华 必作他余剩之民的荣冠华冕，
28.en: In that day, the LORD of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,

28.zh: 也作了在位上行审判者公平之灵， 并城门口打退仇敌者的力量。
28.en: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

28.zh: 就是这[地的]人也因酒摇摇晃晃， 因浓酒东倒西歪。 祭司和先知因浓酒摇摇晃晃， 被酒所困， 因浓酒东倒西歪。 他们错解默示， 谬行审判。
28.en: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.

28.zh: 因为各席上满了呕吐的污秽， 无一处[干净]。
28.en: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.

28.zh: [讥诮先知的说]： 他要将知识指教谁呢？ 要使谁明白传言呢？ 是那刚断奶离怀的吗？
28.en: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?

28.zh: 他竟命上加命，令上加令， 律上加律，例上加例， 这里一点，那里一点。
28.en: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.

28.zh: [先知说]：不然，主要借异邦人的嘴唇 和外邦人的舌头对这百姓说话。
28.en: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language,

28.zh: 他曾对他们说： 你们要使疲乏人得安息， 这样才得安息，才得舒畅， 他们却不肯听。
28.en: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to the weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.

28.zh: 所以，耶和华向他们说的话是 命上加命，令上加令， 律上加律，例上加例， 这里一点，那里一点， 以致他们前行仰面跌倒， 而且跌碎，并陷入网罗被缠住。
28.en: Therefore the LORD’s word will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.

28.zh: 所以，你们这些亵慢的人， 就是辖管住在耶路撒冷这百姓的， 要听耶和华的话。
28.en: Therefore hear the LORD’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:

28.zh: 你们曾说： 我们与死亡立约， 与阴间结盟； 敌军[如水]涨漫经过的时候， 必不临到我们； 因我们以谎言为避所， 在虚假以下藏身。
28.en: “Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing scourge passes through, it won’t come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.’”

28.zh: 所以，主耶和华如此说： 看哪，我在锡安放一块石头作为根基， 是试验过的石头， 是稳固根基，宝贵的房角[石]； 信靠的人必不着急。
28.en: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.

28.zh: 我必以公平为准绳， 以公义为线铊。 冰雹必冲去谎言的避所； 大水必漫过藏身之处。
28.en: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.

28.zh: 你们与死亡所立的约必然废掉， 与阴间所结的盟必立不住。 敌军[如水]涨漫经过的时候， 你们必被他践踏；
28.en: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.

28.zh: 每逢经过必将你们掳去。 因为每早晨他必经过， 白昼黑夜都必如此。 明白传言的必受惊恐。
28.en: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”

28.zh: 原来，床榻短，使人不能舒身； 被窝窄，使人不能遮体。
28.en: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.

28.zh: 耶和华必兴起，像在毗拉心山； 他必发怒，像在基遍谷， 好做成他的工，就是非常的工； 成就他的事，就是奇异的事。
28.en: For the LORD will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and bring to pass his act, his extraordinary act.

28.zh: 现在你们不可亵慢， 恐怕捆你们的绑索更结实了； 因为我从主—万军之耶和华那里听见， 已经决定在全地上施行灭绝的事。
28.en: Now therefore don’t be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord, GOD of Armies, on the whole earth.

28.zh: 你们当侧耳听我的声音， 留心听我的言语。
28.en: Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!

28.zh: 那耕地为要撒种的， 岂是常常耕地呢？ 岂是常常开垦耙地呢？
28.en: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?

28.zh: 他拉平了地面， 岂不就撒种小茴香， 播种大茴香， 按行列种小麦， 在定处种大麦， 在田边种粗麦呢？
28.en: When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?

28.zh: 因为他的　神教导他务农相宜， 并且指教他。
28.en: For his God instructs him in right judgment and teaches him.

28.zh: 原来打小茴香，不用尖利的器具， 轧大茴香，也不用碌碡； 但用杖打小茴香， 用棍打大茴香。
28.en: For the dill isn’t threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.

28.zh: 做饼的[粮食]是用磨磨碎， 因它不必常打； 虽用碌碡和马打散， 却不磨它。
28.en: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses don’t grind it.

28.zh: 这也是出于万军之耶和华— 他的谋略奇妙； 他的智慧广大。
28.en: This also comes out from the LORD of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.

29.zh: 唉！亚利伊勒，亚利伊勒， 大卫安营的城， 任凭你年上加年， 节期照常周流。
29.en: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;

29.zh: 我终必使亚利伊勒困难； 她必悲伤哀号， 我却仍以她为亚利伊勒。
29.en: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth.

29.zh: 我必四围安营攻击你， 屯兵围困你， 筑垒攻击你。
29.en: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.

29.zh: 你必败落，从地中说话； 你的言语必微细出于尘埃。 你的声音必像那交鬼者的声音出于地； 你的言语低低微微出于尘埃。
29.en: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.

29.zh: 你仇敌的群众，却要像细尘； 强暴人的群众，也要像飞糠。 这事必顷刻之间忽然临到。
29.en: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.

29.zh: 万军之耶和华必用雷轰、地震、大声、旋风、暴风， 并吞灭的火焰，向她讨罪。
29.en: She will be visited by the LORD of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.

29.zh: 那时，攻击亚利伊勒列国的群众， 就是一切攻击亚利伊勒和她的保障， 并使她困难的， 必如梦景，如夜间的异象；
29.en: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.

29.zh: 又必像饥饿的人梦中吃饭， 醒了仍觉腹空； 或像口渴的人梦中喝水， 醒了仍觉发昏，心里想喝。 攻击锡安山列国的群众也必如此。
29.en: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.

29.zh: 你们等候惊奇吧！ 你们宴乐昏迷吧！ 他们醉了，却非因酒； 他们东倒西歪，却非因浓酒。
29.en: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

29.zh: 因为耶和华将沉睡的灵浇灌你们， 封闭你们的眼， 蒙盖你们的头。 你们的眼就是先知； 你们的头就是先见。
29.en: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.

29.zh: 所有的默示，你们看如封住的书卷，人将这书卷交给识字的，说：「请念吧！」他说：「我不能念，因为是封住了。」
29.en: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed;”

29.zh: 又将这书卷交给不识字的人，说：「请念吧！」他说：「我不识字。」
29.en: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t read.”

29.zh: 主说：因为这百姓亲近我， 用嘴唇尊敬我， 心却远离我； 他们敬畏我， 不过是领受人的吩咐。
29.en: The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, but they have removed their heart far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment of men which has been taught;

29.zh: 所以，我在这百姓中要行奇妙的事， 就是奇妙又奇妙的事。 他们智慧人的智慧必然消灭， 聪明人的聪明必然隐藏。
29.en: therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.”

29.zh: 祸哉！那些向耶和华深藏谋略的， 又在暗中行事，说： 谁看见我们呢？ 谁知道我们呢？
29.en: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from the LORD, and whose deeds are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?” and “Who knows us?”

29.zh: 你们把事颠倒了， 岂可看窑匠如泥吗？ 被制作的物岂可论制作物的说： 他没有制作我？ 或是被创造的物论造物的说： 他没有聪明？
29.en: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay, that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn’t make me;” or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding”?

29.zh: 黎巴嫩变为肥田， 肥田看如树林， 不是只有一点点时候吗？
29.en: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?

29.zh: 那时，聋子必听见这书上的话； 瞎子的眼必从迷蒙黑暗中得以看见。
29.en: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.

29.zh: 谦卑人必因耶和华增添欢喜； 人间贫穷的必因以色列的圣者快乐。
29.en: The humble also will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

29.zh: 因为，强暴人已归无有， 亵慢人已经灭绝， 一切找机会作孽的都被剪除。
29.en: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—

29.zh: 他们在争讼的事上定[无罪的]为有罪， 为城门口责备人的设下网罗， 用虚无的事屈枉义人。
29.en: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for one who reproves in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.

29.zh: 所以，救赎亚伯拉罕的耶和华 论雅各家如此说： 雅各必不再羞愧， 面容也不致变色。
29.en: Therefore the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, says concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.

29.zh: 但他看见他的众子， 就是我手的工作在他那里， 他们必尊我的名为圣， 必尊雅各的圣者为圣， 必敬畏以色列的　神。
29.en: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the middle of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.

29.zh: 心中迷糊的必得明白； 发怨言的必受训诲。
29.en: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”

30.zh: 耶和华说： 祸哉！这悖逆的儿女。 他们同谋，却不由于我， 结盟，却不由于我的灵， 以致罪上加罪；
30.en: “Woe to the rebellious children”, says the LORD, “who take counsel, but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin;

30.zh: 起身下埃及去，并没有求问我； 要靠法老的力量加添自己的力量， 并投在埃及的荫下。
30.en: who set out to go down into Egypt without asking for my advice, to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!

30.zh: 所以，法老的力量必作你们的羞辱； 投在埃及的荫下，要为你们的惭愧。
30.en: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

30.zh: 他们的首领已在琐安； 他们的使臣到了哈内斯。
30.en: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.

30.zh: 他们必因那不利于他们的民蒙羞。 那民并非帮助，也非利益， 只作羞耻凌辱。
30.en: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can’t profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”

30.zh: 论南方牲畜的默示： 他们把财物驮在驴驹的脊背上， 将宝物驮在骆驼的肉鞍上， 经过艰难困苦之地， 就是公狮、母狮、蝮蛇、火焰的飞龙之地， 往那不利于他们的民那里去。
30.en: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.

30.zh: 埃及的帮助是徒然无益的； 所以我称她为「坐而不动的拉哈伯」。
30.en: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.

30.zh: 现今你去， 在他们面前将这话刻在版上， 写在书上， 以便传留后世，直到永永远远。
30.en: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever.

30.zh: 因为他们是悖逆的百姓、说谎的儿女， 不肯听从耶和华训诲的儿女。
30.en: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear the LORD’s law;

30.zh: 他们对先见说：不要望见[不吉利的事]， 对先知说：不要向我们讲正直的话； 要向我们说柔和的话， 言虚幻的事。
30.en: who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.

30.zh: 你们要离弃正道，偏离直路， 不要在我们面前再提说以色列的圣者。
30.en: Get out of the way. Turn away from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”

30.zh: 所以，以色列的圣者如此说： 因为你们藐视这[训诲的]话， 倚赖欺压和乖僻，以此为可靠的，
30.en: Therefore the Holy One of Israel says, “Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rely on it,

30.zh: 故此，这罪孽在你们身上， 好像将要破裂凸出来的高墙， 顷刻之间忽然坍塌；
30.en: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.

30.zh: 要被打碎，好像把窑匠的瓦器打碎， 毫不顾惜， 甚至碎块中找不到一片可用以从炉内取火， 从池中舀水。
30.en: He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken pieces a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.”

30.zh: 主耶和华—以色列的圣者曾如此说： 你们得救在乎归回安息； 你们得力在乎平静安稳； 你们竟自不肯。
30.en: For thus said the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,

30.zh: 你们却说：不然，我们要骑马奔走。 所以你们必然奔走； 又说：我们要骑飞快的[牲口]。 所以追赶你们的，也必飞快。
30.en: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore those who pursue you will be swift.

30.zh: 一人叱喝，必令千人[逃跑]； 五人叱喝，你们都必逃跑； 以致剩下的，好像山顶的旗杆， 冈上的大旗。
30.en: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.

30.zh: 耶和华必然等候，要施恩给你们； 必然兴起，好怜悯你们。 因为耶和华是公平的　神； 凡等候他的都是有福的！
30.en: Therefore the LORD will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for the LORD is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.

30.zh: 百姓必在锡安、在耶路撒冷居住；你不再哭泣。主必因你哀求的声音施恩给你；他听见的时候就必应允你。
30.en: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.

30.zh: 主虽然以艰难给你当饼，以困苦给你当水，你的教师却不再隐藏；你眼必看见你的教师。
30.en: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any more, but your eyes will see your teachers;

30.zh: 你或向左或向右，你必听见后边有声音说：「这是正路，要行在其间。」
30.en: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

30.zh: 你雕刻偶像所包的银子和铸造偶像所镀的金子，你要玷污，要抛弃，好像污秽之物，对偶像说：「去吧！」
30.en: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”

30.zh: 你将种子撒在地里，主必降雨在其上，并使地所出的粮肥美丰盛。到那时，你的牲畜必在宽阔的草场吃草。
30.en: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.

30.zh: 耕地的牛和驴驹必吃加盐的料；这料是用木杴和杈子扬净的。
30.en: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory feed, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.

30.zh: 在大行杀戮的日子，高台倒塌的时候，各高山冈陵必有川流河涌。
30.en: There will be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

30.zh: 当耶和华缠裹他百姓的损处，医治他民鞭伤的日子，月光必像日光，日光必加七倍，像七日的光一样。
30.en: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.

30.zh: 看哪，耶和华的名从远方来， 怒气烧起，密烟上腾。 他的嘴唇满有忿恨； 他的舌头像吞灭的火。
30.en: Behold, the LORD’s name comes from far away, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke. His lips are full of indignation. His tongue is as a devouring fire.

30.zh: 他的气如涨溢的河水，直涨到颈项， 要用毁灭的筛箩筛净列国， 并且在众民的口中必有使人错行的嚼环。
30.en: His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction. A bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples.

30.zh: 你们必唱歌，像守圣节的夜间一样，并且心中喜乐，像人吹笛，上耶和华的山，到以色列的磐石那里。
30.en: You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept, and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute to come to the LORD’s mountain, to Israel’s Rock.

30.zh: 耶和华必使人听他威严的声音，又显他降罚的膀臂和他怒中的忿恨，并吞灭的火焰与霹雷、暴风、冰雹。
30.en: The LORD will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones.

30.zh: 亚述人必因耶和华的声音惊惶；耶和华必用杖击打他。
30.en: For through the LORD’s voice the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.

30.zh: 耶和华必将命定的杖加在他身上；每打一下，人必击鼓弹琴。打杖的时候，耶和华必抡起[手]来，与他交战。
30.en: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which the LORD will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons.

30.zh: 原来陀斐特又深又宽，早已为王预备好了；其中堆的是火与许多木柴。耶和华的气如一股硫磺火使他着起来。
30.en: For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, it is prepared for the king. He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood. The LORD’s breath, like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.

31.zh: 祸哉！那些下埃及求帮助的， 是因仗赖马匹，倚靠甚多的车辆， 并倚靠强壮的马兵， 却不仰望以色列的圣者， 也不求问耶和华。
31.en: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very strong, but they don’t look to the Holy One of Israel, and they don’t seek the LORD!

31.zh: 其实，耶和华有智慧； 他必降灾祸， 并不反悔自己的话， 却要兴起攻击那作恶之家， 又攻击那作孽帮助人的。
31.en: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of those who work iniquity.

31.zh: 埃及人不过是人，并不是　神； 他们的马不过是血肉，并不是灵。 耶和华一伸手，那帮助人的必绊跌， 那受帮助的也必跌倒，都一同灭亡。
31.en: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD stretches out his hand, both he who helps shall stumble, and he who is helped shall fall, and they all shall be consumed together.

31.zh: 耶和华对我如此说： 狮子和少壮狮子护食咆哮， 就是喊许多牧人来攻击它， 它总不因他们的声音惊惶， 也不因他们的喧哗缩伏。 如此，万军之耶和华 也必降临在锡安山冈上争战。
31.en: For the LORD says to me, “As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called together against him, will not be dismayed at their voice, nor abase himself for their noise, so the LORD of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its heights.

31.zh: 雀鸟怎样搧翅[覆雏]， 万军之耶和华也要照样保护耶路撒冷。 他必保护拯救， 要越门保守。
31.en: As birds hovering, so the LORD of Armies will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and deliver it. He will pass over and preserve it.”

31.zh: 以色列人哪，你们深深地悖逆耶和华，现今要归向他。
31.en: Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel.

31.zh: 到那日，各人必将他金偶像银偶像，就是亲手所造、陷自己在罪中的，都抛弃了。
31.en: For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold—sin which your own hands have made for you.

31.zh: 亚述人必倒在刀下，并非人的刀； 有刀要将他吞灭，并非人的刀。 他必逃避这刀； 他的少年人必成为服苦的。
31.en: “The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; and the sword, not of mankind, shall devour him. He will flee from the sword, and his young men will become subject to forced labor.

31.zh: 他的磐石必因惊吓挪去； 他的首领必因大旗惊惶。 这是那有火在锡安、 有炉在耶路撒冷的耶和华说的。
31.en: His rock will pass away by reason of terror, and his princes will be afraid of the banner,” says the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

32.zh: 看哪，必有一王凭公义行政； 必有首领借公平掌权。
32.en: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.

32.zh: 必有一人像避风所和避暴雨的隐密处， 又像河流在干旱之地， 像大磐石的影子在疲乏之地。
32.en: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land.

32.zh: 那能看的人，眼不再昏迷； 能听的人，耳必得听闻。
32.en: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen.

32.zh: 冒失人的心必明白知识； 结巴人的舌必说话通快。
32.en: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.

32.zh: 愚顽人不再称为高明； 吝啬人不再称为大方。
32.en: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected.

32.zh: 因为愚顽人必说愚顽话， 心里想作罪孽， 惯行亵渎的事， 说错谬的话攻击耶和华， 使饥饿的人无食可吃， 使口渴的人无水可喝。
32.en: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

32.zh: 吝啬人所用的法子是恶的； 他图谋恶计， 用谎言毁灭谦卑人； 穷乏人讲公理的时候， 他也是这样行。
32.en: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked plans to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.

32.zh: 高明人却谋高明事， 在高明事上也必永存。
32.en: But the noble devises noble things, and he will continue in noble things.

32.zh: 安逸的妇女啊，起来听我的声音！ 无虑的女子啊，侧耳听我的言语！
32.en: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!

32.zh: 无虑的女子啊，再过一年多，必受骚扰； 因为无葡萄可摘， 无果子可收。
32.en: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage will fail. The harvest won’t come.

32.zh: 安逸的妇女啊，要战兢； 无虑的女子啊，要受骚扰。 脱去衣服，赤着身体， 腰束[麻布]。
32.en: Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist.

32.zh: 她们必为美好的田地 和多结果的葡萄树，捶胸哀哭。
32.en: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

32.zh: 荆棘蒺藜必长在我百姓的地上， 又长在欢乐的城中和一切快乐的房屋上。
32.en: Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.

32.zh: 因为宫殿必被撇下， 多民的城必被离弃； 山冈望楼永为洞穴， 作野驴所喜乐的， 为羊群的草场。
32.en: For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks,

32.zh: 等到[圣]灵从上浇灌我们， 旷野就变为肥田， 肥田看如树林。
32.en: until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is considered a forest.

32.zh: 那时，公平要居在旷野； 公义要居在肥田。
32.en: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.

32.zh: 公义的果效必是平安； 公义的效验必是平稳，直到永远。
32.en: The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.

32.zh: 我的百姓必住在平安的居所， 安稳的住处，平静的安歇所。
32.en: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places,

32.zh: （但要降冰雹打倒树林； 城必全然拆平。）
32.en: though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.

32.zh: 你们在各水边撒种、 牧放牛驴的有福了！
32.en: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.

33.zh: 祸哉！你这毁灭人的， 自己倒不被毁灭； 行事诡诈的， 人倒不以诡诈待你。 你毁灭罢休了， 自己必被毁灭； 你行完了诡诈， 人必以诡诈待你。
33.en: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have finished betrayal, you will be betrayed.

33.zh: 耶和华啊，求你施恩于我们； 我们等候你。 求你每早晨作我们的膀臂， 遭难的时候为我们的拯救。
33.en: LORD, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

33.zh: 喧嚷的响声一发，众民奔逃； 你一兴起，列国四散。
33.en: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.

33.zh: 你们所掳的必被敛尽， 好像蚂蚱吃尽[禾稼]。 人要蹦在其上，好像蝗虫一样。
33.en: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.

33.zh: 耶和华被尊崇，因他居在高处； 他以公平公义充满锡安。
33.en: The LORD is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

33.zh: 你一生一世必得安稳— 有丰盛的救恩， 并智慧和知识； 你以敬畏耶和华为至宝。
33.en: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is your treasure.

33.zh: 看哪，他们的豪杰在外头哀号； 求和的使臣痛痛哭泣。
33.en: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.

33.zh: 大路荒凉，行人止息； [敌人]背约， 藐视城邑， 不顾人民。
33.en: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.

33.zh: 地上悲哀衰残； 黎巴嫩羞愧枯干； 沙 像旷野； 巴珊和迦密[的树林]凋残。
33.en: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.

33.zh: 耶和华说： 现在我要起来； 我要兴起； 我要勃然而兴。
33.en: “Now I will arise,” says the LORD. “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.

33.zh: 你们要怀的是糠秕， 要生的是碎秸； 你们的气就是吞灭自己的火。
33.en: You will conceive chaff. You will give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.

33.zh: 列邦必像已烧的石灰， 像已割的荆棘在火中焚烧。
33.en: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.

33.zh: 你们远方的人当听我所行的； 你们近处的人当承认我的大能。
33.en: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”

33.zh: 锡安中的罪人都惧怕； 不敬虔的人被战兢抓住。 我们中间谁能与吞灭的火同住？ 我们中间谁能与永火同住呢？
33.en: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?

33.zh: 行事公义、说话正直、 憎恶欺压的财利、 摆手不受贿赂、 塞耳不听流血的话， 闭眼不看邪恶事的，
33.en: He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—

33.zh: 他必居高处； 他的保障是磐石的坚垒； 他的粮必不缺乏； 他的水必不断绝。
33.en: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.

33.zh: 你的眼必见王的荣美， 必见辽阔之地。
33.en: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.

33.zh: 你的心必思想那惊吓的事， [自问说]：记数目的在哪里呢？ 平[贡银]的在哪里呢？ 数戍楼的在哪里呢？
33.en: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?

33.zh: 你必不见那强暴的民， 就是说话深奥，你不能明白， 言语呢喃，你不能懂得的。
33.en: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.

33.zh: 你要看锡安—我们守圣节的城！ 你的眼必见耶路撒冷为安静的居所， 为不挪移的帐幕， 橛子永不拔出， 绳索一根也不折断。
33.en: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.

33.zh: 在那里，耶和华必显威严与我们同在， 当作江河宽阔之地； 其中必没有荡桨摇橹的船来往， 也没有威武的船经过。
33.en: But there the LORD will be with us in majesty, a place of wide rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.

33.zh: 因为，耶和华是审判我们的； 耶和华是给我们设律法的； 耶和华是我们的王； 他必拯救我们。
33.en: For the LORD is our judge. The LORD is our lawgiver. The LORD is our king. He will save us.

33.zh: 你的绳索松开： 不能栽稳桅杆， 也不能扬起篷来。 那时许多掳来的物被分了； 瘸腿的把掠物夺去了。
33.en: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.

33.zh: 城内居民必不说：我病了； 其中居住的百姓，罪孽都赦免了。
33.en: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.

34.zh: 列国啊，要近前来听！ 众民哪，要侧耳而听！ 地和其上所充满的， 世界和其中一切所出的都应当听！
34.en: Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear, the world, and everything that comes from it.

34.zh: 因为耶和华向万国发忿恨， 向他们的全军发烈怒， 将他们灭尽，交出他们受杀戮。
34.en: For the LORD is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has given them over for slaughter.

34.zh: 被杀的必然抛弃， 尸首臭气上腾； 诸山被他们的血融化。
34.en: Their slain will also be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies will come up. The mountains will melt in their blood.

34.zh: 天上的万象都要消没； 天被卷起，好像书卷。 其上的万象要残败， 像葡萄树的叶子残败， 又像无花果树的[叶子]残败一样。
34.en: All of the army of the sky will be dissolved. The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade away, as a leaf fades from off a vine or a fig tree.

34.zh: 因为我的刀在天上已经喝足； 这刀必临到以东和我所咒诅的民， 要施行审判。
34.en: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for judgment.

34.zh: 耶和华的刀满了血， 用脂油和羊羔、公山羊的血， 并公绵羊腰子的脂油滋润的； 因为耶和华在波斯拉有献祭的事， 在以东地大行杀戮。
34.en: The LORD’s sword is filled with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

34.zh: 野牛、牛犊，和公牛要一同下来。 他们的地喝醉了血； 他们的尘土因脂油肥润。
34.en: The wild oxen will come down with them, and the young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will be drunken with blood, and their dust made greasy with fat.

34.zh: 因耶和华有报仇之日， 为锡安的争辩有报应之年。
34.en: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

34.zh: 以东的河水要变为石油， 尘埃要变为硫磺； 地土成为烧着的石油，
34.en: Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, and its land will become burning pitch.

34.zh: 昼夜总不熄灭， 烟气永远上腾， 必世世代代成为荒废， 永永远远无人经过。
34.en: It won’t be quenched night or day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No one will pass through it forever and ever.

34.zh: 鹈鹕、箭猪却要得为业； 猫头鹰、乌鸦要住在其间。 耶和华必将空虚的准绳， 混沌的线铊，拉在其上。
34.en: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.

34.zh: 以东人要召贵胄来治国； 那里却无一个， 首领也都归于无有。
34.en: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.

34.zh: 以东的宫殿要长荆棘； 保障要长蒺藜和刺草； 要作野狗的住处， 鸵鸟的居所。
34.en: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.

34.zh: 旷野的走兽要和豺狼相遇； 野山羊要与伴偶对叫。 夜间的怪物必在那里栖身， 自找安歇之处。
34.en: The wild animals of the desert will meet with the wolves, and the wild goat will cry to his fellow. Yes, the night creature shall settle there, and shall find herself a place of rest.

34.zh: 箭蛇要在那里做窝， 下蛋，抱蛋，生子， 聚子在其影下； 鹞鹰各与伴偶聚集在那里。
34.en: The arrow snake will make her nest there, and lay, hatch, and gather under her shade. Yes, the kites will be gathered there, every one with her mate.

34.zh: 你们要查考宣读耶和华的书。 这都无一缺少， 无一没有伴偶； 因为我的口已经吩咐， 他的灵将它们聚集。
34.en: Search in the book of the LORD, and read: not one of these will be missing. None will lack her mate. For my mouth has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.

34.zh: 他也为它们拈阄， 又亲手用准绳给它们分地； 它们必永得为业， 世世代代住在其间。
34.en: He has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever. From generation to generation they will dwell in it.

35.zh: 旷野和干旱之地必然欢喜； 沙漠也必快乐； 又像玫瑰开花，
35.en: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

35.zh: 必开花繁盛， 乐上加乐，而且欢呼。 黎巴嫩的荣耀， 并迦密与沙 的华美，必赐给它。 人必看见耶和华的荣耀， 我们　神的华美。
35.en: It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory will be given to it, the excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the LORD’s glory, the excellence of our God.

35.zh: 你们要使软弱的手坚壮， 无力的膝稳固。
35.en: Strengthen the weak hands, and make the feeble knees firm.

35.zh: 对胆怯的人说： 你们要刚强，不要惧怕。 看哪，你们的　神必来报仇， 必来施行极大的报应； 他必来拯救你们。
35.en: Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong! Don’t be afraid! Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s retribution. He will come and save you.

35.zh: 那时，瞎子的眼必睁开； 聋子的耳必开通。
35.en: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.

35.zh: 那时，瘸子必跳跃像鹿； 哑巴的舌头必能歌唱。 在旷野必有水发出； 在沙漠必有河涌流。
35.en: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.

35.zh: 发光的沙要变为水池； 干渴之地要变为泉源。 在野狗躺卧之处， 必有青草、芦苇，和蒲草。
35.en: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay.

35.zh: 在那里必有一条大道， 称为圣路。 污秽人不得经过， 必专为赎民行走； 行路的人虽愚昧， 也不致失迷。
35.en: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools shall not go there.

35.zh: 在那里必没有狮子， 猛兽也不登这路； 在那里都遇不见， 只有赎民在那里行走。
35.en: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.

35.zh: 并且耶和华救赎的民必归回， 歌唱来到锡安； 永乐必归到他们的头上； 他们必得着欢喜快乐， 忧愁叹息尽都逃避。
35.en: Then the LORD’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”

36.zh: 希西家王十四年，亚述王西拿基立上来攻击犹大的一切坚固城，将城攻取。
36.en: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

36.zh: 亚述王从拉吉差遣拉伯沙基率领大军往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那里去。他就站在上池的水沟旁，在漂布地的大路上。
36.en: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a large army. He stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool in the fuller’s field highway.

36.zh: 于是希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬，并书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚，出来见拉伯沙基。
36.en: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder came out to him.

36.zh: 拉伯沙基对他们说：「你们去告诉希西家说，亚述大王如此说：『你所倚靠的有什么可仗赖的呢？
36.en: Rabshakeh said to them, “Now tell Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?

36.zh: 你说，有打仗的计谋和能力，我看不过是虚话。你到底倚靠谁才背叛我呢？
36.en: I say that your counsel and strength for the war are only vain words. Now in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

36.zh: 看哪，你所倚靠的埃及是那压伤的苇杖，人若靠这杖，就必刺透他的手。埃及王法老向一切倚靠他的人也是这样。
36.en: Behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt, which if a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.

36.zh: 你若对我说：我们倚靠耶和华—我们的　神。希西家岂不是将　神的邱坛和祭坛废去，且对犹大和耶路撒冷的人说：你们当在这坛前敬拜吗？
36.en: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar’?”

36.zh: 现在你把当头给我主亚述王，我给你二千匹马，看你这一面骑马的人够不够。
36.en: Now therefore, please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

36.zh: 若不然，怎能打败我主臣仆中最小的军长呢？你竟倚靠埃及的战车马兵吗？
36.en: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

36.zh: 现在我上来攻击毁灭这地，岂没有耶和华的意思吗？耶和华吩咐我说，你上去攻击毁灭这地吧！』」
36.en: Have I come up now without the LORD against this land to destroy it? The LORD said to me, “Go up against this land, and destroy it.”’”

36.zh: 以利亚敬、舍伯那、约亚对拉伯沙基说：「求你用亚兰言语和仆人说话，因为我们懂得；不要用犹大言语和我们说话，达到城上百姓的耳中。」
36.en: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it. Don’t speak to us in the Jews’ language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

36.zh: 拉伯沙基说：「我主差遣我来，岂是单对你和你的主说这些话吗？不也是对这些坐在城上、要与你们一同吃自己粪喝自己尿的人说吗？」
36.en: But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you, to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”

36.zh: 于是，拉伯沙基站着，用犹大言语大声喊着说：「你们当听亚述大王的话。
36.en: Then Rabshakeh stood, and called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

36.zh: 王如此说：『你们不要被希西家欺哄了，因他不能拯救你们。
36.en: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you.

36.zh: 也不要听希西家使你们倚靠耶和华说：耶和华必要拯救我们，这城必不交在亚述王的手中。
36.en: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, “The LORD will surely deliver us. This city won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”’

36.zh: 不要听希西家的话，因亚述王如此说：你们要与我和好。出来投降我，各人就可以吃自己葡萄树和无花果树的果子，喝自己井里的水。
36.en: Don’t listen to Hezekiah, for the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and each of you eat from his vine, and each one from his fig tree, and each one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;

36.zh: 等我来领你们到一个地方，与你们本地一样，就是有五谷和新酒之地，有粮食和葡萄园之地。
36.en: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

36.zh: 你们要谨防，恐怕希西家劝导你们说：耶和华必拯救我们。列国的神有哪一个救他本国脱离亚述王的手呢？
36.en: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, “The LORD will deliver us.” Have any of the gods of the nations delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?

36.zh: 哈马和亚珥拔的神在哪里呢？西法瓦音的神在哪里呢？他们曾救撒马利亚脱离我的手吗？
36.en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?

36.zh: 这些国的神有谁曾救自己的国脱离我的手呢？难道耶和华能救耶路撒冷脱离我的手吗？』」
36.en: Who are they among all the gods of these countries that have delivered their country out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”

36.zh: 百姓静默不言，并不回答一句，因为王曾吩咐说：「不要回答他。」
36.en: But they remained silent, and said nothing in reply, for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”

36.zh: 当下希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并亚萨的儿子史官约亚，都撕裂衣服，来到希西家那里，将拉伯沙基的话告诉了他。
36.en: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

37.zh: 希西家王听见就撕裂衣服，披上麻布，进了耶和华的殿，
37.en: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the LORD’s house.

37.zh: 使家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并祭司中的长老，都披上麻布，去见亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚，
37.en: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

37.zh: 对他说：「希西家如此说：『今日是急难、责罚、凌辱的日子，就如妇人将要生产婴孩，却没有力量生产。
37.en: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to give birth.

37.zh: 或者耶和华—你的　神听见拉伯沙基的话，就是他主人亚述王打发他来辱骂永生　神的话；耶和华—你的　神听见这话就发斥责。故此，求你为余剩的民扬声祷告。』」
37.en: It may be the LORD your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”

37.zh: 希西家王的臣仆就去见以赛亚。
37.en: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

37.zh: 以赛亚对他们说：「要这样对你们的主人说，耶和华如此说：『你听见亚述王的仆人亵渎我的话，不要惧怕。
37.en: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master, ‘The LORD says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

37.zh: 我必惊动他的心；他要听见风声就归回本地，我必使他在那里倒在刀下。』」
37.en: Behold, I will put a spirit in him and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”

37.zh: 拉伯沙基回去，正遇见亚述王攻打立拿；原来他早听见亚述王拔营离开拉吉。
37.en: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he heard that he had departed from Lachish.

37.zh: 亚述王听见人论古实王特哈加说：「他出来要与你争战。」亚述王一听见，就打发使者去见希西家，吩咐他们说：
37.en: He heard news concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “He has come out to fight against you.” When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

37.zh: 「你们对犹大王希西家如此说：『不要听你所倚靠的　神欺哄你说：耶路撒冷必不交在亚述王的手中。
37.en: “Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, “Jerusalem won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

37.zh: 你总听说亚述诸王向列国所行的乃是尽行灭绝，难道你还能得救吗？
37.en: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Shall you be delivered?

37.zh: 我列祖所毁灭的，就是歌散、哈兰、利色，和属提·拉撒的伊甸人；这些国的神何曾拯救这些国呢？
37.en: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?

37.zh: 哈马的王，亚珥拔的王，西法瓦音城的王，希拿和以瓦的王，都在哪里呢？』」
37.en: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”

37.zh: 希西家从使者手里接过书信来，看完了，就上耶和华的殿，将书信在耶和华面前展开。
37.en: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to the LORD’s house, and spread it before the LORD.

37.zh: 希西家向耶和华祷告说：
37.en: Hezekiah prayed to the LORD, saying,

37.zh: 「坐在二基路伯上万军之耶和华—以色列的　神啊，你—惟有你是天下万国的　神，你曾创造天地。
37.en: “LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, who is enthroned among the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

37.zh: 耶和华啊，求你侧耳而听；耶和华啊，求你睁眼而看，要听西拿基立的一切话，他是打发使者来辱骂永生　神的。
37.en: Turn your ear, LORD, and hear. Open your eyes, LORD, and behold. Hear all of the words of Sennacherib, who has sent to defy the living God.

37.zh: 耶和华啊，亚述诸王果然使列国和列国之地变为荒凉，
37.en: Truly, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land,

37.zh: 将列国的神像都扔在火里；因为他本不是神，乃是人手所造的，是木头、石头的，所以灭绝他。
37.en: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.

37.zh: 耶和华—我们的　神啊，现在求你救我们脱离亚述王的手，使天下万国都知道惟有你是耶和华。」
37.en: Now therefore, LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are the LORD, even you only.”

37.zh: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚就打发人去见希西家，说：「耶和华—以色列的　神如此说，你既然求我攻击亚述王西拿基立，
37.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “The LORD, the God of Israel says, ‘Because you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,

37.zh: 所以耶和华论他这样说： 锡安的处女藐视你，嗤笑你； 耶路撒冷的女子向你摇头。
37.en: this is the word which the LORD has spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

37.zh: 你辱骂谁，亵渎谁？ 扬起声来，高举眼目攻击谁呢？ 乃是攻击以色列的圣者。
37.en: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.

37.zh: 你借你的臣仆辱骂主说： 我率领许多战车上山顶， 到黎巴嫩极深之处； 我要砍伐其中高大的香柏树 和佳美的松树。 我必上极高之处， 进入肥田的树林。
37.en: By your servants, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon. I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees. I will enter into its farthest height, the forest of its fruitful field.

37.zh: 我已经挖井喝水； 我必用脚掌踏干埃及的一切河。
37.en: I have dug and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt.”

37.zh: [耶和华说]：你岂没有听见 我早先所做的、古时所立的吗？ 现在借你使坚固城荒废，变为乱堆。
37.en: “‘Have you not heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it in ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to destroy fortified cities, turning them into ruinous heaps.

37.zh: 所以其中的居民力量甚小， 惊惶羞愧。 他们像野草，像青菜， 如房顶上的草， 又如田间未长成的[禾稼]。
37.en: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field, and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops, and like a field before its crop has grown.

37.zh: 你坐下，你出去，你进来， 你向我发烈怒，我都知道。
37.en: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.

37.zh: 因你向我发烈怒， 又因你狂傲[的话]达到我耳中， 我就要用钩子钩上你的鼻子， 把嚼环放在你口里， 使你从原路转回去。
37.en: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.

37.zh: 「以色列人哪，我赐你们一个证据：你们今年要吃自生的，明年也要吃自长的，至于后年，你们要耕种收割，栽植葡萄园，吃其中的果子。
37.en: “‘This shall be the sign to you: You will eat this year that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from it; and in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.

37.zh: 犹大家所逃脱余剩的，仍要往下扎根，向上结果。
37.en: The remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

37.zh: 必有余剩的民从耶路撒冷而出；必有逃脱的人从锡安山而来。万军之耶和华的热心必成就这事。
37.en: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and survivors will escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.’

37.zh: 「所以耶和华论亚述王如此说：他必不得来到这城，也不在这里射箭，不得拿盾牌到城前，也不筑垒攻城。
37.en: “Therefore the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither will he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.

37.zh: 他从哪条路来，必从那条路回去，必不得来到这城。这是耶和华说的。
37.en: He will return the way that he came, and he won’t come to this city,’ says the LORD.

37.zh: 因我为自己的缘故，又为我仆人大卫的缘故，必保护拯救这城。」
37.en: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.’”

37.zh: 耶和华的使者出去，在亚述营中杀了十八万五千人。清早有人起来一看，都是死尸了。
37.en: Then the LORD’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.

37.zh: 亚述王西拿基立就拔营回去，住在尼尼微。
37.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went away, returned to Nineveh, and stayed there.

37.zh: 一日在他的神—尼斯洛庙里叩拜，他儿子亚得米勒和沙利色用刀杀了他，就逃到亚拉腊地。他儿子以撒哈顿接续他作王。
37.en: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.

38.zh: 那时希西家病得要死，亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚去见他，对他说：「耶和华如此说：你当留遗命与你的家，因为你必死不能活了。」
38.en: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.’”

38.zh: 希西家就转脸朝墙，祷告耶和华说：
38.en: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD,

38.zh: 「耶和华啊，求你记念我在你面前怎样存完全的心，按诚实行事，又做你眼中所看为善的。」希西家就痛哭了。
38.en: and said, “Remember now, LORD, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” Then Hezekiah wept bitterly.

38.zh: 耶和华的话临到以赛亚说：
38.en: Then the LORD’s word came to Isaiah, saying,

38.zh: 「你去告诉希西家说，耶和华—你祖大卫的　神如此说：我听见了你的祷告，看见了你的眼泪。我必加增你十五年的寿数；
38.en: “Go, and tell Hezekiah, ‘The LORD, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.

38.zh: 并且我要救你和这城脱离亚述王的手，也要保护这城。
38.en: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city.

38.zh: 「我—耶和华必成就我所说的。我先给你一个兆头，
38.en: This shall be the sign to you from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he has spoken.

38.zh: 就是叫亚哈斯的日晷，向前进的日影往后退十度。」于是，前进的日影果然在日晷上往后退了十度。
38.en: Behold, I will cause the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps.”’” So the sun returned ten steps on the sundial on which it had gone down.

38.zh: 犹大王希西家患病已经痊愈，就作诗说：
38.en: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and had recovered of his sickness:

38.zh: 我说：正在我中年之日 必进入阴间的门； 我余剩的年岁不得享受。
38.en: I said, “In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol. I am deprived of the residue of my years.”

38.zh: 我说：我必不得见耶和华， 就是在活人之地不见耶和华； 我与世上的居民不再见面。
38.en: I said, “I won’t see the LORD, the LORD in the land of the living. I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

38.zh: 我的住处被迁去离开我， 好像牧人的帐棚一样； 我将性命卷起， 像织布的卷布一样。 耶和华必将我从机头剪断， 从早到晚，他要使我完结。
38.en: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

38.zh: 我使自己安静直到天亮； 他像狮子折断我一切的骨头， 从早到晚，他要使我完结。
38.en: I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

38.zh: 我像燕子呢喃， 像白鹤鸣叫， 又像鸽子哀鸣； 我因仰观，眼睛困倦。 耶和华啊，我受欺压， 求你为我作保。
38.en: I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my security.”

38.zh: 我可说什么呢？ 他应许我的，也给我成就了。 我因心里的苦楚， 在一生的年日必悄悄而行。
38.en: What will I say? He has both spoken to me, and himself has done it. I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul.

38.zh: 主啊，人得存活乃在乎此。 我灵存活也全在此。 所以求你使我痊愈，仍然存活。
38.en: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them. You restore me, and cause me to live.

38.zh: 看哪，我受大苦，本为使我得平安； 你因爱我的灵魂便救我脱离败坏的坑， 因为你将我一切的罪扔在你的背后。
38.en: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.

38.zh: 原来，阴间不能称谢你， 死亡不能颂扬你； 下坑的人不能盼望你的诚实。
38.en: For Sheol can’t praise you. Death can’t celebrate you. Those who go down into the pit can’t hope for your truth.

38.zh: 只有活人，活人必称谢你， 像我今日称谢你一样。 为父的，必使儿女知道你的诚实。
38.en: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.

38.zh: 耶和华[肯]救我， 所以，我们要一生一世 在耶和华殿中 用丝弦的乐器唱我的诗歌。
38.en: The LORD will save me. Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in the LORD’s house.

38.zh: 以赛亚说：「当取一块无花果饼来，贴在疮上，王必痊愈。」
38.en: Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”

38.zh: 希西家问说：「我能上耶和华的殿，有什么兆头呢？」
38.en: Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to the LORD’s house?”

39.zh: 那时，巴比伦王巴拉但的儿子米罗达·巴拉但听见希西家病而痊愈，就送书信和礼物给他。
39.en: At that time, Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been sick, and had recovered.

39.zh: 希西家喜欢见使者，就把自己宝库的金子、银子、香料、贵重的膏油，和他武库的一切军器，并所有的财宝都给他们看；他家中和全国之内，希西家没有一样不给他们看的。
39.en: Hezekiah was pleased with them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and all the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.

39.zh: 于是先知以赛亚来见希西家王，问他说：「这些人说什么？他们从哪里来见你？」希西家说：「他们从远方的巴比伦来见我。」
39.en: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and asked him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a country far from me, even from Babylon.”

39.zh: 以赛亚说：「他们在你家里看见了什么？」希西家说：「凡我家中所有的，他们都看见了；我财宝中没有一样不给他们看的。」
39.en: Then he asked, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”

39.zh: 以赛亚对希西家说：「你要听万军之耶和华的话：
39.en: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the LORD of Armies:

39.zh: 日子必到，凡你家里所有的，并你列祖积蓄到如今的，都要被掳到巴比伦去，不留下一样；这是耶和华说的。
39.en: ‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up until today, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says the LORD.

39.zh: 并且从你本身所生的众子，其中必有被掳去、在巴比伦王宫里当太监的。」
39.en: ‘They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of Babylon’s palace.’”

39.zh: 希西家对以赛亚说：「你所说耶和华的话甚好，因为在我的年日中必有太平和稳固的景况。」
39.en: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The LORD’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “For there will be peace and truth in my days.”

40.zh: 你们的　神说： 你们要安慰，安慰我的百姓。
40.en: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.

40.zh: 要对耶路撒冷说安慰的话， 又向她宣告[说]， 她争战的日子已满了； 她的罪孽赦免了； 她为自己的一切罪， 从耶和华手中加倍受罚。
40.en: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of the LORD’s hand double for all her sins.”

40.zh: 有人声喊着说： 在旷野预备耶和华的路， 在沙漠地修平我们　神的道。
40.en: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of the LORD in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.

40.zh: 一切山洼都要填满， 大小山冈都要削平； 高高低低的要改为平坦， 崎崎岖岖的必成为平原。
40.en: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.

40.zh: 耶和华的荣耀必然显现； 凡有血气的必一同看见； 因为这是耶和华亲口说的。
40.en: The LORD’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of the LORD has spoken it.”

40.zh: 有人声说：你喊叫吧！ 有一个说：我喊叫什么呢？ [说]：凡有血气的尽都如草； 他的美容都像野地的花。
40.en: The voice of one saying, “Cry out!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.

40.zh: 草必枯干，花必凋残， 因为耶和华的气吹在其上； 百姓诚然是草。
40.en: The grass withers, the flower fades, because the LORD’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.

40.zh: 草必枯干，花必凋残， 惟有我们　神的话必永远立定。
40.en: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”

40.zh: 报好信息给锡安的啊， 你要登高山； 报好信息给耶路撒冷的啊， 你要极力扬声。 扬声不要惧怕， 对犹大的城邑说： 看哪，你们的　神！
40.en: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength! Lift it up! Don’t be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”

40.zh: 主耶和华必像大能者临到； 他的膀臂必为他掌权。 他的赏赐在他那里； 他的报应在他面前。
40.en: Behold, the Lord GOD will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.

40.zh: 他必像牧人牧养自己的羊群， 用膀臂聚集羊羔抱在怀中， 慢慢引导那乳养小羊的。
40.en: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.

40.zh: 谁曾用手心量诸水， 用手虎口量苍天， 用升斗盛大地的尘土， 用秤称山岭， 用天平平冈陵呢？
40.en: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

40.zh: 谁曾测度耶和华的心， 或作他的谋士指教他呢？
40.en: Who has directed the LORD’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?

40.zh: 他与谁商议，谁教导他， 谁将公平的路指示他， 又将知识教训他， 将通达的道指教他呢？
40.en: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?

40.zh: 看哪，万民都像水桶的一滴， 又算如天平上的微尘； 他举起众海岛，好像极微之物。
40.en: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.

40.zh: 黎巴嫩[的树林]不够当柴烧； 其中的走兽也不够作燔祭。
40.en: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.

40.zh: 万民在他面前好像虚无， 被他看为不及虚无，乃为虚空。
40.en: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.

40.zh: 你们究竟将谁比　神， 用什么形象与　神比较呢？
40.en: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?

40.zh: 偶像是匠人铸造， 银匠用金包裹， [为它]铸造银链。
40.en: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.

40.zh: 穷乏献不起[这样]供物的， 就拣选不能朽坏的树木， 为自己寻找巧匠， 立起不能摇动的偶像。
40.en: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up a carved image for him that will not be moved.

40.zh: 你们岂不曾知道吗？ 你们岂不曾听见吗？ 从起初岂没有人告诉你们吗？ 自从立地的根基， 你们岂没有明白吗？
40.en: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?

40.zh: 神坐在地球大圈之上； 地上的居民好像蝗虫。 他铺张穹苍如幔子， 展开诸天如可住的帐棚。
40.en: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in,

40.zh: 他使君王归于虚无， 使地上的审判官成为虚空。
40.en: who brings princes to nothing, who makes the judges of the earth meaningless.

40.zh: 他们是刚才栽上， 刚才种上， 根也刚才扎在地里， 他一吹在其上，便都枯干； 旋风将他们吹去，像碎秸一样。
40.en: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.

40.zh: 那圣者说：你们将谁比我， 叫他与我相等呢？
40.en: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.

40.zh: 你们向上举目， 看谁创造这万象， 按数目领出， 他一一称其名； 因他的权能， 又因他的大能大力， 连一个都不缺。
40.en: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by name. By the greatness of his might, and because he is strong in power, not one is lacking.

40.zh: 雅各啊，你为何说， 我的道路向耶和华隐藏？ 以色列啊，你为何言， 我的冤屈　神并不查问？
40.en: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from the LORD, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?

40.zh: 你岂不曾知道吗？ 你岂不曾听见吗？ 永在的　神耶和华，创造地极的[主]， 并不疲乏，也不困倦； 他的智慧无法测度。
40.en: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.

40.zh: 疲乏的，他赐能力； 软弱的，他加力量。
40.en: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

40.zh: 就是少年人也要疲乏困倦； 强壮的也必全然跌倒。
40.en: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;

40.zh: 但那等候耶和华的必从新得力。 他们必如鹰展翅上腾； 他们奔跑却不困倦， 行走却不疲乏。
40.en: but those who wait for the LORD will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

41.zh: 众海岛啊，当在我面前静默； 众民当从新得力， 都要近前来才可以说话， 我们可以彼此辩论。
41.en: “Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak. Let’s meet together for judgment.

41.zh: 谁从东方兴起一人， 凭公义召他来到脚前呢？ 耶和华将列国交给他， 使他管辖君王， 把他们如灰尘交与他的刀， 如风吹的碎秸交与他的弓。
41.en: Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his feet in righteousness? He hands over nations to him and makes him rule over kings. He gives them like the dust to his sword, like the driven stubble to his bow.

41.zh: 他追赶他们， 走他所未走的道， 坦然前行。
41.en: He pursues them and passes by safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.

41.zh: 谁行做成就这事， 从起初宣召历代呢？ 就是我—耶和华！ 我是首先的， 也与末后的同在。
41.en: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, the LORD, the first, and with the last, I am he.”

41.zh: 海岛看见就都害怕； 地极也都战兢， 就近前来。
41.en: The islands have seen, and fear. The ends of the earth tremble. They approach, and come.

41.zh: 他们各人帮助邻舍， [各人]对弟兄说：壮胆吧！
41.en: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”

41.zh: 木匠勉励银匠， 用锤打光的勉励打砧的， 论焊工说，焊得好； 又用钉子钉稳，免得[偶像]动摇。
41.en: So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith. He who smooths with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, “It is good;” and he fastens it with nails, that it might not totter.

41.zh: 惟你以色列—我的仆人， 雅各—我所拣选的， 我朋友亚伯拉罕的后裔，
41.en: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend,

41.zh: 你是我从地极所领来的， 从地角所召来的， 且对你说：你是我的仆人； 我拣选你，并不弃绝你。
41.en: you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant. I have chosen you and have not cast you away.’

41.zh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在； 不要惊惶，因为我是你的　神。 我必坚固你，我必帮助你； 我必用我公义的右手扶持你。
41.en: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

41.zh: 凡向你发怒的必都抱愧蒙羞； 与你相争的必如无有，并要灭亡。
41.en: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.

41.zh: 与你争竞的，你要找他们也找不着； 与你争战的必如无有，成为虚无。
41.en: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a nonexistent thing.

41.zh: 因为我耶和华— 你的　神必搀扶你的右手， 对你说：不要害怕！ 我必帮助你。
41.en: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’

41.zh: 你这虫雅各和你们以色列人， 不要害怕！ 耶和华说：我必帮助你。 你的救赎主就是以色列的圣者。
41.en: Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says the LORD. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.

41.zh: 看哪，我已使你成为 有快齿打粮的新器具； 你要把山岭打得粉碎， 使冈陵如同糠秕。
41.en: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and will make the hills like chaff.

41.zh: 你要把它簸扬，风要吹去； 旋风要把它刮散。 你倒要以耶和华为喜乐， 以以色列的圣者为夸耀。
41.en: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in the LORD. You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.

41.zh: 困苦穷乏人寻求水却没有； 他们因口渴，舌头干燥。 我—耶和华必应允他们； 我—以色列的　神必不离弃他们。
41.en: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, the LORD, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

41.zh: 我要在净光的高处开江河， 在谷中开泉源； 我要使沙漠变为水池， 使干地变为涌泉。
41.en: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

41.zh: 我要在旷野种上香柏树、 皂荚树、番石榴树，和野橄榄树。 我在沙漠要把松树、杉树， 并黄杨树一同栽植；
41.en: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set cypress trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert;

41.zh: 好叫人看见、知道、 思想、明白； 这是耶和华的手所做的， 是以色列的圣者所造的。
41.en: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that the LORD’s hand has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.

41.zh: 耶和华[对假神]说： 你们要呈上你们的案件； 雅各的君说： 你们要声明你们确实的理由。
41.en: Produce your cause,” says the LORD. “Bring out your strong reasons!” says the King of Jacob.

41.zh: 可以声明，指示我们将来必遇的事， 说明先前的是什么事， 好叫我们思索，得知事的结局， 或者把将来的事指示我们。
41.en: “Let them announce and declare to us what will happen! Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.

41.zh: 要说明后来的事， 好叫我们知道你们是神。 你们或降福，或降祸， 使我们惊奇，一同观看。
41.en: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.

41.zh: 看哪，你们属乎虚无； 你们的作为也属乎虚空。 那选择你们的是可憎恶的。
41.en: Behold, you are nothing, and your work is nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.

41.zh: 我从北方兴起一人； 他是求告我名的， 从日出之地而来。 他必临到掌权的， 好像临到灰泥， 仿佛窑匠踹泥一样。
41.en: “I have raised up one from the north, and he has come, from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name, and he shall come on rulers as on mortar, and as the potter treads clay.

41.zh: 谁从起初指明这事，使我们知道呢？ 谁从先前说明，使我们说[他]不错呢？ 谁也没有指明； 谁也没有说明； 谁也没有听见你们的话。
