41.en: Who has declared it from the beginning, that we may know? and before, that we may say, ‘He is right’? Surely, there is no one who declares. Surely, there is no one who shows. Surely, there is no one who hears your words.

41.zh: 我首先对锡安[说]： 看哪，我要将一位报好信息的赐给耶路撒冷。
41.en: I am the first to say to Zion, ‘Behold, look at them;’ and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem.

41.zh: 我看的时候并没有人； 我问的时候， 他们中间也没有谋士可以回答一句。
41.en: When I look, there is no man, even among them there is no counselor who, when I ask, can answer a word.

41.zh: 看哪，他们和他们的工作都是虚空， 且是虚无。 他们所铸的偶像都是风， 都是虚的。
41.en: Behold, all of their deeds are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.

42.zh: 看哪，我的仆人— 我所扶持所拣选、心里所喜悦的！ 我已将我的灵赐给他； 他必将公理传给外邦。
42.en: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.

42.zh: 他不喧嚷，不扬声， 也不使街上听见他的声音。
42.en: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.

42.zh: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断； 将残的灯火，他不吹灭。 他凭真实将公理传开。
42.en: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.

42.zh: 他不灰心，也不丧胆， 直到他在地上设立公理； 海岛都等候他的训诲。
42.en: He will not fail nor be discouraged, until he has set justice on the earth, and the islands wait for his law.”

42.zh: 创造诸天，铺张穹苍， 将地和地所出的一并铺开， 赐气息给地上的众人， 又赐灵性给行在其上之人的　神耶和华， 他如此说：
42.en: God the LORD, he who created the heavens and stretched them out, he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of it, he who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk in it, says:

42.zh: 我—耶和华凭公义召你， 必搀扶你的手，保守你， 使你作众民的中保， 作外邦人的光，
42.en: “I, the LORD, have called you in righteousness. I will hold your hand. I will keep you, and make you a covenant for the people, as a light for the nations,

42.zh: 开瞎子的眼， 领被囚的出牢狱， 领坐黑暗的出监牢。
42.en: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.

42.zh: 我是耶和华，这是我的名； 我必不将我的荣耀归给假神， 也不将我的称赞归给雕刻的偶像。
42.en: “I am the LORD. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.

42.zh: 看哪，先前的事已经成就， 现在我将新事说明， 这事未发以先，我就说给你们听。
42.en: Behold, the former things have happened and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”

42.zh: 航海的和海中所有的， 海岛和其上的居民， 都当向耶和华唱新歌， 从地极赞美他。
42.en: Sing to the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.

42.zh: 旷野和其中的城邑， 并基达人居住的村庄都当扬声； 西拉的居民当欢呼， 在山顶上呐喊。
42.en: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!

42.zh: 他们当将荣耀归给耶和华， 在海岛中传扬他的颂赞。
42.en: Let them give glory to the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.

42.zh: 耶和华必像勇士出去， 必像战士激动热心， 要喊叫，大声呐喊， 要用大力攻击仇敌。
42.en: The LORD will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.

42.zh: 我许久闭口不言，静默不语； [现在]我要喊叫，像产难的妇人； 我要急气而喘哮。
42.en: “I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant.

42.zh: 我要使大山小冈变为荒场， 使其上的花草都枯干； 我要使江河变为洲岛， 使水池都干涸。
42.en: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.

42.zh: 我要引瞎子行不认识的道， 领他们走不知道的路； 在他们面前使黑暗变为光明， 使弯曲变为平直。 这些事我都要行， 并不离弃他们。
42.en: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.

42.zh: 倚靠雕刻的偶像， 对铸造的偶像说： 你是我们的神； 这等人要退后，全然蒙羞。
42.en: “Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed.

42.zh: 你们这耳聋的，听吧！ 你们这眼瞎的，看吧！ 使你们能看见。
42.en: “Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see.

42.zh: 谁比我的仆人眼瞎呢？ 谁比我差遣的使者耳聋呢？ 谁瞎眼像那[与我]和好的？ 谁瞎眼像耶和华的仆人呢？
42.en: Who is blind, but my servant? Or who is as deaf as my messenger whom I send? Who is as blind as he who is at peace, and as blind as the LORD’s servant?

42.zh: 你看见许多事却不领会， 耳朵开通却不听见。
42.en: You see many things, but don’t observe. His ears are open, but he doesn’t listen.

42.zh: 耶和华因自己公义的缘故， 喜欢使律法为大，为尊。
42.en: It pleased the LORD, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law and make it honorable.

42.zh: 但这百姓是被抢被夺的， 都牢笼在坑中，隐藏在狱里； 他们作掠物，无人拯救， 作掳物，无人说交还。
42.en: But this is a robbed and plundered people. All of them are snared in holes, and they are hidden in prisons. They have become captives, and no one delivers, and a plunder, and no one says, ‘Restore them!’

42.zh: 你们中间谁肯侧耳听此， 谁肯留心而听，以防将来呢？
42.en: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?

42.zh: 谁将雅各交出当作掳物， 将以色列交给抢夺的呢？ 岂不是耶和华吗？ 就是我们所得罪的那位。 他们不肯遵行他的道， 也不听从他的训诲。
42.en: Who gave Jacob as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn’t the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in his ways, and they disobeyed his law.

42.zh: 所以，他将猛烈的怒气和争战的勇力 倾倒在以色列的身上。 在他四围如火着起，他还不知道， 烧着他，他也不介意。
42.en: Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him, and the strength of battle. It set him on fire all around, but he didn’t know. It burned him, but he didn’t take it to heart.”

43.zh: 雅各啊，创造你的耶和华， 以色列啊，造成你的那位， 现在如此说： 你不要害怕！因为我救赎了你。 我曾提你的名召你，你是属我的。
43.en: But now the LORD who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.

43.zh: 你从水中经过，我必与你同在； 你趟过江河，水必不漫过你； 你从火中行过，必不被烧， 火焰也不着在你身上。
43.en: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.

43.zh: 因为我是耶和华—你的　神， 是以色列的圣者—你的救主； 我已经使埃及作你的赎价， 使古实和西巴代替你。
43.en: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.

43.zh: 因我看你为宝为尊； 又因我爱你， 所以我使人代替你， 使列邦人替换你的生命。
43.en: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you, therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.

43.zh: 不要害怕，因我与你同在； 我必领你的后裔从东方来， 又从西方招聚你。
43.en: Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west.

43.zh: 我要对北方说，交出来！ 对南方说，不要拘留！ 将我的众子从远方带来， 将我的众女从地极领回，
43.en: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—

43.zh: 就是凡称为我名下的人， 是我为自己的荣耀创造的， 是我所做成，所造作的。
43.en: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’”

43.zh: 你要将有眼而瞎、 有耳而聋的民都带出来！
43.en: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.

43.zh: 任凭万国聚集； 任凭众民会合。 其中谁能将此声明， 并将先前的事说给我们听呢？ 他们可以带出见证来，自显为是； 或者他们听见便说：这是真的。
43.en: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show us former things? Let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified, or let them hear, and say, “That is true.”

43.zh: 耶和华说：你们是我的见证， 我所拣选的仆人。 既是这样，便可以知道，且信服我， 又明白我就是耶和华。 在我以前没有真神； 在我以后也必没有。
43.en: “You are my witnesses,” says the LORD, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.

43.zh: 惟有我是耶和华； 除我以外没有救主。
43.en: I myself am the LORD. Besides me, there is no savior.

43.zh: 我曾指示，我曾拯救，我曾说明， 并且在你们中间没有别神。 所以耶和华说： 你们是我的见证。 我也是　神；
43.en: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown, and there was no strange god among you. Therefore you are my witnesses”, says the LORD, “and I am God.

43.zh: 自从有日子以来，我就是　神； 谁也不能救人脱离我手。 我要行事谁能阻止呢？
43.en: Yes, since the day was, I am he. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”

43.zh: 耶和华—你们的救赎主、 以色列的圣者如此说： 因你们的缘故， 我已经打发人到巴比伦去； 并且我要使迦勒底人如逃民， 都坐自己喜乐的船下来。
43.en: The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.

43.zh: 我是耶和华—你们的圣者， 是创造以色列的，是你们的君王。
43.en: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”

43.zh: 耶和华在沧海中开道， 在大水中开路，
43.en: The LORD, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters,

43.zh: 使车辆、马匹、军兵、勇士都出来， 一同躺下，不再起来； 他们灭没，好像熄灭的灯火。
43.en: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick) says:

43.zh: 耶和华如此说： 你们不要记念从前的事， 也不要思想古时的事。
43.en: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.

43.zh: 看哪，我要做一件新事； 如今要发现，你们岂不知道吗？ 我必在旷野开道路， 在沙漠开江河。
43.en: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

43.zh: 野地的走兽必尊重我； 野狗和鸵鸟也必如此。 因我使旷野有水， 使沙漠有河， 好赐给我的百姓、我的选民喝。
43.en: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,

43.zh: 这百姓是我为自己所造的， 好述说我的美德。
43.en: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.

43.zh: 雅各啊，你并没有求告我； 以色列啊，你倒厌烦我。
43.en: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.

43.zh: 你没有将你的羊带来给我作燔祭， 也没有用祭物尊敬我； 我没有因供物使你服劳， 也没有因乳香使你厌烦。
43.en: You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings, neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.

43.zh: 你没有用银子为我买菖蒲， 也没有用祭物的脂油使我饱足； 倒使我因你的罪恶服劳， 使我因你的罪孽厌烦。
43.en: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices, but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.

43.zh: 惟有我为自己的缘故涂抹你的过犯； 我也不记念你的罪恶。
43.en: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.

43.zh: 你要提醒我，你我可以一同辩论； 你可以将[你的理]陈明，自显为义。
43.en: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.

43.zh: 你的始祖犯罪； 你的师傅违背我。
43.en: Your first father sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.

43.zh: 所以，我要辱没圣所的首领， 使雅各成为咒诅， 使以色列成为辱骂。
43.en: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”

44.zh: 我的仆人雅各， 我所拣选的以色列啊， 现在你当听。
44.en: Yet listen now, Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.

44.zh: 造作你，又从你出胎造就你， 并要帮助你的耶和华如此说： 我的仆人雅各， 我所拣选的耶书 哪， 不要害怕！
44.en: This is what the LORD who made you, and formed you from the womb, who will help you says: “Don’t be afraid, Jacob my servant; and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

44.zh: 因为我要将水浇灌口渴的人， 将河浇灌干旱之地。 我要将我的灵浇灌你的后裔， 将我的福浇灌你的子孙。
44.en: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and streams on the dry ground. I will pour my Spirit on your descendants, and my blessing on your offspring;

44.zh: 他们要发生在草中， 像溪水旁的柳树。
44.en: and they will spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.

44.zh: 这个要说：我是属耶和华的； 那个要以雅各的名自称； 又一个要亲手写：归耶和华的， 并自称为以色列。
44.en: One will say, ‘I am the LORD’s.’ Another will be called by the name of Jacob; and another will write with his hand ‘to the LORD,’ and honor the name of Israel.”

44.zh: 耶和华—以色列的君， 以色列的救赎主—万军之耶和华如此说： 我是首先的，我是末后的； 除我以外再没有[真]神。
44.en: This is what the LORD, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, the LORD of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no God.

44.zh: 自从我设立古时的民， 谁能像我宣告，并且指明，又为自己陈说呢？ 让他将未来的事和必成的事说明。
44.en: Who is like me? Who will call, and will declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people? Let them declare the things that are coming, and that will happen.

44.zh: 你们不要恐惧，也不要害怕。 我岂不是从上古就说明指示你们吗？ 并且你们是我的见证！ 除我以外，岂有[真]神吗？ 诚然没有磐石，我不知道一个！
44.en: Don’t fear, neither be afraid. Haven’t I declared it to you long ago, and shown it? You are my witnesses. Is there a God besides me? Indeed, there is not. I don’t know any other Rock.”

44.zh: 制造雕刻偶像的尽都虚空；他们所喜悦的都无益处；他们的见证无所看见，无所知晓，他们便觉羞愧。
44.en: Everyone who makes a carved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit. Their own witnesses don’t see, nor know, that they may be disappointed.

44.zh: 谁制造神像，铸造无益的偶像？
44.en: Who has fashioned a god, or molds an image that is profitable for nothing?

44.zh: 看哪，他的同伴都必羞愧。工匠也不过是人，任他们聚会，任他们站立，都必惧怕，一同羞愧。
44.en: Behold, all his fellows will be disappointed; and the workmen are mere men. Let them all be gathered together. Let them stand up. They will fear. They will be put to shame together.

44.zh: 铁匠把铁在火炭中烧热，用锤打铁器，用他有力的膀臂锤成；他饥饿而无力，不喝水而发倦。
44.en: The blacksmith takes an ax, works in the coals, fashions it with hammers, and works it with his strong arm. He is hungry, and his strength fails; he drinks no water, and is faint.

44.zh: 木匠拉线，用笔划出样子，用刨子刨成形状，用圆尺划了模样，仿照人的体态，做成人形，好住在房屋中。
44.en: The carpenter stretches out a line. He marks it out with a pencil. He shapes it with planes. He marks it out with compasses, and shapes it like the figure of a man, with the beauty of a man, to reside in a house.

44.zh: 他砍伐香柏树，又取柞树和橡树，在树林中选定了一棵。他栽种松树，得雨长养。
44.en: He cuts down cedars for himself, and takes the cypress and the oak, and strengthens for himself one among the trees of the forest. He plants a cypress tree, and the rain nourishes it.

44.zh: 这树，人可用以烧火；他自己取些烤火，又烧着烤饼，而且做神像跪拜，做雕刻的偶像向它叩拜。
44.en: Then it will be for a man to burn; and he takes some of it and warms himself. Yes, he burns it and bakes bread. Yes, he makes a god and worships it; he makes it a carved image, and falls down to it.

44.zh: 他把一分烧在火中，把一分烤肉吃饱。自己烤火说：「啊哈，我暖和了，我见火了。」
44.en: He burns part of it in the fire. With part of it, he eats meat. He roasts a roast and is satisfied. Yes, he warms himself and says, “Aha! I am warm. I have seen the fire.”

44.zh: 他用剩下的做了一神，就是雕刻的偶像。他向这偶像俯伏叩拜，祷告它说：「求你拯救我，因你是我的神。」
44.en: The rest of it he makes into a god, even his engraved image. He bows down to it and worships, and prays to it, and says, “Deliver me, for you are my god!”

44.zh: 他们不知道，也不思想；因为耶和华闭住他们的眼，不能看见，塞住他们的心，不能明白。
44.en: They don’t know, neither do they consider, for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see, and their hearts, that they can’t understand.

44.zh: 谁心里也不醒悟，也没有知识，没有聪明，能说：「我曾拿一分在火中烧了，在炭火上烤过饼；我也烤过肉吃。这剩下的，我岂要作可憎的物吗？我岂可向木ⶍ子叩拜呢？」
44.en: No one thinks, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, “I have burned part of it in the fire. Yes, I have also baked bread on its coals. I have roasted meat and eaten it. Shall I make the rest of it into an abomination? Shall I bow down to a tree trunk?”

44.zh: 他以灰为食，心中昏迷，使他偏邪，他不能自救，也不能说：「我右手中岂不是有虚谎吗？」
44.en: He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can’t deliver his soul, nor say, “Isn’t there a lie in my right hand?”

44.zh: 雅各，以色列啊， 你是我的仆人，要记念这些事。 以色列啊，你是我的仆人， 我造就你必不忘记你。
44.en: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, for you are my servant. I have formed you. You are my servant. Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.

44.zh: 我涂抹了你的过犯，像厚云[消散]； 我涂抹了你的罪恶，如薄云[灭没]。 你当归向我，因我救赎了你。
44.en: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.

44.zh: 诸天哪，应当歌唱， 因为耶和华做成这事。 地的深处啊，应当欢呼； 众山应当发声歌唱； 树林和其中所有的树都当如此！ 因为耶和华救赎了雅各， 并要因以色列荣耀自己。
44.en: Sing, you heavens, for the LORD has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains, O forest, all of your trees, for the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself in Israel.

44.zh: 从你出胎，造就你的救赎主—耶和华如此说： 我—耶和华是创造万物的， 是独自铺张诸天、铺开大地的。 谁与我同在呢？
44.en: The LORD, your Redeemer, and he who formed you from the womb says: “I am the LORD, who makes all things; who alone stretches out the heavens; who spreads out the earth by myself;

44.zh: 使说假话的兆头失效， 使占卜的癫狂， 使智慧人退后， 使他的知识变为愚拙；
44.en: who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;

44.zh: 使我仆人的话语立定， 我使者的谋算成就。 论到耶路撒冷说：必有人居住； 论到犹大的城邑说：必被建造， 其中的荒场我也必兴起。
44.en: who confirms the word of his servant, and performs the counsel of his messengers; who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited;’ and of the cities of Judah, ‘They will be built,’ and ‘I will raise up its waste places;’

44.zh: 对深渊说：你干了吧！ 我也要使你的江河干涸。
44.en: who says to the deep, ‘Be dry,’ and ‘I will dry up your rivers,’

44.zh: 论塞鲁士说：[他是]我的牧人， 必成就我所喜悦的， 必下令建造耶路撒冷， 发命立稳圣殿的根基。
44.en: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure,’ even saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be built;’ and of the temple, ‘Your foundation will be laid.’”

45.zh: 我—耶和华所膏的塞鲁士； 我搀扶他的右手， 使列国降伏在他面前。 我也要放松列王的腰带， 使城门在他面前敞开， 不得关闭。 我对他如此说：
45.en: The LORD says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held to subdue nations before him and strip kings of their armor, to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:

45.zh: 我必在你前面行， 修平崎岖之地。 我必打破铜门， 砍断铁闩。
45.en: “I will go before you and make the rough places smooth. I will break the doors of bronze in pieces and cut apart the bars of iron.

45.zh: 我要将暗中的宝物和隐密的财宝赐给你， 使你知道提名召你的， 就是我—耶和华、以色列的　神。
45.en: I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, the LORD, who calls you by your name, even the God of Israel.

45.zh: 因我仆人雅各， 我所拣选以色列的缘故， 我就提名召你； 你虽不认识我， 我也加给你名号。
45.en: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel my chosen, I have called you by your name. I have given you a title, though you have not known me.

45.zh: 我是耶和华，在我以外并没有别神； 除了我以外再没有　神。 你虽不认识我， 我必给你束腰。
45.en: I am the LORD, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,

45.zh: 从日出之地到日落之处 使人都知道除了我以外，没有别神。 我是耶和华； 在我以外并没有别神。
45.en: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am the LORD, and there is no one else.

45.zh: 我造光，又造暗； 我施平安，又降灾祸； 造作这一切的是我—耶和华。
45.en: I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am the LORD, who does all these things.

45.zh: 诸天哪，自上而滴， 穹苍降下公义； 地面开裂，产出救恩， 使公义一同发生； 这都是我—耶和华所造的。
45.en: Rain, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open, that it may produce salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up with it. I, the LORD, have created it.

45.zh: 祸哉，那与造他的主争论的！ 他不过是地上瓦片中的一块瓦片。 泥土岂可对抟弄他的说：你做什么呢？ 所做的物岂可说：你没有手呢？
45.en: Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions it, ‘What are you making?’ or your work, ‘He has no hands’?

45.zh: 祸哉，那对父亲说： 你生的是什么呢？ 或对母亲说： 你产的是什么呢？
45.en: Woe to him who says to a father, ‘What have you become the father of?’ or to a mother, ‘What have you given birth to?’”

45.zh: 耶和华—以色列的圣者， 就是造就以色列的如此说： 将来的事，你们可以问我； 至于我的众子，并我手的工作， 你们可以求我命定。
45.en: The LORD, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker says: “You ask me about the things that are to come, concerning my sons, and you command me concerning the work of my hands!

45.zh: 我造地，又造人在地上。 我亲手铺张诸天； 天上万象也是我所命定的。
45.en: I have made the earth, and created man on it. I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens. I have commanded all their army.

45.zh: 我凭公义兴起塞鲁士， 又要修直他一切道路。 他必建造我的城， 释放我被掳的民； 不是为工价，也不是为赏赐。 这是万军之耶和华说的。
45.en: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He shall build my city, and he shall let my exiles go free, not for price nor reward,” says the LORD of Armies.

45.zh: 耶和华如此说： 埃及劳碌得来的和古实的货物必归你； 身量高大的西巴人必投降你，也要属你。 他们必带着锁链过来随从你， 又向你下拜，祈求你[说]： 　神真在你们中间，此外再没有别神； 再没有别的　神。
45.en: The LORD says: “The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you, and they will be yours. They will go after you. They shall come over in chains. They will bow down to you. They will make supplication to you: ‘Surely God is in you; and there is no one else. There is no other god.

45.zh: 救主—以色列的　神啊， 你实在是自隐的　神。
45.en: Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself, God of Israel, the Savior.’”

45.zh: 凡制造偶像的都必抱愧蒙羞， 都要一同归于惭愧。
45.en: They will be disappointed, yes, confounded, all of them. Those who are makers of idols will go into confusion together.

45.zh: 惟有以色列必蒙耶和华的拯救， 得永远的救恩。 你们必不蒙羞，也不抱愧， 直到永世无尽。
45.en: Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages everlasting.

45.zh: 创造诸天的耶和华， 制造成全大地的　神， 他创造坚定大地， 并非使地荒凉， 是要给人居住。 他如此说： 我是耶和华，再没有别神。
45.en: For the LORD who created the heavens, the God who formed the earth and made it, who established it and didn’t create it a waste, who formed it to be inhabited says: “I am the LORD. There is no other.

45.zh: 我没有在隐密黑暗之地说话； 我没有对雅各的后裔说： 你们寻求我是徒然的。 我—耶和华所讲的是公义， 所说的是正直。
45.en: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I, the LORD, speak righteousness. I declare things that are right.

45.zh: 你们从列国逃脱的人， 要一同聚集前来。 那些抬着雕刻木偶、 祷告不能救人之神的， 毫无知识。
45.en: “Assemble yourselves and come. Draw near together, you who have escaped from the nations. Those have no knowledge who carry the wood of their engraved image, and pray to a god that can’t save.

45.zh: 你们要述说陈明[你们的理]， 让他们彼此商议。 谁从古时指明？ 谁从上古述说？ 不是我—耶和华吗？ 除了我以外，再没有　神； 我是公义的　神，又是救主； 除了我以外，再没有别神。
45.en: Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it of old? Haven’t I, the LORD? There is no other God besides me, a just God and a Savior. There is no one besides me.

45.zh: 地极[的人]都当仰望我， 就必得救； 因为我是　神，再没有别神。
45.en: “Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.

45.zh: 我指着自己起誓， 我口所出的话是凭公义，并不反回： 万膝必向我跪拜； 万口必凭我起誓。
45.en: I have sworn by myself. The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and will not be revoked, that to me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall take an oath.

45.zh: 人论我说， 公义、能力，惟独在乎耶和华； 人都必归向他。 凡向他发怒的必至蒙羞。
45.en: They will say of me, ‘There is righteousness and strength only in the LORD.’” Even to him will men come. All those who raged against him will be disappointed.

45.zh: 以色列的后裔都必因耶和华得称为义， 并要夸耀。
45.en: All the offspring of Israel will be justified in the LORD, and will rejoice!

46.zh: 彼勒屈身，尼波弯腰； 巴比伦的偶像驮在兽和牲畜上。 他们所抬的如今成了重驮， 使[牲畜]疲乏，
46.en: Bel bows down. Nebo stoops. Their idols are carried by animals, and on the livestock. The things that you carried around are heavy loads, a burden for the weary.

46.zh: 都一同弯腰屈身， 不能保全重驮， 自己倒被掳去。
46.en: They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.

46.zh: 雅各家，以色列家一切余剩的要听我言： 你们自从生下，就蒙[我]保抱， 自从出胎，便蒙[我]怀搋。
46.en: “Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth, that have been carried from the womb.

46.zh: 直到你们年老，我仍这样； 直到你们发白，我仍怀搋。 我已造作，也必保抱； 我必怀抱，也必拯救。
46.en: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.

46.zh: 你们将谁与我相比，与我同等， 可以与我比较，使我们相同呢？
46.en: “To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal, and compare me, as if we were the same?

46.zh: 那从囊中抓金子， 用天平平银子的人， 雇银匠制造神像， 他们又俯伏，又叩拜。
46.en: Some pour out gold from the bag, and weigh silver in the balance. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god. They fall down— yes, they worship.

46.zh: 他们将神像抬起，扛在肩上， 安置在定处，它就站立， 不离本位； 人呼求它，它不能答应， 也不能救人脱离患难。
46.en: They bear it on their shoulder. They carry it, and set it in its place, and it stands there. It cannot move from its place. Yes, one may cry to it, yet it can not answer. It cannot save him out of his trouble.

46.zh: 你们当想念这事，自己作大丈夫。 悖逆的人哪，要心里思想。
46.en: “Remember this, and show yourselves men. Bring it to mind again, you transgressors.

46.zh: 你们要追念上古的事。 因为我是　神，并无别神； [我是]　神，再没有能比我的。
46.en: Remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.

46.zh: 我从起初指明末后的事， 从古时言明未成的事， 说：我的筹算必立定； 凡我所喜悦的，我必成就。
46.en: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will stand, and I will do all that I please.

46.zh: 我召鸷鸟从东方来， 召那成就我筹算的人从远方来。 我已说出，也必成就； 我已谋定，也必做成。
46.en: I call a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. Yes, I have spoken. I will also bring it to pass. I have planned. I will also do it.

46.zh: 你们这些心中顽梗、 远离公义的，当听我言。
46.en: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!

46.zh: 我使我的公义临近，必不远离。 我的救恩必不迟延； 我要为以色列—我的荣耀， 在锡安施行救恩。
46.en: I bring my righteousness near. It is not far off, and my salvation will not wait. I will grant salvation to Zion, my glory to Israel.

47.zh: 巴比伦的处女啊， 下来坐在尘埃； 迦勒底的闺女啊， 没有宝座，要坐在地上； 因为你不再称为柔弱娇嫩的。
47.en: “Come down and sit in the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon. Sit on the ground without a throne, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you will no longer be called tender and delicate.

47.zh: 要用磨磨面， 揭去帕子， 脱去长衣，露腿趟河。
47.en: Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, lift up your skirt, uncover your legs, and wade through the rivers.

47.zh: 你的下体必被露出； 你的丑陋必被看见。 我要报仇， 谁也不宽容。
47.en: Your nakedness will be uncovered. Yes, your shame will be seen. I will take vengeance, and will spare no one.”

47.zh: 我们救赎主的名是 万军之耶和华—以色列的圣者。
47.en: Our Redeemer, the LORD of Armies is his name, is the Holy One of Israel.

47.zh: 迦勒底的闺女啊， 你要默然静坐，进入暗中， 因为你不再称为列国的主母。
47.en: “Sit in silence, and go into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you shall no longer be called the mistress of kingdoms.

47.zh: 我向我的百姓发怒， 使我的产业被亵渎， 将他们交在你手中， 你毫不怜悯他们， 把极重的轭加在老年人身上。
47.en: I was angry with my people. I profaned my inheritance and gave them into your hand. You showed them no mercy. You laid a very heavy yoke on the aged.

47.zh: 你自己说：我必永为主母， 所以你不将这事放在心上， 也不思想这事的结局。
47.en: You said, ‘I will be a princess forever,’ so that you didn’t lay these things to your heart, nor did you remember the results.

47.zh: 你这专好宴乐、安然居住的， 现在当听这话。 你心中说：惟有我， 除我以外再没有别的。 我必不致寡居， 也不遭丧子之事。
47.en: “Now therefore hear this, you who are given to pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me. I won’t sit as a widow, neither will I know the loss of children.’

47.zh: 哪知，丧子、寡居这两件事 在一日转眼之间必临到你； 正在你多行邪术、广施符咒的时候， 这两件事必全然临到你身上。
47.en: But these two things will come to you in a moment in one day: the loss of children and widowhood. They will come on you in their full measure, in the multitude of your sorceries, and the great abundance of your enchantments.

47.zh: 你素来倚仗自己的恶行，说： 无人看见我。 你的智慧聪明使你偏邪， 并且你心里说：惟有我， 除我以外再没有别的。
47.en: For you have trusted in your wickedness. You have said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and your knowledge has perverted you. You have said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me.’

47.zh: 因此，祸患要临到你身； 你不知何时发现 灾害落在你身上， 你也不能除掉； 所不知道的毁灭也必忽然临到你身。
47.en: Therefore disaster will come on you. You won’t know when it dawns. Mischief will fall on you. You won’t be able to put it away. Desolation will come on you suddenly, which you don’t understand.

47.zh: 站起来吧！ 用你从幼年劳神施行的符咒和你许多的邪术； 或者可得益处， 或者可得强胜。
47.en: “Stand now with your enchantments and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth, as if you might profit, as if you might prevail.

47.zh: 你筹划太多，以致疲倦。 让那些观天象的，看星宿的， 在月朔说预言的，都站起来， 救你脱离所要临到你的事。
47.en: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels. Now let the astrologers, the stargazers, and the monthly prognosticators stand up and save you from the things that will happen to you.

47.zh: 他们要像碎秸被火焚烧， 不能救自己脱离火焰之力； 这火并非可烤的炭火， 也不是可以坐在其前的火。
47.en: Behold, they are like stubble. The fire will burn them. They won’t deliver themselves from the power of the flame. It won’t be a coal to warm at or a fire to sit by.

47.zh: 你所劳神的事都要这样与你[无益]； 从幼年与你贸易的也都各奔各乡，无人救你。
47.en: The things that you labored in will be like this: those who have trafficked with you from your youth will each wander in his own way. There will be no one to save you.

48.zh: 雅各家，称为以色列名下， 从犹大水源出来的，当听我言！ 你们指着耶和华的名起誓， 提说以色列的　神， 却不凭诚实，不凭公义。
48.en: “Hear this, house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, and have come out of the waters of Judah. You swear by the LORD’s name, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness—

48.zh: 他们自称为圣城的人， 所倚靠的是 名为万军之耶和华—以色列的　神。
48.en: for they call themselves citizens of the holy city, and rely on the God of Israel; the LORD of Armies is his name.

48.zh: 主说：早先的事，我从古时说明， 已经出了我的口， 也是我所指示的； 我忽然行做，事便成就。
48.en: I have declared the former things from of old. Yes, they went out of my mouth, and I revealed them. I did them suddenly, and they happened.

48.zh: 因为我素来知道你是顽梗的— 你的颈项是铁的； 你的额是铜的。
48.en: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;

48.zh: 所以，我从古时将这事给你说明， 在未成以先指示你， 免得你说：这些事是我的偶像所行的， 是我雕刻的偶像和我铸造的偶像所命定的。
48.en: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them. My engraved image and my molten image has commanded them.’

48.zh: 你已经听见，现在要看见这一切； 你不说明吗？ 从今以后，我将新事， 就是你所不知道的隐密事指示你。
48.en: You have heard it. Now see all this. And you, won’t you declare it? “I have shown you new things from this time, even hidden things, which you have not known.

48.zh: 这事是现今造的，并非从古就有； 在今日以先，你也未曾听见， 免得你说：这事我早已知道了。
48.en: They are created now, and not from of old. Before today, you didn’t hear them, lest you should say, ‘Behold, I knew them.’

48.zh: 你未曾听见，未曾知道； 你的耳朵从来未曾开通。 我原知道你行事极其诡诈， 你自从出胎以来， 便称为悖逆的。
48.en: Yes, you didn’t hear. Yes, you didn’t know. Yes, from of old your ear was not opened, for I knew that you dealt very treacherously, and were called a transgressor from the womb.

48.zh: 我为我的名暂且忍怒， 为我的颂赞向你容忍， 不将你剪除。
48.en: For my name’s sake, I will defer my anger, and for my praise, I hold it back for you so that I don’t cut you off.

48.zh: 我熬炼你，却不像熬炼银子； 你在苦难的炉中，我拣选你。
48.en: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.

48.zh: 我为自己的缘故必行这事， 我焉能使[我的名]被亵渎？ 我必不将我的荣耀归给假神。
48.en: For my own sake, for my own sake, I will do it; for how would my name be profaned? I will not give my glory to another.

48.zh: 雅各—我所选召的以色列啊， 当听我言： 我是耶和华， 我是首先的，也是末后的。
48.en: “Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he. I am the first. I am also the last.

48.zh: 我手立了地的根基； 我右手铺张诸天； 我一招呼便都立住。
48.en: Yes, my hand has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand has spread out the heavens. when I call to them, they stand up together.

48.zh: 你们都当聚集而听， 他们内中谁说过这些事？ 耶和华所爱的人必向巴比伦行他所喜悦的事； 他的膀臂也要[加在]迦勒底人身上。
48.en: “Assemble yourselves, all of you, and hear! Who among them has declared these things? He whom the LORD loves will do what he likes to Babylon, and his arm will be against the Chaldeans.

48.zh: 惟有我曾说过，我又选召他， 领他来，他的道路就必亨通。
48.en: I, even I, have spoken. Yes, I have called him. I have brought him and he shall make his way prosperous.

48.zh: 你们要就近我来听这话： 我从起头并未曾在隐密处说话； 自从有这事，我就在那里。 现在，主耶和华差遣我和他的灵来。
48.en: “Come near to me and hear this: “From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it happened, I was there.” Now the Lord GOD has sent me with his Spirit.

48.zh: 耶和华—你的救赎主， 以色列的圣者如此说： 我是耶和华—你的　神， 教训你，使你得益处， 引导你所当行的路。
48.en: The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.

48.zh: 甚愿你素来听从我的命令！ 你的平安就如河水； 你的公义就如海浪。
48.en: Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.

48.zh: 你的后裔也必多如[海]沙； 你腹中所生的也必多如沙粒。 他的名在我面前必不剪除， 也不灭绝。
48.en: Your offspring also would have been as the sand and the descendants of your body like its grains. His name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.”

48.zh: 你们要从巴比伦出来， 从迦勒底人中逃脱， 以欢呼的声音传扬说： 耶和华救赎了他的仆人雅各！ 你们要将这事宣扬到地极。
48.en: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With the sound of joyful shouting announce this, tell it even to the end of the earth; say, “The LORD has redeemed his servant Jacob!”

48.zh: 耶和华引导他们经过沙漠。 他们并不干渴； 他为他们使水从磐石而流， 分裂磐石，水就涌出。
48.en: They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts. He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them. He also split the rock and the waters gushed out.

48.zh: 耶和华说： 恶人必不得平安！
48.en: “There is no peace”, says the LORD, “for the wicked.”

49.zh: 众海岛啊，当听我言！ 远方的众民哪，留心而听！ 自我出胎，耶和华就选召我； 自出母腹，他就提我的名。
49.en: Listen, islands, to me. Listen, you peoples, from afar: the LORD has called me from the womb; from the inside of my mother, he has mentioned my name.

49.zh: 他使我的口如快刀， 将我藏在他手荫之下； 又使我成为磨亮的箭， 将我藏在他箭袋之中；
49.en: He has made my mouth like a sharp sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. He has made me a polished shaft. He has kept me close in his quiver.

49.zh: 对我说：你是我的仆人以色列； 我必因你得荣耀。
49.en: He said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified.”

49.zh: 我却说：我劳碌是徒然； 我尽力是虚无虚空。 然而，我[当得]的理必在耶和华那里； 我的赏赐必在我　神那里。
49.en: But I said, “I have labored in vain. I have spent my strength in vain for nothing; yet surely the justice due to me is with the LORD, and my reward with my God.”

49.zh: 耶和华从我出胎，造就我作他的仆人， 要使雅各归向他， 使以色列到他那里聚集。 原来耶和华看我为尊贵； 我的　神也成为我的力量。
49.en: Now the LORD, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant, says to bring Jacob again to him, and to gather Israel to him, for I am honorable in the LORD’s eyes, and my God has become my strength.

49.zh: 现在他说：你作我的仆人， 使雅各众支派复兴， 使以色列中得保全的归回尚为小事， 我还要使你作外邦人的光， 叫你施行我的救恩，直到地极。
49.en: Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel. I will also give you as a light to the nations, that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.”

49.zh: 救赎主—以色列的圣者耶和华 对那被人所藐视、本国所憎恶、 官长所虐待的如此说： 君王要看见就站起， 首领也要下拜； 都因信实的耶和华， 就是拣选你—以色列的圣者。
49.en: The LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a servant of rulers: “Kings shall see and rise up, princes, and they shall worship, because of the LORD who is faithful, even the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.”

49.zh: 耶和华如此说： 在悦纳的时候，我应允了你； 在拯救的日子，我济助了你。 我要保护你， 使你作众民的中保； 复兴遍地， 使人承受荒凉之地为业。
49.en: The LORD says, “I have answered you in an acceptable time. I have helped you in a day of salvation. I will preserve you and give you for a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to make them inherit the desolate heritage,

49.zh: 对那被捆绑的人说：出来吧！ 对那在黑暗的人说：显露吧！ 他们在路上必得饮食， 在一切净光的高处必有食物。
49.en: saying to those who are bound, ‘Come out!’; to those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves!’ “They shall feed along the paths, and their pasture shall be on all treeless heights.

49.zh: 不饥不渴， 炎热和烈日必不伤害他们； 因为怜恤他们的必引导他们， 领他们到水泉旁边。
49.en: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them, for he who has mercy on them will lead them. He will guide them by springs of water.

49.zh: 我必使我的众山成为大道； 我的大路也被修高。
49.en: I will make all my mountains a road, and my highways shall be exalted.

49.zh: 看哪，这些从远方来； 这些从北方、从西方来； 这些从秦国来。
49.en: Behold, these shall come from afar, and behold, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim.”

49.zh: 诸天哪，应当欢呼！ 大地啊，应当快乐！ 众山哪，应当发声歌唱！ 因为耶和华已经安慰他的百姓， 也要怜恤他困苦之民。
49.en: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains! For the LORD has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.

49.zh: 锡安说：耶和华离弃了我； 主忘记了我。
49.en: But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”

49.zh: 妇人焉能忘记她吃奶的婴孩， 不怜恤她所生的儿子？ 即或有忘记的， 我却不忘记你。
49.en: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!

49.zh: 看哪，我将你铭刻在我掌上； 你的墙垣常在我眼前。
49.en: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.

49.zh: 你的儿女必急速[归回]； 毁坏你的，使你荒废的，必都离你出去，
49.en: Your children hurry. Your destroyers and those who devastated you will leave you.

49.zh: 你举目向四方观看； 他们都聚集来到你这里。 耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓： 你必要以他们为妆饰佩戴， 以他们为华带束腰，像新妇一样。
49.en: Lift up your eyes all around, and see: all these gather themselves together, and come to you. As I live,” says the LORD, “you shall surely clothe yourself with them all as with an ornament, and dress yourself with them, like a bride.

49.zh: 至于你荒废凄凉之处， 并你被毁坏之地， 现今众民居住必显为太窄； 吞灭你的必离你遥远。
49.en: “For, as for your waste and your desolate places, and your land that has been destroyed, surely now that land will be too small for the inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far away.

49.zh: 你必听见丧子之后所生的儿女说： 这地方我居住太窄， 求你给我地方居住。
49.en: The children of your bereavement will say in your ears, ‘This place is too small for me. Give me a place to live in.’

49.zh: 那时你心里必说：我既丧子独居， 是被掳的，漂流在外。 谁给我生这些？ 谁将这些养大呢？ 撇下我一人独居的时候， 这些在哪里呢？
49.en: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has conceived these for me, since I have been bereaved of my children and am alone, an exile, and wandering back and forth? Who has brought these up? Behold, I was left alone. Where were these?’”

49.zh: 主耶和华如此说： 我必向列国举手， 向万民竖立大旗； 他们必将你的众子怀中抱来， 将你的众女肩上扛来。
49.en: The Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and lift up my banner to the peoples. They shall bring your sons in their bosom, and your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders.

49.zh: 列王必作你的养父； 王后必作你的乳母。 他们必将脸伏地，向你下拜， 并舔你脚上的尘土。 你便知道我是耶和华； 等候我的必不致羞愧。
49.en: Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces to the earth, and lick the dust of your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; and those who wait for me won’t be disappointed.”

49.zh: 勇士抢去的岂能夺回？ 该掳掠的岂能解救吗？
49.en: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?

49.zh: 但耶和华如此说： 就是勇士所掳掠的，也可以夺回； 强暴人所抢的，也可以解救。 与你相争的，我必与他相争； 我要拯救你的儿女。
49.en: But the LORD says, “Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the plunder retrieved from the fierce, for I will contend with him who contends with you and I will save your children.

49.zh: 并且我必使那欺压你的吃自己的肉， 也要以自己的血喝醉，好像喝甜酒一样。 凡有血气的必都知道我—耶和华是你的救主， 是你的救赎主，是雅各的大能者。
49.en: I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh; and they will be drunk on their own blood, as with sweet wine. Then all flesh shall know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”

50.zh: 耶和华如此说： 我休你们的母亲， 休书在哪里呢？ 我将你们卖给我哪一个债主呢？ 你们被卖，是因你们的罪孽； 你们的母亲被休，是因你们的过犯。
50.en: The LORD says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors have I sold you? Behold, you were sold for your iniquities, and your mother was put away for your transgressions.

50.zh: 我来的时候，为何无人[等候]呢？ 我呼唤的时候，为何无人答应呢？ 我的膀臂岂是缩短、不能救赎吗？ 我岂无拯救之力吗？ 看哪，我一斥责，海就干了； 我使江河变为旷野； 其中的鱼因无水腥臭，干渴而死。
50.en: Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it can’t redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea. I make the rivers a wilderness. Their fish stink because there is no water, and die of thirst.

50.zh: 我使诸天以黑暗为衣服， 以麻布为遮盖。
50.en: I clothe the heavens with blackness. I make sackcloth their covering.”

50.zh: 主耶和华赐我受教者的舌头， 使我知道怎样用言语扶助疲乏的人。 主每早晨提醒， 提醒我的耳朵， 使我能听，像受教者一样。
50.en: The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary. He awakens morning by morning, he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.

50.zh: 主耶和华开通我的耳朵； 我并没有违背，也没有退后。
50.en: The Lord GOD has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.

50.zh: 人打我的背，我任他打； 人拔我腮颊的胡须，我由他拔； 人辱我，吐我，我并不掩面。
50.en: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame and spitting.

50.zh: 主耶和华必帮助我， 所以我不抱愧。 我硬着脸面好像坚石； 我也知道我必不致蒙羞。
50.en: For the Lord GOD will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won’t be disappointed.

50.zh: 称我为义的与我相近； 谁与我争论， 可以与我一同站立； 谁与我作对， 可以就近我来。
50.en: He who justifies me is near. Who will bring charges against me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me.

50.zh: 主耶和华要帮助我； 谁能定我有罪呢？ 他们都像衣服渐渐旧了， 为蛀虫所咬。
50.en: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me! Who is he who will condemn me? Behold, they will all grow old like a garment. The moths will eat them up.

50.zh: 你们中间谁是敬畏耶和华、 听从他仆人之话的？ 这人行在暗中，没有亮光。 当倚靠耶和华的名， 仗赖自己的　神。
50.en: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust in the LORD’s name, and rely on his God.

50.zh: 凡你们点火，用火把围绕自己的 可以行在你们的火焰里， 并你们所点的火把中。 这是我手所定的： 你们必躺在悲惨之中。
50.en: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who adorn yourselves with torches around yourselves, walk in the flame of your fire, and among the torches that you have kindled. You will have this from my hand: you will lie down in sorrow.

51.zh: 你们这追求公义、 寻求耶和华的，当听我言！ 你们要追想被凿而出的磐石， 被挖而出的岩穴。
51.en: “Listen to me, you who follow after righteousness, you who seek the LORD. Look to the rock you were cut from, and to the quarry you were dug from.

51.zh: 要追想你们的祖宗亚伯拉罕 和生养你们的撒拉； 因为亚伯拉罕独自一人的时候， 我选召他，赐福与他， 使他[人数]增多。
51.en: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who bore you; for when he was but one I called him, I blessed him, and made him many.

51.zh: 耶和华已经安慰锡安 和锡安一切的荒场， 使旷野像伊甸， 使沙漠像耶和华的园囿； 在其中必有欢喜、快乐、感谢， 和歌唱的声音。
51.en: For the LORD has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in them, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

51.zh: 我的百姓啊，要向我留心； 我的国民哪，要向我侧耳； 因为训诲必从我而出； 我必坚定我的公理为万民之光。
51.en: “Listen to me, my people; and hear me, my nation, for a law will go out from me, and I will establish my justice for a light to the peoples.

51.zh: 我的公义临近； 我的救恩发出。 我的膀臂要审判万民； 海岛都要等候我，倚赖我的膀臂。
51.en: My righteousness is near. My salvation has gone out, and my arms will judge the peoples. The islands will wait for me, and they will trust my arm.

51.zh: 你们要向天举目， 观看下地； 因为天必像烟云消散， 地必如衣服渐渐旧了； 其上的居民也要如此死亡。 惟有我的救恩永远长存； 我的公义也不废掉。
51.en: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens will vanish away like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment. Its inhabitants will die in the same way, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will not be abolished.

51.zh: 知道公义、将我训诲存在心中的民， 要听我言！ 不要怕人的辱骂， 也不要因人的毁谤惊惶。
51.en: “Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law. Don’t fear the reproach of men, and don’t be dismayed at their insults.

51.zh: 因为蛀虫必咬他们，好像咬衣服； 虫子必咬他们，如同咬羊绒。 惟有我的公义永远长存， 我的救恩直到万代。
51.en: For the moth will eat them up like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool; but my righteousness will be forever, and my salvation to all generations.”

51.zh: 耶和华的膀臂啊，兴起！兴起！ 以能力为衣穿上， 像古时的年日、上古的世代兴起一样。 从前砍碎拉哈伯、 刺透大鱼的，不是你吗？
51.en: Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of the LORD! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it you who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the monster?

51.zh: 使海与深渊的水干涸、 使海的深处变为赎民经过之路的， 不是你吗？
51.en: Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?

51.zh: 耶和华救赎的民必归回， 歌唱来到锡安； 永乐必归到他们的头上。 他们必得着欢喜快乐； 忧愁叹息尽都逃避。
51.en: Those ransomed by the LORD will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy. Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

51.zh: 惟有我，是安慰你们的。 你是谁，竟怕那必死的人？ 怕那要变如草的世人？
51.en: “I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass?

51.zh: 却忘记铺张诸天、立定地基、 创造你的耶和华？ 又因欺压者图谋毁灭要发的暴怒， 整天害怕， 其实那欺压者的暴怒在哪里呢？
51.en: Have you forgotten the LORD your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live in fear continually all day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he prepares to destroy? Where is the fury of the oppressor?

51.zh: 被掳去的快得释放， 必不死而下坑； 他的食物也不致缺乏。
51.en: The captive exile will speedily be freed. He will not die and go down into the pit. His bread won’t fail.

51.zh: 我是耶和华—你的　神— 搅动大海，使海中的波浪匉訇— 万军之耶和华是我的名。
51.en: For I am the LORD your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. the LORD of Armies is his name.

51.zh: 我将我的话传给你， 用我的手影遮蔽你， 为要栽定诸天，立定地基， 又对锡安说：你是我的百姓。
51.en: I have put my words in your mouth and have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and tell Zion, ‘You are my people.’”

51.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，兴起！ 兴起！站起来！ 你从耶和华手中喝了他忿怒之杯， 喝了那使人东倒西歪的爵，以致喝尽。
51.en: Awake, awake! Stand up, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the LORD’s hand the cup of his wrath. You have drunken the bowl of the cup of staggering, and drained it.

51.zh: 她所生育的诸子中，没有一个引导她的； 她所养大的诸子中，没有一个搀扶她的。
51.en: There is no one to guide her among all the sons to whom she has given birth; and there is no one who takes her by the hand among all the sons whom she has brought up.

51.zh: 荒凉、毁灭、饥荒、刀兵， 这几样临到你， 谁为你举哀？ 我如何能安慰你呢？
51.en: These two things have happened to you— who will grieve with you?— desolation and destruction, and famine and the sword. How can I comfort you?

51.zh: 你的众子发昏， 在各市口上躺卧， 好像黄羊在网罗之中， 都满了耶和华的忿怒 —你　神的斥责。
51.en: Your sons have fainted. They lie at the head of all the streets, like an antelope in a net. They are full of the LORD’s wrath, the rebuke of your God.

51.zh: 因此，你这困苦却非因酒而醉的， 要听我言。
51.en: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

51.zh: 你的主耶和华— 就是为他百姓辨屈的　神如此说： 看哪，我已将那使人东倒西歪的杯， 就是我忿怒的爵， 从你手中接过来； 你必不致再喝。
51.en: Your Lord GOD, your God who pleads the cause of his people, says, “Behold, I have taken out of your hand the cup of staggering, even the bowl of the cup of my wrath. You will not drink it any more.

51.zh: 我必将这杯递在苦待你的人手中； 他们曾对你说：你屈身， 由我们践踏过去吧！ 你便以背为地， 好像街市，任人经过。
51.en: I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down, that we may walk over you;’ and you have laid your back as the ground, like a street to those who walk over.”

52.zh: 锡安哪，兴起！兴起！ 披上你的能力！ 圣城耶路撒冷啊，穿上你华美的衣服！ 因为从今以后， 未受割礼、不洁净的必不再进入你中间。
52.en: Awake, awake! Put on your strength, Zion. Put on your beautiful garments, Jerusalem, the holy city, for from now on the uncircumcised and the unclean will no more come into you.

52.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，要抖下尘土！ 起来坐[在位上]！ 锡安被掳的居民哪， 要解开你颈项的锁链！
52.en: Shake yourself from the dust! Arise, sit up, Jerusalem! Release yourself from the bonds of your neck, captive daughter of Zion!

52.zh: 耶和华如此说：「你们是无价被卖的，也必无银被赎。
52.en: For the LORD says, “You were sold for nothing; and you will be redeemed without money.”

52.zh: 主耶和华如此说：起先我的百姓下到埃及，在那里寄居，又有亚述人无故欺压他们。
52.en: For the Lord GOD says: “My people went down at the first into Egypt to live there; and the Assyrian has oppressed them without cause.

52.zh: 耶和华说：我的百姓既是无价被掳去，如今我在这里做什么呢？耶和华说：辖制他们的人呼叫，我的名整天受亵渎。
52.en: “Now therefore, what do I do here,” says the LORD, “seeing that my people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule over them mock,” says the LORD, “and my name is blasphemed continually all day long.

52.zh: 所以，我的百姓必知道我的名；到那日[他们必知道]说这话的就是我。看哪，是我！」
52.en: Therefore my people shall know my name. Therefore they shall know in that day that I am he who speaks. Behold, it is I.”

52.zh: 那报佳音，传平安， 报好信，传救恩的， 对锡安说：你的　神作王了！ 这人的脚登山何等佳美！
52.en: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”

52.zh: 听啊，你守望之人的声音， 他们扬起声来，一同歌唱； 因为耶和华归回锡安的时候， 他们必亲眼看见。
52.en: Your watchmen lift up their voice. Together they sing; for they shall see eye to eye when the LORD returns to Zion.

52.zh: 耶路撒冷的荒场啊， 要发起欢声，一同歌唱； 因为耶和华安慰了他的百姓， 救赎了耶路撒冷。
52.en: Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for the LORD has comforted his people. He has redeemed Jerusalem.

52.zh: 耶和华在万国眼前露出圣臂； 地极的人都看见我们　神的救恩了。
52.en: The LORD has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

52.zh: 你们离开吧！离开吧！ 从巴比伦出来。 不要沾不洁净的物； 要从其中出来。 你们扛抬耶和华器皿的人哪， 务要自洁。
52.en: Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Go out from among her! Cleanse yourselves, you who carry the LORD’s vessels.

52.zh: 你们出来必不致急忙， 也不致奔逃。 因为，耶和华必在你们前头行； 以色列的　神必作你们的后盾。
52.en: For you shall not go out in haste, neither shall you go by flight; for the LORD will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your rear guard.

52.zh: 我的仆人行事必有智慧， 必被高举上升， 且成为至高。
52.en: Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high.

52.zh: 许多人因他惊奇； 他的面貌比别人憔悴； 他的形容比世人枯槁。
52.en: Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men—

52.zh: 这样，他必洗净许多国民； 君王要向他闭口。 因所未曾传与他们的，他们必看见； 未曾听见的，他们要明白。
52.en: so he will cleanse many nations. Kings will shut their mouths at him; for they will see that which had not been told them, and they will understand that which they had not heard.

53.zh: 我们所传的有谁信呢？ 耶和华的膀臂向谁显露呢？
53.en: Who has believed our message? To whom has the LORD’s arm been revealed?

53.zh: 他在耶和华面前生长如嫩芽， 像根出于干地。 他无佳形美容； 我们看见他的时候， 也无美貌使我们羡慕他。
53.en: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

53.zh: 他被藐视，被人厌弃； 多受痛苦，常经忧患。 他被藐视， 好像被人掩面不看的一样； 我们也不尊重他。
53.en: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.

53.zh: 他诚然担当我们的忧患， 背负我们的痛苦； 我们却以为他受责罚， 被　神击打苦待了。
53.en: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.

53.zh: 哪知他为我们的过犯受害， 为我们的罪孽压伤。 因他受的刑罚，我们得平安； 因他受的鞭伤，我们得医治。
53.en: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.

53.zh: 我们都如羊走迷； 各人偏行己路； 耶和华使我们众人的罪孽都归在他身上。
53.en: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

53.zh: 他被欺压， 在受苦的时候却不开口 ； 他像羊羔被牵到宰杀之地， 又像羊在剪毛的人手下无声， 他也是这样不开口。
53.en: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth.

53.zh: 因受欺压和审判，他被夺去， 至于他同世的人，谁想他受鞭打、 从活人之地被剪除， 是因我百姓的罪过呢？
53.en: He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?

53.zh: 他虽然未行强暴， 口中也没有诡诈， 人还使他与恶人同埋； 谁知死的时候与财主同葬。
53.en: They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.

53.zh: 耶和华却定意将他压伤， 使他受痛苦。 耶和华以他为赎罪祭。 他必看见后裔，并且延长年日。 耶和华所喜悦的事必在他手中亨通。
53.en: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days and the LORD’s pleasure will prosper in his hand.

53.zh: 他必看见自己劳苦的功效， 便心满意足。 有许多人因认识我的义仆得称为义； 并且他要担当他们的罪孽。
53.en: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.

53.zh: 所以，我要使他与位大的同分， 与强盛的均分掳物。 因为他将命倾倒，以致于死； 他也被列在罪犯之中。 他却担当多人的罪， 又为罪犯代求。
53.en: Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors.

54.zh: 你这不怀孕、不生养的要歌唱； 你这未曾经过产难的要发声歌唱，扬声欢呼； 因为没有丈夫的比有丈夫的儿女更多。 这是耶和华说的。
54.en: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth! Break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child! For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife,” says the LORD.

54.zh: 要扩张你帐幕之地， 张大你居所的幔子，不要限止； 要放长你的绳子， 坚固你的橛子。
54.en: “Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare; lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.

54.zh: 因为你要向左向右开展； 你的后裔必得多国为业， 又使荒凉的城邑有人居住。
54.en: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left; and your offspring will possess the nations and settle in desolate cities.

54.zh: 不要惧怕，因你必不致蒙羞； 也不要抱愧，因你必不致受辱。 你必忘记幼年的羞愧， 不再记念你寡居的羞辱。
54.en: “Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth. You will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more.

54.zh: 因为造你的是你的丈夫； 万军之耶和华是他的名。 救赎你的是以色列的圣者； 他必称为全地之　神。
54.en: For your Maker is your husband; the LORD of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.

54.zh: 耶和华召你， 如召被离弃心中忧伤的妻， 就是幼年所娶被弃的妻。 这是你　神所说的。
54.en: For the LORD has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off,” says your God.

54.zh: 我离弃你不过片时， 却要施大恩将你收回。
54.en: “For a small moment I have forsaken you, but I will gather you with great mercies.

54.zh: 我的怒气涨溢， 顷刻之间向你掩面， 却要以永远的慈爱怜恤你。 这是耶和华—你的救赎主说的。
54.en: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.

54.zh: 这事在我好像挪亚的洪水。 我怎样起誓不再使挪亚的洪水漫过遍地， 我也照样起誓不再向你发怒， 也不斥责你。
54.en: “For this is like the waters of Noah to me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, nor rebuke you.

54.zh: 大山可以挪开， 小山可以迁移； 但我的慈爱必不离开你； 我平安的约也不迁移。 这是怜恤你的耶和华说的。
54.en: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says the LORD who has mercy on you.

54.zh: 你这受困苦、被风飘荡不得安慰的人哪， 我必以彩色安置你的石头， 以蓝宝石立定你的根基；
54.en: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires.

54.zh: 又以红宝石造你的女墙， 以红玉造你的城门， 以宝石造你四围的边界。
54.en: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.

54.zh: 你的儿女都要受耶和华的教训； 你的儿女必大享平安。
54.en: All your children will be taught by the LORD, and your children’s peace will be great.

54.zh: 你必因公义得坚立， 必远离欺压，不致害怕； 你必远离惊吓，惊吓必不临近你。
54.en: You will be established in righteousness. You will be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid, and far from terror, for it shall not come near you.

54.zh: 即或有人聚集，却不由于我； 凡聚集攻击你的，必因你仆倒。
54.en: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me. Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you.

54.zh: 吹嘘炭火、打造合用器械的铁匠是我所造； 残害人、行毁灭的也是我所造。
54.en: “Behold, I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame, and forges a weapon for his work; and I have created the destroyer to destroy.

54.zh: 凡为攻击你造成的器械必不利用； 凡在审判时兴起用舌攻击你的， 你必定他为有罪。 这是耶和华仆人的产业， 是他们从我所得的义。 这是耶和华说的。
54.en: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of the LORD’s servants, and their righteousness is of me,” says the LORD.

55.zh: 你们一切干渴的都当就近水来； 没有银钱的也可以来。 你们都来，买了吃； 不用银钱，不用价值， 也来买酒和奶。
55.en: “Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

55.zh: 你们为何花钱买那不足为食物的？ 用劳碌得来的买那不使人饱足的呢？ 你们要留意听我的话就能吃那美物， 得享肥甘，心中喜乐。
55.en: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in richness.

55.zh: 你们当就近我来； 侧耳而听，就必得活。 我必与你们立永约， 就是[应许]大卫那可靠的恩典。
55.en: Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

55.zh: 我已立他作万民的见证， 为万民的君王和司令。
55.en: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.

55.zh: 你素不认识的国民，你也必召来； 素不认识你的国民也必向你奔跑， 都因耶和华—你的　神以色列的圣者， 因为他已经荣耀你。
55.en: Behold, you shall call a nation that you don’t know; and a nation that didn’t know you shall run to you, because of the LORD your God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified you.”

55.zh: 当趁耶和华可寻找的时候寻找他， 相近的时候求告他。
55.en: Seek the LORD while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.

55.zh: 恶人当离弃自己的道路； 不义的人当除掉自己的意念。 归向耶和华，耶和华就必怜恤他； 当归向我们的　神，因为　神必广行赦免。
55.en: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to the LORD, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.

55.zh: 耶和华说：我的意念非同你们的意念； 我的道路非同你们的道路。
55.en: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says the LORD.

55.zh: 天怎样高过地， 照样，我的道路高过你们的道路； 我的意念高过你们的意念。
55.en: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

55.zh: 雨雪从天而降，并不返回， 却滋润地土，使地上发芽结实， 使撒种的有种，使要吃的有粮。
55.en: For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky, and doesn’t return there, but waters the earth, and makes it grow and bud, and gives seed to the sower and bread to the eater;

55.zh: 我口所出的话也必如此， 决不徒然返回， 却要成就我所喜悦的， 在我发他去成就的事上必然亨通。
55.en: so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.

55.zh: 你们必欢欢喜喜而出来， 平平安安蒙引导。 大山小山必在你们面前发声歌唱； 田野的树木也都拍掌。
55.en: For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands.

55.zh: 松树长出，代替荆棘； 番石榴长出，代替蒺藜。 这要为耶和华留名， 作为永远的证据，不能剪除。
55.en: Instead of the thorn the cypress tree will come up; and instead of the brier the myrtle tree will come up. It will make a name for the LORD, for an everlasting sign that will not be cut off.”

56.zh: 耶和华如此说： 你们当守公平，行公义； 因我的救恩临近， 我的公义将要显现。
56.en: The LORD says: “Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is near and my righteousness will soon be revealed.

56.zh: 谨守安息日而不干犯， 禁止己手而不作恶； 如此行、如此持守的人便为有福。
56.en: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.”

56.zh: 与耶和华联合的外邦人不要说： 耶和华必定将我从他民中分别出来。 太监也不要说：我是枯树。
56.en: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD speak, saying, “The LORD will surely separate me from his people.” Do not let the eunuch say, “Behold, I am a dry tree.”

56.zh: 因为耶和华如此说： 那些谨守我的安息日， 拣选我所喜悦的事， 持守我约的太监，
56.en: For the LORD says, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant,

56.zh: 我必使他们在我殿中， 在我墙内，有记念，有名号， 比有儿女的更美。 我必赐他们永远的名，不能剪除。
56.en: I will give them in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters. I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off.

56.zh: 还有那些与耶和华联合的外邦人， 要事奉他，要爱耶和华的名， 要作他的仆人— 就是凡守安息日不干犯， 又持守他约的人。
56.en: Also the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD to serve him, and to love the LORD’s name, to be his servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and holds fast my covenant,

56.zh: 我必领他们到我的圣山， 使他们在祷告我的殿中喜乐。 他们的燔祭和[平安]祭， 在我坛上必蒙悦纳， 因我的殿必称为万民祷告的殿。
56.en: I will bring these to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.”

56.zh: 主耶和华， 就是招聚以色列被赶散的，说： 在这被招聚的人以外， 我还要招聚[别人]归并他们。
56.en: The Lord GOD, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, “I will yet gather others to him, in addition to his own who are gathered.”

56.zh: 田野的诸兽都来吞吃吧！ 林中的诸兽也要如此。
56.en: All you animals of the field, come to devour, all you animals in the forest.

56.zh: 他看守的人是瞎眼的， 都没有知识， 都是哑巴狗，不能叫唤； 但知做梦，躺卧，贪睡，
56.en: His watchmen are blind. They are all without knowledge. They are all mute dogs. They can’t bark— dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.

56.zh: 这些狗贪食，不知饱足。 这些牧人不能明白— 各人偏行己路， 各从各方求自己的利益。
56.en: Yes, the dogs are greedy. They can never have enough. They are shepherds who can’t understand. They have all turned to their own way, each one to his gain, from every quarter.

56.zh: 他们说：来吧！我去拿酒， 我们饱饮浓酒； 明日必和今日一样， 就是[宴乐]无量极大之日。
56.en: “Come,” they say, “I will get wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be as today, great beyond measure.”

57.zh: 义人死亡， 无人放在心上； 虔诚人被收去， 无人思念。 这义人被收去是免了[将来的]祸患；
57.en: The righteous perish, and no one lays it to heart. Merciful men are taken away, and no one considers that the righteous is taken away from the evil.

57.zh: 他们得享平安。 素行正直的，各人在坟里安歇。
57.en: He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.

57.zh: 你们这些巫婆的儿子， 奸夫和妓女的种子， 都要前来！
57.en: “But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes.

57.zh: 你们向谁戏笑？ 向谁张口吐舌呢？ 你们岂不是悖逆的儿女， 虚谎的种类呢？
57.en: Whom do you mock? Against whom do you make a wide mouth and stick out your tongue? Aren’t you children of disobedience and offspring of falsehood,

57.zh: 你们在橡树中间，在各青翠树下欲火攻心； 在山谷间，在石穴下杀了儿女；
57.en: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?

57.zh: 在谷中光滑[石头]里有你的分。 这些就是你所得的分； 你也向他浇了奠祭，献了供物， 因这事我岂能容忍吗？
57.en: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion. They, they are your lot. You have even poured a drink offering to them. You have offered an offering. Shall I be appeased for these things?

57.zh: 你在高而又高的山上安设床榻， 也上那里去献祭。
57.en: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.

57.zh: 你在门后，在门框后， 立起你的纪念； 向外人赤露，又上去扩张床榻， 与他们立约； 你在那里看见他们的床就甚喜爱。
57.en: You have set up your memorial behind the doors and the posts, for you have exposed yourself to someone besides me, and have gone up. You have enlarged your bed and made a covenant for yourself with them. You loved what you saw on their bed.

57.zh: 你把油带到王那里， 又多加香料， 打发使者往远方去， 自卑自贱直到阴间，
57.en: You went to the king with oil, increased your perfumes, sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to Sheol.

57.zh: 你因路远疲倦， 却不说这是枉然； 你[以为]有复兴之力， 所以不觉疲惫。
57.en: You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren’t faint.

57.zh: 你怕谁？因谁恐惧？ 竟说谎，不记念我， 又不将这事放在心上。 我不是许久闭口不言， 你仍不怕我吗？
57.en: “Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I held my peace for a long time, and you don’t fear me?

57.zh: 我要指明你的公义； 至于你所行的都必与你无益。
57.en: I will declare your righteousness; and as for your works, they will not benefit you.

57.zh: 你哀求的时候， 让你所聚集的拯救你吧！ 风要把他们刮散， 一口气要把他们都吹去。 但那投靠我的必得地土， 必承受我的圣山为业。
57.en: When you cry, let those whom you have gathered deliver you, but the wind will take them. A breath will carry them all away, but he who takes refuge in me will possess the land, and will inherit my holy mountain.”

57.zh: 耶和华要说： 你们修筑修筑，预备道路， 将绊脚石从我百姓的路中除掉。
57.en: He will say, “Build up, build up, prepare the way! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.”

57.zh: 因为那至高至上、永远长存 名为圣者的如此说： 我住在至高至圣的所在， 也与心灵痛悔谦卑的人同居； 要使谦卑人的灵苏醒， 也使痛悔人的心苏醒。
57.en: For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.

57.zh: 我必不永远相争，也不长久发怒， 恐怕我所造的人与灵性都必发昏。
57.en: For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls whom I have made.

57.zh: 因他贪婪的罪孽，我就发怒击打他； 我向他掩面发怒， 他却仍然随心背道。
57.en: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him. I hid myself and was angry; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.

57.zh: 我看见他所行的道，也要医治他； 又要引导他， 使他和那一同伤心的人再得安慰。
57.en: I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.

57.zh: 我造就嘴唇的果子； 愿平安康泰归与远处的人， 也归与近处的人； 并且我要医治他。 这是耶和华说的。
57.en: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says the LORD; “and I will heal them.”

57.zh: 惟独恶人，好像翻腾的海， 不得平静； 其中的水常涌出污秽和淤泥来。
57.en: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can’t rest and its waters cast up mire and mud.

57.zh: 我的　神说：恶人必不得平安！
57.en: “There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”

58.zh: 你要大声喊叫，不可止息； 扬起声来，好像吹角。 向我百姓说明他们的过犯； 向雅各家说明他们的罪恶。
58.en: “Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house of Jacob their sins.

58.zh: 他们天天寻求我， 乐意明白我的道， 好像行义的国民， 不离弃他们　神的典章， 向我求问公义的判语， 喜悦亲近　神。
58.en: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways. As a nation that did righteousness, and didn’t forsake the ordinance of their God, they ask of me righteous judgments. They delight to draw near to God.

58.zh: 他们说：我们禁食，你为何不看见呢？ 我们刻苦己心，你为何不理会呢？ 看哪，你们禁食的日子仍求利益， 勒逼人为你们做苦工。
58.en: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and oppress all your laborers.

58.zh: 你们禁食，却互相争竞， 以凶恶的拳头打人。 你们今日禁食， 不得使你们的声音听闻于上。
58.en: Behold, you fast for strife and contention, and to strike with the fist of wickedness. You don’t fast today so as to make your voice to be heard on high.

58.zh: 这样禁食岂是我所拣选、 使人刻苦己心的日子吗？ 岂是叫人垂头像苇子， 用麻布和炉灰铺在他以下吗？ 你这可称为禁食、为耶和华所悦纳的日子吗？
58.en: Is this the fast that I have chosen? A day for a man to humble his soul? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under himself? Will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?

58.zh: 我所拣选的禁食不是要松开凶恶的绳， 解下轭上的索， 使被欺压的得自由， 折断一切的轭吗？
58.en: “Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke?

58.zh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人， 将飘流的穷人接到你家中， 见赤身的给他[衣服]遮体， 顾恤自己的骨肉而不掩藏吗？
58.en: Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you not hide yourself from your own flesh?

58.zh: 这样，你的光就必发现如早晨的光； 你所得的医治要速速发明。 你的公义必在你前面行； 耶和华的荣光必作你的后盾。
58.en: Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go before you, and the LORD’s glory will be your rear guard.

58.zh: 那时你求告，耶和华必应允； 你呼求，他必说：我在这里。 你若从你中间除掉[重]轭 和指摘人的指头，并发恶言的事，
58.en: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer. You will cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I am.’ “If you take away from among you the yoke, finger pointing, and speaking wickedly;

58.zh: 你心若向饥饿的人发怜悯， 使困苦的人得满足， 你的光就必在黑暗中发现； 你的幽暗必变如正午。
58.en: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your obscurity will be as the noonday;

58.zh: 耶和华也必时常引导你， 在干旱之地使你心满意足， 骨头强壮。 你必像浇灌的园子， 又像水流不绝的泉源。
58.en: and the LORD will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.

58.zh: 那些出于你的人必修造久已荒废之处； 你要建立[拆毁]累代的根基。 你必称为补破口的， 和重修路径与人居住的。
58.en: Those who will be of you will build the old waste places. You will raise up the foundations of many generations. You will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of Paths with Dwellings.

58.zh: 你若在安息日掉转你的脚步， 在我圣日不以[操作]为喜乐， 称安息日为可喜乐的， 称耶和华的圣日为可尊重的； 而且尊敬这日， 不办自己的私事， 不随自己的私意， 不说自己的私话，
58.en: “If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day, and call the Sabbath a delight, and the holy of the LORD honorable, and honor it, not doing your own ways, nor finding your own pleasure, nor speaking your own words,

58.zh: 你就以耶和华为乐。 耶和华要使你乘驾地的高处， 又以你祖雅各的产业养育你。 这是耶和华亲口说的。
58.en: then you will delight yourself in the LORD, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father;” for the LORD’s mouth has spoken it.

59.zh: 耶和华的膀臂并非缩短，不能拯救， 耳朵并非发沉，不能听见，
59.en: Behold, the LORD’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.

59.zh: 但你们的罪孽使你们与　神隔绝； 你们的罪恶使他掩面不听你们。
59.en: But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

59.zh: 因你们的手被血沾染， 你们的指头被罪孽沾污， 你们的嘴唇说谎言， 你们的舌头出恶语。
59.en: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters wickedness.

59.zh: 无一人按公义告状， 无一人凭诚实辨白； 都倚靠虚妄，说谎言。 所怀的是毒害； 所生的是罪孽。
59.en: No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity and speak lies. They conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.

59.zh: 他们抱毒蛇蛋， 结蜘蛛网； 人吃这蛋必死。 这蛋被踏，必出蝮蛇。
59.en: They hatch adders’ eggs and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.

59.zh: 所结的网不能成为衣服； 所做的也不能遮盖自己。 他们的行为都是罪孽； 手所做的都是强暴。
59.en: Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and acts of violence are in their hands.

59.zh: 他们的脚奔跑行恶； 他们急速流无辜人的血； 意念都是罪孽， 所经过的路都荒凉毁灭。
59.en: Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and destruction are in their paths.

59.zh: 平安的路，他们不知道； 所行的事没有公平。 他们为自己修弯曲的路； 凡行此路的都不知道平安。
59.en: They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves; whoever goes in them doesn’t know peace.

59.zh: 因此，公平离我们远， 公义追不上我们。 我们指望光亮，却是黑暗， 指望光明，却行幽暗。
59.en: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.

59.zh: 我们摸索墙壁，好像瞎子； 我们摸索，如同无目之人。 我们晌午绊脚，如在黄昏一样； 我们在肥壮人中，像死人一般。
59.en: We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were twilight. Among those who are strong, we are like dead men.

59.zh: 我们咆哮如熊， 哀鸣如鸽； 指望公平，却是没有； 指望救恩，却远离我们。
59.en: We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is far off from us.

59.zh: 我们的过犯在你面前增多， 罪恶作见证告我们； 过犯与我们同在。 至于我们的罪孽，我们都知道：
59.en: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:

59.zh: 就是悖逆、不认识耶和华， 转去不跟从我们的　神， 说欺压和叛逆的话， 心怀谎言，随即说出。
59.en: transgressing and denying the LORD, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

59.zh: 并且公平转而退后， 公义站在远处； 诚实在街上仆倒， 正直也不得进入。
59.en: Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness can’t enter.

59.zh: 诚实少见； 离恶的人反成掠物。 那时，耶和华看见没有公平， 甚不喜悦。
59.en: Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. The LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.

59.zh: 他见无人[拯救]， 无人代求，甚为诧异， 就用自己的膀臂施行拯救， 以公义扶持自己。
59.en: He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.

59.zh: 他以公义为铠甲， 以拯救为头盔， 以报仇为衣服， 以热心为外袍。
59.en: He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.

59.zh: 他必按人的行为施报， 恼怒他的敌人， 报复他的仇敌 向众海岛施行报应。
59.en: According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate: wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies. He will repay the islands their due.

59.zh: 如此，人从日落之处必敬畏耶和华的名， 从日出之地也必敬畏他的荣耀； 因为仇敌好像急流的河水冲来， 是耶和华之气所驱逐的。
59.en: So they will fear the LORD’s name from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which the LORD’s breath drives.

59.zh: 必有一位救赎主来到锡安— 雅各族中转离过犯的人那里。 这是耶和华说的。
59.en: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says the LORD.

59.zh: 耶和华说：「至于我与他们所立的约乃是这样：我加给你的灵，传给你的话，必不离你的口，也不离你后裔与你后裔之后裔的口，从今直到永远；这是耶和华说的。」
59.en: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says the LORD, “from now on and forever.”

60.zh: 兴起，发光！因为你的光已经来到！ 耶和华的荣耀发现照耀你。
60.en: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and the LORD’s glory has risen on you!

60.zh: 看哪，黑暗遮盖大地， 幽暗遮盖万民， 耶和华却要显现照耀你； 他的荣耀要现在你身上。
60.en: For behold, darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but the LORD will arise on you, and his glory shall be seen on you.

60.zh: 万国要来就你的光； 君王要来就你发现的光辉。
60.en: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.

60.zh: 你举目向四方观看； 众人都聚集来到你这里。 你的众子从远方而来； 你的众女也被怀抱而来。
60.en: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from far away, and your daughters will be carried in arms.

60.zh: 那时，你看见就有光荣； 你心又跳动又宽畅； 因为大海丰盛的[货物]必转来归你； 列国的财宝也必来归你。
60.en: Then you shall see and be radiant, and your heart will thrill and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea will be turned to you. The wealth of the nations will come to you.

60.zh: 成群的骆驼， 并米甸和以法的独峰驼必遮满你； 示巴的众人都必来到； 要奉上黄金乳香， 又要传说耶和华的赞美。
60.en: A multitude of camels will cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come. They will bring gold and frankincense, and will proclaim the praises of the LORD.

60.zh: 基达的羊群都必聚集到你这里， 尼拜约的公羊要供你使用， 在我坛上必蒙悦纳； 我必荣耀我荣耀的殿。
60.en: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered together to you. The rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will be accepted as offerings on my altar; and I will beautify my glorious house.

60.zh: 那些飞来如云、 又如鸽子向窗户飞回的是谁呢？
60.en: “Who are these who fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

60.zh: 众海岛必等候我， 首先是他施的船只， 将你的众子连他们的金银从远方一同带来， 都为耶和华—你　神的名， 又为以色列的圣者， 因为他已经荣耀了你。
60.en: Surely the islands will wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far away, their silver and their gold with them, for the name of the LORD your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he has glorified you.

60.zh: 外邦人必建筑你的城墙； 他们的王必服事你。 我曾发怒击打你， 现今却施恩怜恤你。
60.en: “Foreigners will build up your walls, and their kings will serve you; for in my wrath I struck you, but in my favor I have had mercy on you.

60.zh: 你的城门必时常开放， 昼夜不关； 使人把列国的财物带来归你， 并将他们的君王牵引而来。
60.en: Your gates also shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night, that men may bring to you the wealth of the nations, and their kings led captive.

60.zh: 哪一邦哪一国不事奉你，就必灭亡， 也必全然荒废。
60.en: For that nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish; yes, those nations shall be utterly wasted.

60.zh: 黎巴嫩的荣耀， 就是松树、杉树、黄杨树， 都必一同归你， 为要修饰我圣所之地； 我也要使我脚踏之处得荣耀。
60.en: “The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress tree, the pine, and the box tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

60.zh: 素来苦待你的，他的子孙都必屈身来就你； 藐视你的，都要在你脚下跪拜。 他们要称你为「耶和华的城」， 为「以色列圣者的锡安」。
60.en: The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at the soles of your feet. They will call you the LORD’s City, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

60.zh: 你虽然被撇弃被厌恶， 甚至无人经过， 我却使你变为永远的荣华， 成为累代的喜乐。
60.en: “Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no one passed through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

60.zh: 你也必吃万国的奶， 又吃君王的奶。 你便知道我—耶和华是你的救主， 是你的救赎主，雅各的大能者。
60.en: You will also drink the milk of the nations, and will nurse from royal breasts. Then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

60.zh: 我要拿金子代替铜， 拿银子代替铁， 拿铜代替木头， 拿铁代替石头； 并要以和平为你的官长， 以公义为你的监督。
60.en: For bronze I will bring gold; for iron I will bring silver; for wood, bronze, and for stones, iron. I will also make peace your governor, and righteousness your ruler.

60.zh: 你地上不再听见强暴的事， 境内不再听见荒凉毁灭的事。 你必称你的墙为「拯救」， 称你的门为「赞美」。
60.en: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, nor desolation or destruction within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.

60.zh: 日头不再作你白昼的光； 月亮也不再发光照耀你。 耶和华却要作你永远的光； 你　神要为你的荣耀。
60.en: The sun will be no more your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.

60.zh: 你的日头不再下落； 你的月亮也不退缩； 因为耶和华必作你永远的光。 你悲哀的日子也完毕了。
60.en: Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will end.

60.zh: 你的居民都成为义人， 永远得地为业； 是我种的栽子，我手的工作， 使我得荣耀。
60.en: Then your people will all be righteous. They will inherit the land forever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

60.zh: 至小的[族]要加增千倍； 微弱的国必成为强盛。 我—耶和华要按定期速成这事。
60.en: The little one will become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation. I, the LORD, will do this quickly in its time.”

61.zh: 主耶和华的灵在我身上； 因为耶和华用膏膏我， 叫我传好信息给谦卑的人， 差遣我医好伤心的人， 报告被掳的得释放， 被囚的出[监牢]；
61.en: The Lord GOD’s Spirit is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound,

61.zh: 报告耶和华的恩年， 和我们　神报仇的日子； 安慰一切悲哀的人，
61.en: to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,

61.zh: 赐华冠与锡安悲哀的人，代替灰尘； 喜乐油代替悲哀； 赞美衣代替忧伤之灵； 使他们称为「公义树」， 是耶和华所栽的，叫他得荣耀。
61.en: to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he may be glorified.

61.zh: 他们必修造已久的荒场， 建立先前凄凉之处， 重修历代荒凉之城。
61.en: They will rebuild the old ruins. They will raise up the former devastated places. They will repair the ruined cities that have been devastated for many generations.

61.zh: 那时，外人必起来牧放你们的羊群； 外邦人必作你们耕种田地的， 修理葡萄园的。
61.en: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards.

61.zh: 你们倒要称为耶和华的祭司； 人必称你们为我们　神的仆役。 你们必吃用列国的财物， 因得他们的荣耀自夸。
61.en: But you will be called the LORD’s priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.

61.zh: 你们[必得]加倍[的好处]，代替所受的羞辱； 分中所得的喜乐，必代替所受的凌辱。 在境内必得加倍[的产业]； 永远之乐必归与你们。
61.en: Instead of your shame you will have double. Instead of dishonor, they will rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double. Everlasting joy will be to them.

61.zh: 因为我—耶和华喜爱公平， 恨恶抢夺和罪孽； 我要凭诚实施行报应， 并要与我的百姓立永约。
61.en: “For I, the LORD, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

61.zh: 他们的后裔必在列国中被人认识； 他们的子孙在众民中也是如此。 凡看见他们的必认他们是耶和华赐福的后裔。
61.en: Their offspring will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge them, that they are the offspring which the LORD has blessed.”

61.zh: 我因耶和华大大欢喜； 我的心靠　神快乐。 因他以拯救为衣给我穿上， 以公义为袍给我披上， 好像新郎戴上华冠， 又像新妇佩戴妆饰。
