61.en: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

61.zh: 田地怎样使百谷发芽， 园子怎样使所种的发生， 主耶和华必照样 使公义和赞美在万民中发出。
61.en: For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.

62.zh: 我因锡安必不静默， 为耶路撒冷必不息声， 直到他的公义如光辉发出， 他的救恩如明灯发亮。
62.en: For Zion’s sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a burning lamp.

62.zh: 列国必见你的公义； 列王必见你的荣耀。 你必得新名的称呼， 是耶和华亲口所起的。
62.en: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name, which the LORD’s mouth will name.

62.zh: 你在耶和华的手中要作为华冠， 在你　神的掌上必作为冕旒。
62.en: You will also be a crown of beauty in the LORD’s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.

62.zh: 你必不再称为「撇弃的」； 你的地也不再称为「荒凉的」。 你却要称为「我所喜悦的」； 你的地也必称为「有夫之妇」。 因为耶和华喜悦你， 你的地也必归他。
62.en: You will not be called Forsaken any more, nor will your land be called Desolate any more; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD delights in you, and your land will be married.

62.zh: 少年人怎样娶处女， 你的众民也要照样娶你； 新郎怎样喜悦新妇， 你的　神也要照样喜悦你。
62.en: For as a young man marries a virgin, so your sons will marry you. As a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.

62.zh: 耶路撒冷啊， 我在你城上设立守望的， 他们昼夜必不静默。 呼吁耶和华的，你们不要歇息，
62.en: I have set watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem. They will never be silent day nor night. You who call on the LORD, take no rest,

62.zh: 也不要使他歇息， 直等他建立耶路撒冷， 使耶路撒冷在地上成为可赞美的。
62.en: and give him no rest until he establishes, and until he makes Jerusalem a praise on the earth.

62.zh: 耶和华指着自己的右手和大能的膀臂起誓说： 我必不再将你的五谷给你仇敌作食物； 外邦人也不再喝你劳碌得来的新酒。
62.en: The LORD has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, “Surely I will no more give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners will not drink your new wine, for which you have labored,

62.zh: 惟有那收割的要吃，并赞美耶和华； 那聚敛的要在我圣所的院内喝。
62.en: but those who have harvested it will eat it, and praise the LORD. Those who have gathered it will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.”

62.zh: 你们当从门经过经过， 预备百姓的路； 修筑修筑大道， 捡去石头， 为万民竖立大旗，
62.en: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples.

62.zh: 看哪，耶和华曾宣告到地极， 对锡安的居民说： 你的拯救者来到。 他的赏赐在他那里； 他的报应在他面前。
62.en: Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the end of the earth: “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes! Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him!’”

62.zh: 人必称他们为「圣民」，为「耶和华的赎民」； 你也必称为「被眷顾、不撇弃的城」。
62.en: They will call them “The Holy People, The LORD’s Redeemed”. You will be called “Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken”.

63.zh: 这从以东的波斯拉来， 穿红衣服， 装扮华美， 能力广大， 大步行走的是谁呢？ 就是我， 是凭公义说话， 以大能施行拯救。
63.en: Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching in the greatness of his strength? “It is I who speak in righteousness, mighty to save.”

63.zh: 你的装扮为何有红色？ 你的衣服为何像踹酒榨的呢？
63.en: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat?

63.zh: 我独自踹酒榨； 众民中无一人与我同在。 我发怒将他们踹下， 发烈怒将他们践踏。 他们的血溅在我衣服上， 并且污染了我一切的衣裳。
63.en: “I have trodden the wine press alone. Of the peoples, no one was with me. Yes, I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my wrath. Their lifeblood is sprinkled on my garments, and I have stained all my clothing.

63.zh: 因为，报仇之日在我心中； 救赎我民之年已经来到。
63.en: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed has come.

63.zh: 我仰望，见无人帮助； 我诧异，没有人扶持。 所以，我自己的膀臂为我施行拯救； 我的烈怒将我扶持。
63.en: I looked, and there was no one to help; and I wondered that there was no one to uphold. Therefore my own arm brought salvation to me. My own wrath upheld me.

63.zh: 我发怒，踹下众民； 发烈怒，使他们沉醉， 又将他们的血倒在地上。
63.en: I trod down the peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my wrath. I poured their lifeblood out on the earth.”

63.zh: 我要照耶和华一切所赐给我们的， 提起他的慈爱和美德， 并他向以色列家所施的大恩； 这恩是照他的怜恤 和丰盛的慈爱赐给他们的。
63.en: I will tell of the loving kindnesses of the LORD and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD has given to us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has given to them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

63.zh: 他说：他们诚然是我的百姓， 不行虚假的子民； 这样，他就作了他们的救主。
63.en: For he said, “Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely;” so he became their Savior.

63.zh: 他们在一切苦难中， 他也同受苦难； 并且他面前的使者拯救他们； 他以慈爱和怜悯救赎他们； 在古时的日子常保抱他们，怀搋他们。
63.en: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he redeemed them. He bore them, and carried them all the days of old.

63.zh: 他们竟悖逆，使主的圣灵担忧。 他就转作他们的仇敌， 亲自攻击他们。
63.en: But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought against them.

63.zh: 那时，他们想起古时的日子— 摩西和他百姓，[说]： 将百姓和牧养他全群的人 从海里领上来的在哪里呢？ 将他的圣灵降在他们中间的在哪里呢？
63.en: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying, “Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is he who put his Holy Spirit among them?”

63.zh: 使他荣耀的膀臂在摩西的右手边行动， 在他们前面将水分开， 要建立自己永远的名，
63.en: Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses’ right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

63.zh: 带领他们经过深处， 如马行走旷野， 使他们不致绊跌的在哪里呢？
63.en: Who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn’t stumble?

63.zh: 耶和华的灵使他们得安息， 仿佛牲畜下到山谷； 照样，你也引导你的百姓， 要建立自己荣耀的名。
63.en: As the livestock that go down into the valley, the LORD’s Spirit caused them to rest. So you led your people to make yourself a glorious name.

63.zh: 求你从天上垂顾， 从你圣洁荣耀的居所观看。 你的热心和你大能的作为在哪里呢？ 你爱慕的心肠和怜悯向我们止住了。
63.en: Look down from heaven, and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory. Where are your zeal and your mighty acts? The yearning of your heart and your compassion is restrained toward me.

63.zh: 亚伯拉罕虽然不认识我们， 以色列也不承认我们， 你却是我们的父。 耶和华啊，你是我们的父； 从万古以来，你名称为「我们的救赎主」。
63.en: For you are our Father, though Abraham doesn’t know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, LORD, are our Father. Our Redeemer from everlasting is your name.

63.zh: 耶和华啊，你为何使我们走差离开你的道， 使我们心里刚硬、不敬畏你呢？ 求你为你仆人， 为你产业支派的缘故，转回来。
63.en: O LORD, why do you make us wander from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.

63.zh: 你的圣民不过暂时得这产业； 我们的敌人已经践踏你的圣所。
63.en: Your holy people possessed it but a little while. Our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.

63.zh: 我们好像你未曾治理的人， 又像未曾得称你名下的人。
63.en: We have become like those over whom you never ruled, like those who were not called by your name.

64.zh: 愿你裂天而降； 愿山在你面前震动—
64.en: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—

64.zh: 好像火烧干柴， 又像火将水烧开， 使你敌人知道你的名， 使列国在你面前发颤！
64.en: as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!

64.zh: 你曾行我们不能逆料可畏的事。 那时你降临，山岭在你面前震动。
64.en: When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.

64.zh: 从古以来，人未曾听见、未曾耳闻、未曾眼见 在你以外有什么神为等候他的人行事。
64.en: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.

64.zh: 你迎接那欢喜行义、记念你道的人； 你曾发怒，我们[仍]犯罪； 这景况已久，我们还能得救吗？
64.en: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?

64.zh: 我们都像不洁净的人； 所有的义都像污秽的衣服。 我们都像叶子渐渐枯干； 我们的罪孽好像风把我们吹去。
64.en: For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.

64.zh: 并且无人求告你的名； 无人奋力抓住你。 原来你掩面不顾我们， 使我们因罪孽消化。
64.en: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.

64.zh: 耶和华啊，现在你仍是我们的父！ 我们是泥，你是窑匠； 我们都是你手的工作。
64.en: But now, LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.

64.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要大发震怒， 也不要永远记念罪孽。 求你垂顾我们， 我们都是你的百姓。
64.en: Don’t be furious, LORD. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.

64.zh: 你的圣邑变为旷野。 锡安变为旷野； 耶路撒冷成为荒场。
64.en: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

64.zh: 我们圣洁华美的殿— 就是我们列祖赞美你的所在被火焚烧； 我们所羡慕的美地尽都荒废。
64.en: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.

64.zh: 耶和华啊，有这些事，你还忍得住吗？ 你仍静默使我们深受苦难吗？
64.en: Will you hold yourself back for these things, LORD? Will you keep silent and punish us very severely?

65.zh: 素来没有访问[我的]，现在求问我； 没有寻找我的，我叫他们遇见； 没有称为我名下的，我对他们说： 我在这里！我在这里！
65.en: “I am inquired of by those who didn’t ask. I am found by those who didn’t seek me. I said, ‘See me, see me,’ to a nation that was not called by my name.

65.zh: 我整天伸手招呼那悖逆的百姓； 他们随自己的意念行不善之道。
65.en: I have spread out my hands all day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;

65.zh: 这百姓时常当面惹我发怒； 在园中献祭， 在坛上烧香；
65.en: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens, and burning incense on bricks;

65.zh: 在坟墓间坐着， 在隐密处住宿， 吃猪肉； 他们器皿中有可憎之物做的汤；
65.en: who sit among the graves, and spend nights in secret places; who eat pig’s meat, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

65.zh: 且对人说：你站开吧！ 不要挨近我，因为我比你圣洁。 [主说]：这些人是我鼻中的烟， 是整天烧着的火。
65.en: who say, ‘Stay by yourself, don’t come near to me, for I am holier than you.’ These are smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all day.

65.zh: 看哪，这都写在我面前。 我必不静默，必施行报应， 必将你们的罪孽和你们列祖的罪孽， 就是在山上烧香， 在冈上亵渎我的罪孽， 一同报应在他们后人怀中， 我先要把他们所行的量给他们； 这是耶和华说的。
65.en: “Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will repay, yes, I will repay into their bosom

your own iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together”, says the LORD, “who have burned incense on the mountains, and blasphemed me on the hills. Therefore I will first measure their work into their bosom.”

65.zh: 耶和华如此说：葡萄中寻得新酒， 人就说：不要毁坏， 因为福在其中。 我因我仆人的缘故也必照样而行， 不将他们全然毁灭。
65.en: The LORD says, “As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, ‘Don’t destroy it, for a blessing is in it:’ so I will do for my servants’ sake, that I may not destroy them all.

65.zh: 我必从雅各中领出后裔， 从犹大中领出承受我众山的。 我的选民必承受； 我的仆人要在那里居住。
65.en: I will bring offspring out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains. My chosen will inherit it, and my servants will dwell there.

65.zh: 沙 [平原]必成为羊群的圈； 亚割谷必成为牛群躺卧之处， 都为寻求我的民所得。
65.en: Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people who have sought me.

65.zh: 但你们这些离弃耶和华、 忘记我的圣山、给时运摆筵席、 给天命盛满调和酒的，
65.en: “But you who forsake the LORD, who forget my holy mountain, who prepare a table for Fortune, and who fill up mixed wine to Destiny;

65.zh: 我要命定你们归在刀下， 都必屈身被杀； 因为我呼唤，你们没有答应； 我说话，你们没有听从； 反倒行我眼中看为恶的， 拣选我所不喜悦的。
65.en: I will destine you to the sword, and you will all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, you didn’t answer. When I spoke, you didn’t listen; but you did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”

65.zh: 所以，主耶和华如此说： 我的仆人必得吃，你们却饥饿； 我的仆人必得喝，你们却干渴； 我的仆人必欢喜，你们却蒙羞。
65.en: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, my servants will rejoice, but you will be disappointed.

65.zh: 我的仆人因心中高兴欢呼， 你们却因心中忧愁哀哭， 又因心里忧伤哀号。
65.en: Behold, my servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will wail for anguish of spirit.

65.zh: 你们必留下自己的名， 为我选民指着赌咒。 主耶和华必杀你们， 另起别名称呼他的仆人。
65.en: You will leave your name for a curse to my chosen, and the Lord GOD will kill you. He will call his servants by another name,

65.zh: 这样，在地上为自己求福的， 必凭真实的　神求福； 在地上起誓的， 必指真实的　神起誓。 因为，从前的患难已经忘记， 也从我眼前隐藏了。
65.en: so that he who blesses himself on the earth will bless himself in the God of truth; and he who swears on the earth will swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hidden from my eyes.

65.zh: 看哪！我造新天新地； 从前的事不再被记念，也不再追想。
65.en: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.

65.zh: 你们当因我所造的永远欢喜快乐； 因我造耶路撒冷为人所喜， 造其中的居民为人所乐。
65.en: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people a joy.

65.zh: 我必因耶路撒冷欢喜， 因我的百姓快乐； 其中必不再听见哭泣的声音和哀号的声音。
65.en: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more.

65.zh: 其中必没有数日[夭亡]的婴孩， 也没有寿数不满的老者； 因为百岁死的仍算孩童， 有百岁[死]的罪人算被咒诅。
65.en: “No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child will die one hundred years old, and the sinner being one hundred years old will be accursed.

65.zh: 他们要建造房屋，自己居住； 栽种葡萄园，吃其中的果子。
65.en: They will build houses and inhabit them. They will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

65.zh: 他们建造的，别人不得住； 他们栽种的，别人不得吃； 因为我民的日子必像树木的日子； 我选民亲手劳碌得来的必长久享用。
65.en: They will not build and another inhabit. They will not plant and another eat; for the days of my people will be like the days of a tree, and my chosen will long enjoy the work of their hands.

65.zh: 他们必不徒然劳碌， 所生产的，也不遭灾害， 因为都是蒙耶和华赐福的后裔； 他们的子孙也是如此。
65.en: They will not labor in vain nor give birth for calamity; for they are the offspring of the LORD’s blessed and their descendants with them.

65.zh: 他们尚未求告，我就应允； 正说话的时候，我就垂听。
65.en: It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

65.zh: 豺狼必与羊羔同食； 狮子必吃草与牛一样； 尘土必作蛇的食物。 在我圣山的遍处， 这一切都不伤人，不害物。 这是耶和华说的。
65.en: The wolf and the lamb will feed together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent’s food. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain,” says the LORD.

66.zh: 耶和华如此说： 天是我的座位； 地是我的脚凳。 你们要为我造何等的殿宇？ 哪里是我安息的地方呢？
66.en: The LORD says: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I rest?

66.zh: 耶和华说：这一切都是我手所造的， 所以就都有了。 但我所看顾的， 就是虚心痛悔、 因我话而战兢的人。
66.en: For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says the LORD: “but I will look to this man, even to he who is poor and of a contrite spirit, and who trembles at my word.

66.zh: [假冒为善的]宰牛，好像杀人， 献羊羔，好像打折狗项， 献供物，好像献猪血， 烧乳香，好像称颂偶像。 这等人拣选自己的道路， 心里喜悦行可憎恶的事。
66.en: He who kills an ox is as he who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, as he who breaks a dog’s neck; he who offers an offering, as he who offers pig’s blood; he who burns frankincense, as he who blesses an idol. Yes, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.

66.zh: 我也必拣选迷惑他们的事， 使他们所惧怕的临到他们； 因为我呼唤，无人答应； 我说话，他们不听从； 反倒行我眼中看为恶的， 拣选我所不喜悦的。
66.en: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears on them, because when I called, no one answered; when I spoke, they didn’t listen, but they did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”

66.zh: 你们因耶和华言语战兢的人当听他的话： 你们的弟兄—就是恨恶你们， 因我名赶出你们的，曾说： 愿耶和华得荣耀， 使我们得见你们的喜乐； 但蒙羞的究竟是他们！
66.en: Hear the LORD’s word, you who tremble at his word: “Your brothers who hate you, who cast you out for my name’s sake, have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified, that we may see your joy;’ but it is those who shall be disappointed.

66.zh: 有喧哗的声音出自城中！ 有声音出于殿中！ 是耶和华向仇敌施行报应的声音！
66.en: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that repays his enemies what they deserve.

66.zh: 锡安未曾劬劳就生产， 未觉疼痛就生出男孩。
66.en: “Before she travailed, she gave birth. Before her pain came, she delivered a son.

66.zh: 国岂能一日而生？ 民岂能一时而产？ 因为锡安一劬劳便生下儿女， 这样的事谁曾听见？ 谁曾看见呢？
66.en: Who has heard of such a thing? Who has seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? Shall a nation be born at once? For as soon as Zion travailed, she gave birth to her children.

66.zh: 耶和华说：我既使她临产， 岂不使她生产呢？ 你的　神说：我既使她生产， 岂能使她闭[胎]不生呢？
66.en: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to be delivered?” says the LORD. “Shall I who cause to give birth shut the womb?” says your God.

66.zh: 你们爱慕耶路撒冷的 都要与她一同欢喜快乐； 你们为她悲哀的 都要与她一同乐上加乐；
66.en: “Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all you who mourn over her;

66.zh: 使你们在她安慰的怀中吃奶得饱， 使他们得她丰盛的荣耀， 犹如挤奶，满心喜乐。
66.en: that you may nurse and be satisfied at the comforting breasts; that you may drink deeply, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.”

66.zh: 耶和华如此说： 我要使平安延及她，好像江河， 使列国的荣耀延及她，如同涨溢的河。 你们要[从中]享受； 你们必蒙抱在肋旁，摇弄在膝上。
66.en: For the LORD says, “Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream, and you will nurse. You will be carried on her side, and will be dandled on her knees.

66.zh: 母亲怎样安慰儿子，我就照样安慰你们； 你们也必因耶路撒冷得安慰。
66.en: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”

66.zh: 你们看见，就心中快乐； 你们的骨头必得滋润像嫩草一样； 而且耶和华的手向他仆人所行的必被人知道； 他也要向仇敌发恼恨。
66.en: You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. The LORD’s hand will be known among his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.

66.zh: 看哪，耶和华必在火中降临； 他的车辇像旋风， 以烈怒施行报应， 以火焰施行责罚；
66.en: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and his chariots will be like the whirlwind; to give his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

66.zh: 因为耶和华在一切有血气的人身上， 必以火与刀施行审判； 被耶和华所杀的必多。
66.en: For the LORD will execute judgment by fire and by his sword on all flesh; and those slain by the LORD will be many.

66.zh: 「那些分别为圣、洁净自己的，进入园内跟在其中一个人的后头，吃猪肉和仓鼠并可憎之物，他们必一同灭绝；这是耶和华说的。
66.en: “Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, following one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together,” says the LORD.

66.zh: 「[我知道]他们的行为和他们的意念。[时候]将到，我必将万民万族聚来，看见我的荣耀，
66.en: “For I know their works and their thoughts. The time comes that I will gather all nations and languages, and they will come, and will see my glory.

66.zh: 我要显神迹在他们中间。逃脱的，我要差到列国去，就是到他施、普勒、拉弓的路德和土巴、雅完，并素来没有听见我名声、没有看见我荣耀辽远的海岛；他们必将我的荣耀传扬在列国中。
66.en: “I will set a sign among them, and I will send those who escape of them to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to far-away islands, who have not heard my fame, nor have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the nations.

66.zh: 他们必将你们的弟兄从列国中送回，使他们或骑马，或坐车，坐轿，骑骡子，骑独峰驼，到我的圣山耶路撒冷，作为供物献给耶和华，好像以色列人用洁净的器皿盛供物奉到耶和华的殿中；这是耶和华说的。
66.en: They shall bring all your brothers out of all the nations for an offering to the LORD, on horses, in chariots, in litters, on mules, and on camels, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says the LORD, as the children of Israel bring their offering in a clean vessel into the LORD’s house.

66.zh: 耶和华说：我也必从他们中间取人为祭司，为利未人。」
66.en: Of them I will also select priests and Levites,” says the LORD.

66.zh: 耶和华说：我所要造的新天新地， 怎样在我面前长存； 你们的后裔和你们的名字也必照样长存。
66.en: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me,” says the LORD, “so your offspring and your name shall remain.

66.zh: 每逢月朔、安息日， 凡有血气的必来在我面前下拜。 这是耶和华说的。
66.en: It shall happen that from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, all flesh will come to worship before me,” says the LORD.

66.zh: 他们必出去观看那些违背我人的尸首； 因为他们的虫是不死的； 他们的火是不灭的； 凡有血气的都必憎恶他们。
66.en: “They will go out, and look at the dead bodies of the men who have transgressed against me; for their worm will not die, nor will their fire be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind.”
